\"\"}\n              data-testid=\"product-options\"\n              disabled={!!disabled || isAdding}\n            />\n          ))}\n        </div>\n      )}\n\n      <Button\n        onClick={handleAddToCart}\n        disabled={\n          !inStock || !selectedVariant || !!disabled || isAdding || !isValidVariant\n        }\n        size=\"large\"\n        className=\"w-full\"\n        loading={isAdding}\n        data-testid=\"add-product-button\"\n      >\n        {!selectedVariant\n          ?   "instructions": "Show the specs as an honest mono table on the design tokens.",
  "content": "\"use client\"\n\nimport { HttpTypes } from \"@medusajs/types\"\n\nimport Accordion from \"./accordion\"\n\ntype ProductTabsProps = {\n  product: HttpTypes.StoreProduct\n}\n\nconst ProductTabs = ({ product }: ProductTabsProps) => {\n  const tabs = [\n    {\n      label: \"Product information\",\n      component: <ProductInfoTab product={product} />,\n    },\n    {\n      label: \"Shipping and returns\",\n      component: <ShippingInfoTab />,\n    },\n  ]\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"w-full\">\n      <Accordion type=\"multiple\">\n        {tabs.map((tab) => (\n          <Accordion.Item key={tab.label} title={tab.label} value={tab.label}>\n            {tab.component}\n          </Accordion.Item>\n        ))}\n      </Accordion>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n\n/*\n * Specs are facts, so they are set as a definition list and the values are\n * mono, the one place in this design that is allowed to look like a data sheet\n * (docs/DESIGN.md §3). A field with no value is left out rather than shown as\n * a dash.\n */\nconst ProductInfoTab = ({ product }: ProductTabsProps) => {\n  const specs: { term: string; value: string | null | undefined }[] = [\n    { term: \"Material\", value: product.material },\n    { term: \"Country of origin\", value: product.origin_country },\n    { term: \"Type\", value: product.type?.value },\n    { term: \"Weight\", value: product.weight ? `${product.weight} g` : null },\n    {\n      term: \"Dimensions\",\n      value:\n        product.length && product.width && product.height\n          ? `${product.length}L x ${product.width}W x ${product.height}H`\n          : null,\n    },\n  ].filter((spec) => spec.value)\n\n  if (!specs.length) {\n    return (\n      <p className=\"text-small text-ink/70\">\n        Detailed specifications for this product are not published yet.\n      </p>\n    )\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <dl className=\"grid grid-cols-1 gap-x-8 gap-y-2 small:grid-cols-2\">\n      {specs.map((spec) => (\n        <div key={spec.term} className=\"flex items-baseline justify-between gap-4 border-b border-ink/10 py-1\">\n          <dt className=\"text-small text-ink/70\">{spec.term}</dt>\n          <dd className=\"font-mono text-small text-ink\">{spec.value}</dd>\n        </div>\n      ))}\n    </dl>\n  )\n}\n\nconst ShippingInfoTab = () => {\n  return (\n    <div className=\"flex flex-col gap-4 text-small text-ink/80\">\n      <p>\n        Orders ship from our print partner within two business days and arrive\n        in three to five business days.\n      </p>\n      <p>\n        If the fit is not right, send it back within 30 days and we will\n        exchange it or refund it.\n      </p>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n\nexport default ProductTabs\n"
}

{
  "path": "apps/storefront/src/modules/products/components/related-products/index.tsx",
  "instructions": "Show four related products in the design plate grid.",
  "content": "import { listProducts } from \"@lib/data/products\"\nimport { getRegion } from \"@lib/data/regions\"\nimport { HttpTypes } from \"@medusajs/types\"\nimport { Rule } from \"@modules/design-system\"\nimport Product from \"../product-preview\"\n\n/** How many related plates to show. The spec asks for at least four (C7). */\nconst RELATED_LIMIT = 4\n\ntype RelatedProductsProps = {\n  product: HttpTypes.StoreProduct\n  countryCode: string\n}\n\nexport default async function RelatedProducts({\n  product,\n  countryCode,\n}: RelatedProductsProps) {\n  const region = await getRegion(countryCode)\n\n  if (!region) {\n    return null\n  }\n\n  // Same collection first, then anything sharing a tag, never the product itself.\n  const queryParams: HttpTypes.StoreProductListParams = {}\n  if (region?.id) {\n    queryParams.region_id = region.id\n  }\n  if (product.collection_id) {\n    queryParams.collection_id = [product.collection_id]\n  }\n  if (product.tags) {\n    queryParams.tag_id = product.tags\n      .map((t) => t.id)\n      .filter(Boolean) as string[]\n  }\n  queryParams.is_giftcard = false\n\n  const products = await listProducts({\n    queryParams,\n    countryCode,\n  }).then(({ response }) => {\n    return response.products\n      .filter((responseProduct) => responseProduct.id !== product.id)\n      .slice(0, RELATED_LIMIT)\n  })\n\n  if (!products.length) {\n    return null\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <section aria-labelledby=\"related-products-heading\">\n      <div className=\"mb-6 flex flex-col gap-4\">\n        <h2\n          id=\"related-products-heading\"\n          className=\"font-display text-h2\"\n        >\n          Related products\n        </h2>\n        <Rule weight=\"heavy\" />\n      </div>\n\n      <ul className=\"grid grid-cols-2 gap-x-4 gap-y-8 small:grid-cols-3 small:gap-x-6\">\n        {products.map((related) => (\n          <li key={related.id}>\n            <Product region={region} product={related} />\n          </li>\n        ))}\n      </ul>\n    </section>\n  )\n}\n"
}

{
  "path": "/tmp/expr-product-mobile.js",
  "instructions": "Check the sticky mobile buy bar, its option sheet and the specs accordion at phone width.",
  "content": "(async () => {\n  const wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms))\n\n  const clickOption = (legend, value) => {\n    const fieldset = [...document.querySelectorAll('fieldset[data-testid=\"product-options\"]')].find(\n      (fs) => fs.querySelector(\"legend\")?.textContent.trim() === legend\n    )\n    const button = fieldset\n      ? [...fieldset.querySelectorAll(\"button\")].find((b) => b.textContent.trim() === value)\n      : null\n    button?.click()\n    return Boolean(button)\n  }\n\n  const inlineButton = () => {\n    const b = document.querySelector('[data-testid=\"add-product-button\"]')\n    const bar = b?.closest('[data-testid=\"mobile-actions\"]')\n    return b && !bar ? { text: b.textContent.trim(), disabled: b.hasAttribute(\"disabled\") } : null\n  }\n\n  const stock = () => document.querySelector('[data-testid=\"stock-state\"]')?.textContent.trim() ?? null\n\n  clickOption(\"Size\", \"XL\")\n  await wait(900)\n  const pickedSoldOut = { vId: new URLSearchParams(location.search).get(\"v_id\"), stock: stock(), inline: inlineButton() }\n\n  window.scrollTo(0, document.body.scrollHeight)\n  await wait(1500)\n\n  const bar = document.querySelector('[data-testid=\"mobile-actions\"]')\n  const barButton = document.querySelector('[data-testid=\"mobile-cart-button\"]')\n  const optionsButton = document.querySelector('[data-testid=\"mobile-actions-button\"]')\n  const barState = bar\n    ? {\n        barText: bar.innerText.replace(/\\s+/g, \" \").trim().slice(0, 120),\n        addButton: barButton ? { text: barButton.textContent.trim(), disabled: barButton.hasAttribute(\"disabled\") } : null,\n        optionsButtonText: optionsButton?.textContent.trim() ?? null,\n      }\n    : null\n\n  optionsButton?.click()\n  await wait(900)\n  const sheet = document.querySelector('[data-testid=\"mobile-actions-modal\"]')\n  const sheetState = sheet\n    ? {\n        open: true,\n        optionButtons: [...sheet.querySelectorAll(\"button\")].map((b) => b.textContent.trim()).filter((t) => t && t !== \"Close\"),\n        labels: [...sheet.querySelectorAll(\"legend\")].map((l) => l.textContent.trim()),\n      }\n    : { open: false }\n\n  document.querySelector('[data-testid=\"close-modal-button\"]')?.click()\n  await wait(600)\n\n  const tab = [...document.querySelectorAll(\"button\")].find((b) =>\n    /product information/i.test(b.textContent)\n  )\n  tab?.click()\n  await wait(700)\n\n  return {\n    url: location.href,\n    pickedSoldOut,\n    barState,\n    sheetState,\n    specs: [...document.querySelectorAll(\"dl dt\")].map((dt) => dt.textContent.trim()),\n    specValues: [...document.querySelectorAll(\"dl dd\")].map((dd) => dd.textContent.trim()),\n    docScrollWidth: document.documentElement.scrollWidth,\n    innerWidth: window.innerWidth,\n    overflow: [...document.querySelectorAll(\"body *\")]\n      .filter((el) => el.scrollWidth > el.clientWidth + 1 && el.clientWidth > 0)\n      .slice(0, 4)\n      .map((el) => el.tagName.toLowerCase() + \".\" + String(el.className).slice(0, 40)),\n  }\n})()\n"

## Acceptance criteria, verified with real data

| AC | Evidence |

| Add-to-cart disabled when unavailable | Disabled with "Select variant" before a full selection, disabled for the sold-out XL — in the inline buy box, the sticky phone bar, and the mobile option sheet |

      "use client"

      import { useRange } from "react-instantsearch"
      
      import { indexedCurrency, priceAttribute } from "@lib/search-client"
      
      function formatAmount(amount: number, currency: string) {
          try {
            return new Intl.NumberFormat(undefined, {
              style: "currency",
              currency: currency.toUpperCase(),
              maximumFractionDigits: 0,
            }).format(amount)
          } catch {
            // An unrecognised currency code shouldn't take the sidebar down.
            return `${Math.round(amount)} ${currency.toUpperCase()}`
          }
      }
      
      /**
       * Price filter over the region currency's `min_price_*` field, which is
       * declared `facetable({ types: ["stats"] })` — the stats facet is what
       * supplies the slider's bounds. Refines on release rather than per pixel.
       */
      const PriceRange = ({ currencyCode }: { currencyCode: string }) => {
        const { start, range, canRefine, refine } = useRange({
          attribute: priceAttribute("min_price", currencyCode),
        })
        const currency = indexedCurrency(currencyCode)
        const format = (amount: number) => formatAmount(amount, currency)
      
        const min = Math.floor(range.min ?? 0)
        const max = Math.ceil(range.max ?? 0)
      
        // `start` holds ±Infinity for an unset bound, so fall back to the extremes.
        const from = Number.isFinite(start[0]) ? (start[0] as number) : min
        const to = Number.isFinite(start[1]) ? (start[1] as number) : max
      
        const [value, setValue] = useState<number[]>([from, to])
      
        // Follow the refinement when it changes elsewhere — clearing all filters, or
        // a bound arriving from the URL on load.
        useEffect(() => {
          setValue([from, to])
        }, [from, to])
      
        // No stats yet, or every product costs the same: nothing to slide between.
        if (!canRefine || min >= max) {
          return null
        }
      
        return (
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-y-4">
            <span className="txt-compact-small-plus text-ui-fg-subtle">Price</span>
      
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-y-3 pr-6">
              <Slider.Root
                className="relative flex h-5 w-full touch-none select-none items-center"
                value={value}
                min={min}
                max={max}
                step={1}
                minStepsBetweenThumbs={0}
                onValueChange={setValue}
                // Only refine when the thumb is released, so dragging doesn't fire a
                // search per pixel.
                onValueCommit={(committed) => refine([committed[0], committed[1]])}
                aria-label="Price range"
                data-testid="price-range"
              >
                <Slider.Track className="relative h-0.5 w-full grow rounded-full bg-ui-border-base">
                  <Slider.Range className="absolute h-full rounded-full bg-ui-fg-interactive" />
                </Slider.Track>
                {value.map((_, index) => (
                  <Slider.Thumb
                    key={index}
                    className="block h-4 w-4 rounded-full border border-ui-border-interactive bg-ui-bg-base shadow-elevation-card-rest outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ui-fg-interactive"
                    aria-label={index === 0 ? "Minimum price" : "Maximum price"}
                  />
                ))}
              </Slider.Root>
      
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="text-small-regular text-ui-fg-subtle">
                  {format(value[0])}
                </span>
                <span className="text-small-regular text-ui-fg-subtle">
                  {format(value[1])}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )
      }
      
      export default PriceRange

      "use client"
      
      import clsx from "clsx"
      import { useRefinementList } from "react-instantsearch"
      
      type RefinementGroupProps = {
        attribute: string
        title: string
      }
      
      const RefinementGroup = ({ attribute, title }: RefinementGroupProps) => {
        const { items, refine } = useRefinementList({
          attribute,
          limit: 20,
          sortBy: ["count:desc", "name:asc"],
        })
      
        if (!items.length) {
          return null
        }
      
        return (
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-y-3">
            <span className="txt-compact-small-plus text-ui-fg-subtle">
              {title}
            </span>
            <ul className="flex flex-col gap-y-2 pr-6">
              {items.map((item) => (
                <li key={item.value}>
                  <label className="flex cursor-pointer items-start gap-x-2">
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      checked={item.isRefined}
                      onChange={() => refine(item.value)}
                      className="mt-1 shrink-0 accent-ui-fg-interactive"
                      data-testid={`refinement-${attribute}`}
                    />

                      className={clsx("text-small-regular min-w-0 break-words", {
                        "text-ui-fg-base": item.isRefined,

- path: apps/storefront/src/modules/store/components/store-refinements/current-refinements.tsx
  content: |
      "use client"
      
      import { XMarkMini } from "@medusajs/icons"
      import { useClearRefinements, useCurrentRefinements } from "react-instantsearch"
      
      import { indexedCurrency, priceAttribute } from "@lib/search-client"
      import { convertToLocale } from "@lib/util/money"
      import {
        CATEGORY_ATTRIBUTE,
        LABELS_ATTRIBUTE,
        OPTION_VALUES_ATTRIBUTE,
      } from "./attributes"
      
      type Refinement = ReturnType<
        typeof useCurrentRefinements
      >["items"][number]["refinements"][number]
      
      /**
       * What a single refinement reads as on its chip. The raw label is the facet
       * value, which is the option's `Size:M` form for options and a bare `true` for
       * the on-sale toggle — neither says what it filters on out of context.
       */
      function refinementLabel(refinement: Refinement, currencyCode: string) {
        const { attribute, label, value, operator } = refinement
      
        if (attribute === OPTION_VALUES_ATTRIBUTE) {
          const separator = String(value).indexOf(":")
      
          return separator < 1
            ? label
            : `${String(value).slice(0, separator)}: ${String(value).slice(
                separator + 1
              )}`
        }
      
        if (attribute === priceAttribute("on_sale", currencyCode)) {
          return "On sale"
        }
      
        if (attribute === priceAttribute("min_price", currencyCode)) {
          const amount = convertToLocale({
            amount: Number(value),
            currency_code: indexedCurrency(currencyCode),
            maximumFractionDigits: 0,
          })
      
          return operator === "<=" || operator === "<"
            ? `Up to ${amount}`
            : `From ${amount}`
        }
      
        if (attribute === CATEGORY_ATTRIBUTE) {
          return `Category: ${label}`
        }
      
        if (attribute === LABELS_ATTRIBUTE) {
          return `Label: ${label}`
        }
      
        return label
      }
      
      /**
       * Every active refinement as a chip that drops it, above the filters that set
       * them. The free-text query is excluded by the connector's own defaults, so
       * only what the sidebar controls shows up here.
       */
      const CurrentRefinements = ({ currencyCode }: { currencyCode: string }) => {
        const { items, refine } = useCurrentRefinements()
        const { canRefine: canClearAll, refine: clearAll } = useClearRefinements()
      
        const refinements = items.flatMap((item) => item.refinements)
      
        if (!refinements.length) {
          return null
        }
      
        return (
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-y-3" data-testid="current-refinements">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-x-2 pr-6">
              <span className="txt-compact-small-plus text-ui-fg-subtle">
                Applied filters
              </span>
              {canClearAll && (
                <button
                  onClick={clearAll}
                  className="txt-compact-small-plus text-ui-fg-interactive hover:text-ui-fg-interactive-hover"
                  data-testid="clear-refinements"
                >
                  Clear all
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
      
            <ul className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 pr-6">
              {refinements.map((refinement) => {
                const label = refinementLabel(refinement, currencyCode)
      
                return (
                  <li
                    key={`${refinement.attribute}:${refinement.operator ?? ""}:${
                      refinement.value
                    }`}
                  >
                    <button
                      onClick={() => refine(refinement)}
                      aria-label={`Remove filter ${label}`}
                      className="border-ui-border-interactive text-ui-fg-base border text-small-regular h-8 rounded-rounded px-3 flex items-center gap-x-1.5 transition-colors duration-150 hover:bg-ui-bg-base-hover"
                      data-testid="remove-refinement"
                    >
                      {label}
                      <XMarkMini className="text-ui-fg-muted" />
                    </button>
                  </li>
                )
              })}
            </ul>
          </div>
        )
      }
      
      export default CurrentRefinements
      
  referencedBy: {}
- path: apps/storefront/src/modules/store/components/store-refinements/on-sale-toggle.tsx
  content: |
      "use client"
      
      import { useToggleRefinement } from "react-instantsearch"
      
      import { priceAttribute } from "@lib/search-client"
      
      /**
       * Narrows to products whose calculated price is below their original in the
       * region's currency. Hides itself when nothing is discounted, which is the
       * case until a price list applies to some product.
       */
      const OnSaleToggle = ({ currencyCode }: { currencyCode: string }) => {
        const { value, refine, canRefine } = useToggleRefinement({
          attribute: priceAttribute("on_sale", currencyCode),
          on: true,
        })
      
        if (!canRefine) {
          return null
        }
      
        return (
          <label className="flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-x-2">
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              checked={value.isRefined}
              onChange={() => refine(value)}
              className="shrink-0 accent-ui-fg-interactive"
              data-testid="on-sale-toggle"
            />
            <span className="txt-compact-small-plus text-ui-fg-subtle">
              On sale only
            </span>
            {typeof value.count === "number" && (
              <span className="text-small-regular text-ui-fg-muted">
                ({value.count})
              </span>
            )}
          </label>
        )
      }
      
      export default OnSaleToggle

- path: apps/storefront/src/modules/store/components/store-refinements/option-refinements.tsx
  content: |
      "use client"
      
      import * as Accordion from "@radix-ui/react-accordion"
      import { ChevronDownMini } from "@medusajs/icons"
      import clsx from "clsx"
      import { useState } from "react"
      import { useRefinementList } from "react-instantsearch"
      
      import { OPTION_VALUES_ATTRIBUTE } from "./attributes"
      
      const FACET_LIMIT = 200
      
      type OptionGroup = {
        title: string
        values: {
          label: string
          value: string
          count: number
          isRefined: boolean
        }[]
      }
      
      function groupItems(
        items: ReturnType<typeof useRefinementList>["items"]
      ): OptionGroup[] {
        const groups = new Map<string, OptionGroup>()
      
        for (const item of items) {
          const separator = item.label.indexOf(":")
      
          if (separator < 1) {
            continue
          }
      
          const title = item.label.slice(0, separator)
          const label = item.label.slice(separator + 1)
      
          if (!groups.has(title)) {
            groups.set(title, { title, values: [] })
          }
      
          groups.get(title)!.values.push({
            label,
            value: item.value,
            count: item.count,
            isRefined: item.isRefined,
          })
        }
      
        return Array.from(groups.values())
      }
      
      const OptionRefinements = () => {
        const { items, refine } = useRefinementList({
          attribute: OPTION_VALUES_ATTRIBUTE,
          limit: FACET_LIMIT,
          // Alphabetical keeps a size or colour list stable as counts move around.
          sortBy: ["name:asc"],
          operator: "and",
        })
        const [closedGroups, setClosedGroups] = useState<string[]>([])
      
        const groups = groupItems(items)
      
        if (!groups.length) {
          return null
        }
      
        return (
          <Accordion.Root
            type="multiple"
            value={groups
              .map((group) => group.title)
              .filter((title) => !closedGroups.includes(title))}
            onValueChange={(openTitles) =>
              setClosedGroups(
                groups
                  .map((group) => group.title)
                  .filter((title) => !openTitles.includes(title))
              )
            }
            className="flex flex-col gap-y-3 pr-6"
          >
            {groups.map((group) => {
              const isOpen = !closedGroups.includes(group.title)
              const selectedCount = group.values.filter(
                (value) => value.isRefined
              ).length
      
              return (
                <Accordion.Item
                  key={group.title}
                  value={group.title}
                  className="overflow-hidden"
                >
                  <Accordion.Header>
                    <Accordion.Trigger className="flex w-full items-center justify-between py-3 text-left">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <span className="txt-compact-small-plus text-ui-fg-base">
                          {group.title}
                        </span>
                        <span className="txt-compact-small-plus text-ui-fg-muted">
                          ({selectedCount})
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <span
                        className={clsx(
                          "flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center text-ui-fg-muted transition-transform duration-150",
                          { "rotate-180": isOpen }
                        )}
                      >
                        <ChevronDownMini />
                      </span>
                    </Accordion.Trigger>
                  </Accordion.Header>
                  <Accordion.Content className="pb-4 pt-1">
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                      {group.values.map((value) => (
                        <button
                          key={value.value}
                          onClick={() => refine(value.value)}
                          aria-pressed={value.isRefined}
                          className={clsx(
                            "border-ui-border-base border text-small-regular h-10 rounded-rounded px-3 flex items-center gap-x-1.5 transition-colors duration-150",
                            {
                              "border-ui-border-interactive text-ui-fg-base":
                                value.isRefined,
                              "text-ui-fg-muted hover:text-ui-fg-base":
                                !value.isRefined,
                            }
                          )}
                          data-testid="option-refinement"
                        >
                          {value.label}
                          <span className="text-ui-fg-muted">({value.count})</span>
                        </button>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </Accordion.Content>
                </Accordion.Item>
              )
            })}
          </Accordion.Root>
        )
      }
      
      export default OptionRefinements
      
  referencedBy: {}
- path: apps/storefront/src/lib/util/sort-products.ts
  content: |
      import { HttpTypes } from "@medusajs/types"
      import { SortOptions } from "@modules/store/components/refinement-list/sort-products"
      
      interface MinPricedProduct extends HttpTypes.StoreProduct {
        _minPrice?: number
      }
      
      /**
       * Helper function to sort products by price until the store API supports sorting by price
       * @param products
       * @param sortBy
       * @returns products sorted by price
       */
      export function sortProducts(
        products: HttpTypes.StoreProduct[],
        sortBy: SortOptions
      ): HttpTypes.StoreProduct[] {
        const sortedProducts = products as MinPricedProduct[]
      
        if (["price_asc", "price_desc"].includes(sortBy)) {
          // Precompute the minimum price for each product
          sortedProducts.forEach((product) => {
            if (product.variants && product.variants.length > 0) {
              product._minPrice = Math.min(
                ...product.variants.map(
                  (variant) => variant?.calculated_price?.calculated_amount || 0
                )
              )
            } else {
              product._minPrice = Infinity
            }
          })
      
          // Sort products based on the precomputed minimum prices
          sortedProducts.sort((a, b) => {
            const diff = a._minPrice! - b._minPrice!
            return sortBy === "price_asc" ? diff : -diff
          })
        }
      
        if (sortBy === "created_at") {
          sortedProducts.sort((a, b) => {
            return (
              new Date(b.created_at!).getTime() - new Date(a.created_at!).getTime()
            )
          })
        }
      
        return sortedProducts
      }
      
  referencedBy: {}

  "instructions": "Compute from the Store API what each C5 test case should render.",
  "content": "// Independent expectation for each C5 case, derived from the Store API rather\n// than from the storefront's own search index.\nimport { readFileSync } from \"node:fs\"\nimport { CASES } from \"./c5-cases.mjs\"\n\nconst env = readFileSync(\"/home/miraz-rafi/dtc-starter/apps/storefront/.env.local\", \"utf8\")\n  .split(\"\\n\")\n  .reduce((a, l) => {\n    const m = l.match(/^([A-Z0-9_]+)=(.*)$/)\n    if (m) a[m[1]] = m[2].replace(/^[\"']|[\"']$/g, \"\")\n    return a\n  }, {})\n\nconst BACKEND = env.NEXT_PUBLIC_MEDUSA_BACKEND_URL\nconst KEY = env.NEXT_PUBLIC_MEDUSA_PUBLISHABLE_KEY\n\nconst api = async (path) => {\n  const res = await fetch(`${BACKEND}${path}`, { headers: { \"x-publishable-api-key\": KEY } })\n  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`${path} -> ${res.status}`)\n  return res.json()\n}\n\nconst { regions } = await api(\"/store/regions\")\nconst regionId = regions[0].id\n\nconst { products } = await api(\n  `/store/products?limit=100&region_id=${regionId}&fields=${encodeURIComponent(\n    \"id,handle,title,created_at,*variants.calculated_price\"\n  )}`\n)\n\nconst { product_categories } = await api(\n  \"/store/product-categories?limit=100&fields=id,name,handle\"\n)\nconst tshirts = product_categories.find((c) => c.handle === \"t-shirts\")\n\nconst { products: teeProducts } = await api(\n  `/store/products?limit=100&region_id=${regionId}&category_id[]=${tshirts.id}&fields=id,handle`\n)\nconst teeHandles = new Set(teeProducts.map((p) => p.handle))\n\nconst withMeta = products.map((p) => ({\n  handle: p.handle,\n  createdAt: p.created_at,\n  minPrice: Math.min(\n    ...p.variants.map((v) => v.calculated_price?.calculated_amount ?? Infinity)\n  ),\n}))\n\nconst PAGE = 12\nconst pageOf = (list) => list.slice(0, PAGE)\n\nconst expectations = {}\n\nconst byCreatedDesc = [...withMeta].sort(\n  (a, b) => new Date(b.createdAt).getTime() - new Date(a.createdAt).getTime()\n)\nconst byPriceAsc = [...withMeta].sort((a, b) => a.minPrice - b.minPrice)\nconst byPriceDesc = [...withMeta].sort((a, b) => b.minPrice - a.minPrice)\nconst inRange = (min, max) =>\n  withMeta.filter((p) => p.minPrice >= (min ?? -Infinity) && p.minPrice <= (max ?? Infinity))\n\nexpectations.T1 = pageOf(byCreatedDesc).map((p) => p.handle)\nexpectations.T2 = pageOf(byPriceAsc).map((p) => p.handle)\nexpectations.T3 = pageOf(byPriceDesc).map((p) => p.handle)\nexpectations.T4 = pageOf(inRange(40, null)).map((p) => p.handle)\nexpectations.T5 = pageOf(inRange(null, 20)).map((p) => p.handle)\nexpectations.T6 = pageOf(inRange(20, 50)).map((p) => p.handle)\nexpectations.T7 = pageOf(withMeta.filter((p) => teeHandles.has(p.handle))).map((p) => p.handle)\nexpectations.T8 = pageOf(\n  withMeta\n    .filter((p) => teeHandles.has(p.handle) && p.minPrice >= 25)\n    .sort((a, b) => b.minPrice - a.minPrice)\n).map((p) => p.handle)\nexpectations.T9 = withMeta\n  .filter((p) => teeHandles.has(p.handle))\n  .map((p) => p.handle)\n  .slice(PAGE, PAGE * 2)\n\nconst sets = {}\nfor (const [id, handles] of Object.entries(expectations)) {\n  if ([\"T1\", \"T2\", \"T3\", \"T7\"].includes(id)) continue\n  sets[id] = handles\n}\n\nconsole.log(\n  JSON.stringify(\n    {\n      cases: CASES,\n      catalogueSize: withMeta.length,\n      teeCount: teeHandles.size,\n      minMaxPrice: [Math.min(...withMeta.map((p) => p.minPrice)), Math.max(...withMeta.map((p) => p.minPrice))],\n      expectations,\n    },\n    null,\n    2\n  )\n)\n"
}

      "use client"
      
      import * as Accordion from "@radix-ui/react-accordion"
      import { useEffect, useState } from "react"
      
      import { ChevronDownMini } from "@medusajs/icons"
      import { sdk } from "@lib/config"
      import { HttpTypes } from "@medusajs/types"
      import clsx from "clsx"
      
      type OptionsPickerProps = {
        selectedValueIds: string[]
        setOptionValueIds: (valueIds: string[]) => void
      }
      
      const OptionsPicker = ({
        selectedValueIds,
        setOptionValueIds,
      }: OptionsPickerProps) => {
        const [options, setOptions] = useState<HttpTypes.StoreProductOption[]>([])
        const [openItems, setOpenItems] = useState<string[]>([])
      
        useEffect(() => {
          const fetchOptions = async () => {
            try {
              const response = await sdk.client.fetch<{
                product_options?: HttpTypes.StoreProductOption[]
              }>("/store/product-options", {
                method: "GET",
                query: {
                  is_exclusive: false,
                  fields: "*values",
                },
              })
      
              if (response?.product_options) {
                setOptions(response.product_options)
              }
            } catch (error) {
              console.error("Failed to fetch product options", error)
            }
          }
      
          fetchOptions()
        }, [])
      
        useEffect(() => {
          if (options.length) {
            setOpenItems(options.map((option) => option.id))
          }
        }, [options])
      
        if (!options.length) {
          return null
        }
      
        return (
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-y-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-1">
              <span className="txt-compact-small-plus text-ui-fg-subtle">
                Options
              </span>
            </div>
            <Accordion.Root
              type="multiple"
              value={openItems}
              onValueChange={(values) => setOpenItems(values as string[])}
              className="flex flex-col gap-y-3 pr-6"
            >
              {options.map((option) => {
                const values =
                  option.values
                    ?.map((value) => ({
                      id: value.id,
                      label: value.value,
                    }))
                    .filter(
                      (value): value is { id: string; label: string } =>
                        !!value.id && !!value.label
                    ) || []
      
                if (!values.length) {
                  return null
                }
      
                const toggleValue = (valueId: string) => {
                  const isSelected = selectedValueIds.includes(valueId)
                  const nextSelections = isSelected
                    ? selectedValueIds.filter((id) => id !== valueId)
                    : [...selectedValueIds, valueId]
      
                  setOptionValueIds(Array.from(new Set(nextSelections)))
                }
      
                const isOpen = openItems.includes(option.id)
                const selectedCount = values.filter((value) =>
                  selectedValueIds.includes(value.id)
                ).length
      
                return (
                  <Accordion.Item
                    key={option.id}
                    value={option.id}
                    className="overflow-hidden"
                  >
                    <Accordion.Header>
                      <Accordion.Trigger className="flex w-full items-center justify-between py-3 text-left">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <span className="txt-compact-small-plus text-ui-fg-base">
                            {option.title || "Option"}
                          </span>
                          <span className="txt-compact-small-plus text-ui-fg-muted">
                            ({selectedCount})
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        <span
                          className={clsx(
                            "flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center text-ui-fg-muted transition-transform duration-150",
                            {
                              "rotate-180": isOpen,
                            }
                          )}
                        >
                          <ChevronDownMini />
                        </span>
                      </Accordion.Trigger>
                    </Accordion.Header>
                    <Accordion.Content className="pb-4 pt-1">
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                        {values.map((value) => {
                          const isSelected = selectedValueIds.includes(value.id)
      
                          return (
                            <button
                              key={value.id}
                              onClick={() => toggleValue(value.id)}
                              className={clsx(
                                "border-ui-border-base border text-small-regular h-10 rounded-rounded px-3 flex items-center transition-colors duration-150",
                                {
                                  "border-ui-border-interactive text-ui-fg-base":
                                    isSelected,
                                  "text-ui-fg-muted hover:text-ui-fg-base":
                                    !isSelected,
                                }
                              )}
                              aria-pressed={isSelected}
                            >
                              {value.label}
                            </button>
                          )
                        })}
                      </div>
                    </Accordion.Content>
                  </Accordion.Item>
                )
              })}
            </Accordion.Root>
          </div>
        )
      }
      
      export default OptionsPicker
      
  referencedBy: {}

  "content": "\"use client\"\n\nimport clsx from \"clsx\"\nimport { useRefinementList } from \"react-instantsearch\"\n\ntype RefinementGroupProps = {\n  attribute: string\n  title: string\n}\n\n/**\n * A facet as a checkbox list, most common value first. Native checkboxes, so\n * the state is announced and the control is keyboard-operable for free.\n */\nconst RefinementGroup = ({ attribute, title }: RefinementGroupProps) => {\n  const { items, refine } = useRefinementList({\n    attribute,\n    limit: 20,\n    sortBy: [\"count:desc\", \"name:asc\"],\n  })\n\n  if (!items.length) {\n    return null\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <fieldset className=\"flex flex-col gap-2\">\n      <legend className=\"pb-1 text-small font-semibold text-ink\">\n        {title}\n      </legend>\n      <ul className=\"flex flex-col\">\n        {items.map((item) => (\n          <li key={item.value} className=\"border-b border-ink/10\">\n            <label className=\"flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 py-2 text-small\">\n              <input\n                type=\"checkbox\"\n                checked={item.isRefined}\n                onChange={() => refine(item.value)}\n                className=\"h-4 w-4 shrink-0 accent-riso-blue\"\n                data-testid={`refinement-${attribute}`}\n              />\n              <span\n                className={clsx(\n                  \"min-w-0 flex-1 break-words\",\n                  item.isRefined ? \"font-semibold text-ink\" : \"text-ink/80\"\n                )}\n              >\n                {item.label}\n              </span>\n              <span className=\"shrink-0 font-mono text-micro text-ink/60\">\n                {item.count}\n              </span>\n            </label>\n          </li>\n        ))}\n      </ul>\n    </fieldset>\n  )\n}\n\nexport default RefinementGroup\n"
}

  "instructions": "Put the price range slider on the design tokens.",
  "content": "\"use client\"\n\nimport * as Slider from \"@radix-ui/react-slider\"\nimport { useEffect, useState } from \"react\"\nimport { useRange } from \"react-instantsearch\"\n\nimport { indexedCurrency, priceAttribute } from \"@lib/search-client\"\n\nfunction formatAmount(amount: number, currency: string) {\n  try {\n    return new Intl.NumberFormat(undefined, {\n      style: \"currency\",\n      currency: currency.toUpperCase(),\n      maximumFractionDigits: 0,\n    }).format(amount)\n  } catch {\n    // An unrecognised currency code shouldn't take the sidebar down.\n    return `${Math.round(amount)} ${currency.toUpperCase()}`\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Price filter over the region currency's `min_price_*` field, which is\n * declared `facetable({ types: [\"stats\"] })` — the stats facet is what\n * supplies the slider's bounds. Refines on release rather than per pixel.\n *\n * Hides itself when every remaining product costs the same (or there are no\n * stats yet), because there is nothing to slide between.\n */\nconst PriceRange = ({ currencyCode }: { currencyCode: string }) => {\n  const { start, range, canRefine, refine } = useRange({\n    attribute: priceAttribute(\"min_price\", currencyCode),\n  })\n  const currency = indexedCurrency(currencyCode)\n  const format = (amount: number) => formatAmount(amount, currency)\n\n  const min = Math.floor(range.min ?? 0)\n  const max = Math.ceil(range.max ?? 0)\n\n  // `start` holds ±Infinity for an unset bound, so fall back to the extremes.\n  const from = Number.isFinite(start[0]) ? (start[0] as number) : min\n  const to = Number.isFinite(start[1]) ? (start[1] as number) : max\n\n  const [value, setValue] = useState<number[]>([from, to])\n\n  // Follow the refinement when it changes elsewhere — clearing all filters, or\n  // a bound arriving from the URL on load.\n  useEffect(() => {\n    setValue([from, to])\n  }, [from, to])\n\n  if (!canRefine || min >= max) {\n    return null\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"flex flex-col gap-2\">\n      <span className=\"text-small font-semibold text-ink\">Price</span>\n\n      <div className=\"flex flex-col gap-3 pt-2\">\n        <Slider.Root\n          className=\"relative flex h-5 w-full touch-none select-none items-center\"\n          value={value}\n          min={min}\n          max={max}\n          step={1}\n          minStepsBetweenThumbs={0}\n          onValueChange={setValue}\n          // Only refine when the thumb is released, so dragging doesn't fire a\n          // search per pixel.\n          onValueCommit={(committed) => refine([committed[0], committed[1]])}\n          aria-label=\"Price range\"\n          data-testid=\"price-range\"\n        >\n          <Slider.Track className=\"relative h-0.5 w-full grow bg-ink/20\">\n            <Slider.Range className=\"absolute h-full bg-riso-blue\" />\n          </Slider.Track>\n          {value.map((_, index) => (\n            <Slider.Thumb\n              key={index}\n              className=\"block h-4 w-4 border border-ink bg-stock outline-none\"\n              aria-label={index === 0 ? \"Minimum price\" : \"Maximum price\"}\n            />\n          ))}\n        </Slider.Root>\n\n        <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between font-mono text-micro text-ink/70\">\n          <span>{format(value[0])}</span>\n          <span>{format(value[1])}</span>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n\nexport default PriceRange\n"
}

Hides itself when nothing is discounted, which is the\n * case until a price list applies to some product.\n */\nconst OnSaleToggle = ({ currencyCode }: { currencyCode: string }) => {\n  const { value, refine, canRefine } = useToggleRefinement({\n    attribute: priceAttribute(\"on_sale\", currencyCode),\n    on: true,\n  })\n\n  if (!canRefine) {\n    return null\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <label className=\"flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 text-small\">\n      <input\n        type=\"checkbox\"\n        checked={value.isRefined}\n        onChange={() => refine(value)}\n        className=\"h-4 w-4 shrink-0 accent-riso-blue\"\n        data-testid=\"on-sale-toggle\"\n      />\n      <span className=\"font-semibold text-ink\">On sale only</span>\n      {typeof value.count === \"number\" && (\n        <span className=\"font-mono text-micro text-ink/60\">\n          {value.count}\n        </span>\n      )}\n    </label>\n  )\n}\n\nexport default OnSaleToggle\n"
}

{\n  const groups = new Map<string, OptionGroup>()\n\n  for (const item of items) {\n    const separator = item.label.indexOf(\":\")\n\n    if (separator < 1) {\n      continue\n    }\n\n    const {
  "path": "apps/storefront/src/modules/store/components/store-refinements/current-refinements.tsx",
  "instructions": "Put the applied-filter chips on the design tokens.",
  "content": "\"use client\"\n\nimport { XMarkMini } from \"@medusajs/icons\"\nimport { useClearRefinements, useCurrentRefinements } from \"react-instantsearch\"\n\nimport { indexedCurrency, priceAttribute } from \"@lib/search-client\"\nimport { convertToLocale } from \"@lib/util/money\"\nimport {\n  CATEGORY_ATTRIBUTE,\n  LABELS_ATTRIBUTE,\n  OPTION_VALUES_ATTRIBUTE,\n} from \"./attributes\"\n\ntype Refinement = ReturnType<\n  typeof useCurrentRefinements\n>[\"items\"][number][\"refinements\"][number]\n\n/**\n * What a single refinement reads as on its chip. The raw label is the facet\n * value, which is the option's `Size:M` form for options and a bare `true` for\n * the on-sale toggle — neither says what it filters on out of context.\n */\nfunction refinementLabel(refinement: Refinement, currencyCode: string) {\n  const { attribute, label, value, operator } = refinement\n\n  if (attribute === OPTION_VALUES_ATTRIBUTE) {\n    const separator = String(value).indexOf(\":\")\n\n    return separator < 1\n      ? label\n      : `${String(value).slice(0, separator)}: ${String(value).slice(\n          separator + 1\n        )}`\n  }\n\n  if (attribute === priceAttribute(\"on_sale\", currencyCode)) {\n    return \"On sale\"\n  }\n\n  if (attribute === priceAttribute(\"min_price\", currencyCode)) {\n    const amount = convertToLocale({\n      amount: Number(value),\n      currency_code: indexedCurrency(currencyCode),\n      maximumFractionDigits: 0,\n    })\n\n    return operator === \"<=\" || operator === \"<\"\n      ? `Up to ${amount}`\n      : `From ${amount}`\n  }\n\n  if (attribute === CATEGORY_ATTRIBUTE) {\n    return `Category: ${label}`\n  }\n\n  if (attribute === LABELS_ATTRIBUTE) {\n    return `Label: ${label}`\n  }\n\n  return label\n}\n\n/**\n * Every active refinement as a chip that drops it, above the filters that set\n * them. The free-text query is excluded by the connector's own defaults, so\n * only what the sidebar controls shows up here.\n */\nconst CurrentRefinements = ({ currencyCode }: { currencyCode: string }) => {\n  const { items, refine } = useCurrentRefinements()\n  const { canRefine: canClearAll, refine: clearAll } = useClearRefinements()\n\n  const refinements = items.flatMap((item) => item.refinements)\n\n  if (!refinements.length) {\n    return null\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"flex flex-col gap-2\" data-testid=\"current-refinements\">\n      <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between gap-2\">\n        <span className=\"text-small font-semibold text-ink\">\n          Applied filters\n        </span>\n        {canClearAll && (\n          <button\n            type=\"button\"\n            onClick={clearAll}\n            className=\"text-small text-riso-blue underline decoration-1 underline-offset-4 hover:text-ink\"\n            data-testid=\"clear-refinements\"\n          >\n            Clear all\n          </button>\n        )}\n      </div>\n\n      <ul className=\"flex flex-wrap gap-2\">\n        {refinements.map((refinement) => {\n          const label = refinementLabel(refinement, currencyCode)\n\n          return (\n            <li\n              key={`${refinement.attribute}:${refinement.operator ?? \"\"}:${\n                refinement.value\n              }`}\n            >\n              <button\n                type=\"button\"\n                onClick={() => refine(refinement)}\n                aria-label={`Remove filter ${label}`}\n                className=\"flex min-h-10 items-center gap-1.5 border border-ink/40 px-3 text-small text-ink transition-colors hover:border-ink\"\n                data-testid=\"remove-refinement\"\n              >\n                {label}\n                <XMarkMini className=\"text-ink/60\" />\n              </button>\n            </li>\n          )\n        })}\n      </ul>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n\nexport default CurrentRefinements\n"
}

Hmm, `small:gap-0` on the parent means no gap; the sidebar should carry its own right padding/margin.

Then the main column has `w-full min-w-0`. Visually there's no divider; adding `small:border-r small:border-ink/20` gives the "visible grid" the design wants. Let me use `small:border-r small:border-ink/20 small:pr-8` — but the parent has no padding between the border and the grid; the right column starts right after. Let me add `small:mr-8` too. Hmm, `small:gap-0` fights me; better to change the parent to `small:gap-8` and drop `small:gap-0`. The store template is one of my files from C2; editing it is fine (it's C5-relevant: the sidebar lives there).

Using `[&>*]:border-t` is fiddly. Let me give the container `flex flex-col gap-6` and rely on each control's own heading; add a `Rule`-like divider by wrapping groups:

And with `gap-6` plus divide, spacing is fine (divide adds borders between; gap adds space around them, resulting in a hairline floating between groups — nice enough).

{
  "path": "apps/storefront/src/modules/store/components/refinement-list/index.tsx",
  "instructions": "Make the category/collection sidebar a labelled filter column on the design tokens.",
  "content": "\"use client\"\n\nimport { usePathname, useRouter, useSearchParams } from \"next/navigation\"\nimport { useCallback, useMemo } from \"react\"\n\nimport {\n  OPTION_VALUE_QUERY_KEY,\n  parseOptionValueIds,\n} from \"@lib/util/product-option-filters\"\nimport OptionsPicker from \"./options-picker\"\nimport SortProducts, { SortOptions } from \"./sort-products\"\n\ntype RefinementListProps = {\n  sortBy: SortOptions\n  search?: boolean\n  hideOptionsPicker?: boolean\n  \"data-testid\"?: string\n}\n\n/*\n * Sort and option filters for a category or collection page. These pages read\n * plain query parameters (`sortBy`, `optionValueIds`, `page`) rather than the\n * search listing's InstantSearch state, because their products come from the\n * Store API directly.\n */\nconst RefinementList = ({\n  sortBy,\n  hideOptionsPicker = false,\n  \"data-testid\": dataTestId,\n}: RefinementListProps) => {\n  const router = useRouter()\n  const pathname = usePathname()\n  const searchParams = useSearchParams()\n\n  const updateQueryParams = useCallback(\n    (updater: (params: URLSearchParams) => void) => {\n      const params = new URLSearchParams(searchParams.toString())\n      updater(params)\n\n      params.delete(\"page\")\n\n      const queryString = params.toString()\n      const currentQuery = searchParams.toString()\n      const nextPath = queryString ? `${pathname}?${queryString}` : pathname\n      const currentPath = currentQuery\n        ? `${pathname}?${currentQuery}`\n        : pathname\n\n      if (nextPath !== currentPath) {\n        router.push(nextPath)\n      }\n    },\n    [pathname, router, searchParams]\n  )\n\n  const setQueryParams = (name: string, value: string) =>\n    updateQueryParams((params) => params.set(name, value))\n\n  const selectedOptionValueIds = useMemo(\n    () => parseOptionValueIds(searchParams),\n    [searchParams]\n  )\n\n  const setOptionValueIds = (valueIds: string[]) =>\n    updateQueryParams((params) => {\n      params.delete(OPTION_VALUE_QUERY_KEY)\n      valueIds.forEach((valueId) =>\n        params.append(OPTION_VALUE_QUERY_KEY, valueId)\n      )\n    })\n\n  return (\n    <aside\n      aria-label=\"Sort and filter\"\n      className=\"flex flex-col gap-6 divide-y divide-ink/20 small:w-[260px] small:shrink-0\"\n    >\n      <SortProducts\n        sortBy={sortBy}\n        setQueryParams={setQueryParams}\n        data-testid={dataTestId}\n      />\n      {!hideOptionsPicker && (\n        <div className=\"pt-6\">\n          <OptionsPicker\n            selectedValueIds={selectedOptionValueIds}\n            setOptionValueIds={setOptionValueIds}\n          />\n        </div>\n      )}\n    </aside>\n  )\n}\n\nexport default RefinementList\n"
}

```
"use client"

import FilterRadioGroup from "@modules/common/components/filter-radio-group"

export type SortOptions = "price_asc" | "price_desc" | "created_at"

type SortProductsProps = {
  sortBy: SortOptions
  setQueryParams: (name: string, value: string) => void
  "data-testid"?: string
}

const sortOptions = [
  {
    value: "created_at",
    label: "Latest Arrivals",
  },
  {
    value: "price_asc",
    label: "Price: Low -> High",
  },
  {
    value: "price_desc",
    label: "Price: High -> Low",
  },
]

const SortProducts = ({
  "data-testid": dataTestId,
  sortBy,
  setQueryParams,
}: SortProductsProps) => {
  const handleChange = (value: string) => {
    setQueryParams("sortBy", value as SortOptions)
  }

  return (
    <FilterRadioGroup
      title="Sort by"
      items={sortOptions}
      value={sortBy}
      handleChange={handleChange}
      data-testid={dataTestId}
    />
  )
}

export default SortProducts

      typecheck and build all pass for both apps from the repository root (the same commands CI runs).

Backend typecheck, lint and build pass; admin, storefront and product routes return 200.
      - [x] **C1** Homepage — hero, featured products, category links, collection section. Data comes from Medusa (`/store/products`, `/store/product-categories`, `/store/collections`). Hero takes the newest product or falls back to a yellow plate; categories and collections each have an empty state; a failed catalogue load renders an in-page error instead of a 500. Verified in the browser at 360 / 768 / 1280: no horizontal overflow, 3 collection rails of 3 plates each, all category and collection links present.
      - [x] **C2** Product listing — grid, image/title/price, loading + empty states. The listing is the starter's search-driven `/store` page, kept and restyled onto the design-system `Plate`: 12 plates per page from a 23-product catalogue, pagination through InstantSearch URL state (`?product[page]=2` → 11 plates, `aria-current` and a `nav[aria-label="Pagination"]` landmark), formatted prices per plate, skeleton plates while a query is in flight, and "No products matched these filters." for an empty result. A search backend that never answers now shows an error with a **Try again** button after 10s instead of an endless skeleton (verified by blocking `/store/search`). Verified against the production build served on the CORS-allowed origin.
      - [x] **C3** Category & collection pages — resolve by handle, 404 for unknown handle. Both routes resolve the handle through the Store API and render only the products the API reports for that id: every category and collection was compared against its API membership and matched exactly (the `everyday-basics` collection spans two pages, 14 of 14 products). Unknown handles return HTTP 404 with the storefront's own not-found page (nav, footer, display heading, links back to the catalogue). Rebuilt on the design system: display heading, breadcrumb for nested categories, child-category strip, heavy rule, plate grid matching the `/store` listing, page-param pagination with `aria-current` and a `nav[aria-label="Pagination"]` landmark, and an empty state when a filter matches nothing (verified through `?optionValueIds=` with an unknown value). Verified against the production build served on the CORS-allowed origin, at 360 / 768 / 1280.
      - [x] **C4** Product detail — gallery, variant selectors, per-variant price, stock state. Verified with real data: `hello-world-tee` (Colour × Size, 8 variants) resolves a distinct variant id per combination, and `race-condition-hoodie` size M shows `Only 5 left` with the button enabled while size XL shows `Out of stock` with the button disabled — inline, in the sticky phone bar, and in the mobile option sheet.       - [ ] **P4.3** CI runs lint, types, tests, build; E2E on main/nightly.
      - [ ] **P4.4** Production config: server + worker, migrations on deploy, Redis, S3, CORS, Stripe webhook.
      - [ ] **P4.5** Deploy storefront + backend; run production seed; smoke-test full purchase.
      - [ ] **P4.6** `docs/DEPLOYMENT.md` with steps and a rollback note.
      
      ## Phase 5 — Documentation
      
      Only when asked.
      
      - [ ] `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`
      - [ ] `docs/DECISIONS.md`
      - [ ] `docs/TESTING.md`
      - [ ] `README.human.md`
      
      ---
      
      ## Beyond-spec work already done
      
      - **Design foundation (P1.1).** Not in the spec's roadmap; requested directly. Fonts, theme tokens, base
        components and an internal `/{country}/design` preview page. See `docs/DESIGN.md`.
      
      ## Standing notes
      
      - **Two URL vocabularies, by design:** `/store` is search-driven and keeps InstantSearch's names —
        `product[sortBy]`, `product[refinementList][category][0]`, `product[range][min_price_euro]`, `product[page]`.
        C5 accepts these as "reflected in URL query params": they round-trip (loaded URLs reproduce the exact result
        set) and are shareable. The category and collection pages, which read the Store API directly, use plain
        `sortBy`, `optionValueIds` and `page`. Unifying them would mean giving up InstantSearch's routing on `/store`;
        not worth it unless a requirement says so.
      - **Price ties can swap the last card on a page:** sorting by price puts the catalogue's €38 products in an
        arbitrary order among themselves, so page 1 of "Price: High -> Low" can show either `cache-miss-shorts` or
        `weekend-debug-shorts` in slot 12. The set is correct either way; it is a limit of comparing equal values, not
        of the sort.
      - **The price slider hides itself when the results share one price:** filtering to a category whose products all
        cost the same removes the range control, because there is no spread to slide between. Expected, and it is why
        a price test must run against the unfiltered catalogue.
      - **Search:** the spec names Meilisearch; the starter ships Medusa's built-in search API plus an
        InstantSearch adapter. Per spec §2 the starter's choice is authoritative, so Meilisearch is dropped.
        Meilisearch stays in `docker-compose.yml` behind a profile but is not wired to anything.
      - **Stripe provider:** `@medusajs/payment-stripe` is not yet a direct backend dependency and
        `medusa-config.ts` registers no payment module. K4 needs both; that is a dependency change and will be
        raised for approval before it is made.
      - **Known pre-existing lint debt:** none outstanding — the errors in `src/lib/data/cart.ts` and
        `src/modules/layout/components/language-select/index.tsx` were fixed as part of P0.6 so CI can be green.
      - **Seed replaces starter data:** `src/scripts/seed.ts` deletes the starter's four placeholder
        products and their empty categories. `src/migration-scripts/initial-data-seed.ts` is no longer part
        of the setup path; `src/scripts/seed-demo-products.ts` remains as an optional bulk filler.
      - **Turbo caches nothing for `seed`:** `turbo.json` sets `"cache": false` for the task, so a repeat
        `pnpm run backend:seed` actually runs the script instead of replaying cached output.
      - **Product images:** the public Medusa demo bucket only holds 11 product shots, so the catalogue
        reuses them. Real photography is a later task.
      - **Never run `next build` while `next dev` is running:** both write `apps/storefront/.next`, and a build wipes
        the dev server's turbopack runtime chunks, which then serves `500` until `.next` is removed and the dev server
        restarted. This happened during C1 verification; the dev server on port 8000 was killed, `.next` deleted and the
        server restarted. Stop the dev server before `pnpm build`.
      - **`notFound()` must not run inside `generateMetadata`:** doing so renders the root `app/not-found.tsx`
        instead of the route group's own not-found page. C3 hit this on unknown category and collection handles: the
        metadata helpers now return plain fallback metadata and the page component raises `notFound()`, which keeps the
        404 inside the storefront layout. Watch for the same pattern in any later route that resolves a handle.
      - **Every variant of a product costs the same:** the seeded catalogue has no size-based or colour-based pricing, so
        C4's "correct price per variant" is only provable as a mechanism (each option combination resolves its own variant
        and reads that variant's calculated price), not as visibly different amounts. The same data has no variant on a
        sale price, so the sale branch of the price display is unexercised too. Adding one product with per-size prices
        (and one promotional price list) to the seed would make both visible; K6 needs the latter anyway.
      - **Spec table has no SKU:** `docs/DESIGN.md` shows a SKU in the product spec table, but the tabs receive the
        product, not the selected variant, and SKUs are per variant. Left out rather than printed from the wrong variant;
        it needs the selected variant passed down when something asks for it.
      - **Nested categories are unexercised:** the seeded catalogue is five flat categories, so the C3 breadcrumb and
        child-category strip cannot be seen at runtime. They render only when a category has a parent or children;
        re-check them if the catalogue ever gains a hierarchy.
      - **Load-state pass still open (Phase 1 final item):** the homepage and the listing have empty, loading and error
        states, but there is no route-level `loading.tsx` anywhere and product/category/collection pages have not been
        swept yet. That sweep is the Phase 1 "responsive + loading/empty/error state pass" line, not a C1/C2 gap.
      - **Typo tolerance (C6):** `POST /store/search` returns no hits for a misspelled query such as
        `hoddie` even though the index declares `typo_tolerance: { enabled: true }`. To look at during C6.

- path: apps/storefront/src/lib/data/cart.ts
  content: |
      "use server"
      
      import { sdk } from "@lib/config"
      import medusaError from "@lib/util/medusa-error"
      import { HttpTypes } from "@medusajs/types"
      import { revalidateTag } from "next/cache"
      import { redirect } from "next/navigation"
      import {
        getAuthHeaders,
        getCacheOptions,
        getCacheTag,
        getCartId,
        removeCartId,
        setCartId,
      } from "./cookies"
      import { getRegion } from "./regions"
      import { getLocale } from "./locale-actions"
      
      /**
       * Retrieves a cart by its ID. If no ID is provided, it will use the cart ID from the cookies.
       * @param cartId - optional - The ID of the cart to retrieve.
       * @returns The cart object if found, or null if not found.
       */
      export async function retrieveCart(cartId?: string, fields?: string) {
        const id = cartId || (await getCartId())
        fields ??=
          "*items, *region, *items.product, *items.variant, *items.thumbnail, *items.metadata, +items.total, *promotions, +shipping_methods.name"
      
        if (!id) {
          return null
        }
      
        const headers = {
          ...(await getAuthHeaders()),
        }
      
        const next = {
          ...(await getCacheOptions("carts")),
        }
      
        return await sdk.client
          .fetch<HttpTypes.StoreCartResponse>(`/store/carts/${id}`, {
            method: "GET",
            query: {
              fields,
            },
            headers,
            next,
            cache: "force-cache",
          })
          .then(({ cart }: { cart: HttpTypes.StoreCart }) => cart)
          .catch(() => null)
      }
      
      export async function getOrSetCart(countryCode: string) {
        const region = await getRegion(countryCode)
      
        if (!region) {
          throw new Error(`Region not found for country code: ${countryCode}`)
        }
      
        let cart = await retrieveCart(undefined, "id,region_id")
      
        const headers = {
          ...(await getAuthHeaders()),
        }
      
        if (!cart) {
          const locale = await getLocale()
          const cartResp = await sdk.store.cart.create(
            { region_id: region.id, locale: locale || undefined },
            {},
            headers
          )
          cart = cartResp.cart
      
          await setCartId(cart.id)
      
          const cartCacheTag = await getCacheTag("carts")
          revalidateTag(cartCacheTag)
        }
      
        if (cart && cart?.region_id !== region.id) {
          await sdk.store.cart.update(cart.id, { region_id: region.id }, {}, headers)
          const cartCacheTag = await getCacheTag("carts")
          revalidateTag(cartCacheTag)
        }
      
        return cart
      }
      
      export async function updateCart(data: HttpTypes.StoreUpdateCart) {
        const cartId = await getCartId()
      
        if (!cartId) {
          throw new Error("No existing cart found, please create one before updating")
        }
      
        const headers = {
          ...(await getAuthHeaders()),
        }
      
        return sdk.store.cart
          .update(cartId, data, {}, headers)
          .then(async ({ cart }: { cart: HttpTypes.StoreCart }) => {
            const cartCacheTag = await getCacheTag("carts")
            revalidateTag(cartCacheTag)
      
            const fulfillmentCacheTag = await getCacheTag("fulfillment")
            revalidateTag(fulfillmentCacheTag)
      
            return cart
          })
          .catch(medusaError)
      }
      
      export async function addToCart({
        variantId,
        quantity,
        countryCode,
      }: {
        variantId: string
        quantity: number
        countryCode: string
      }) {
        if (!variantId) {
          throw new Error("Missing variant ID when adding to cart")
        }
      
        const cart = await getOrSetCart(countryCode)
      
        if (!cart) {
          throw new Error("Error retrieving or creating cart")
        }
      
        const headers = {
          ...(await getAuthHeaders()),
        }
      
        await sdk.store.cart
          .createLineItem(
            cart.id,
            {
              variant_id: variantId,
              quantity,
            },
            {},
            headers
          )
          .then(async () => {
            const cartCacheTag = await getCacheTag("carts")
            revalidateTag(cartCacheTag)
      
            const fulfillmentCacheTag = await getCacheTag("fulfillment")
            revalidateTag(fulfillmentCacheTag)
          })
          .catch(medusaError)
      }
      
      export async function updateLineItem({
        lineId,
        quantity,
      }: {
        lineId: string
        quantity: number
      }) {
        if (!lineId) {
          throw new Error("Missing lineItem ID when updating line item")
        }
      
        const cartId = await getCartId()
      
        if (!cartId) {
          throw new Error("Missing cart ID when updating line item")
        }
      
        const headers = {
          ...(await getAuthHeaders()),
        }
      
        await sdk.store.cart
          .updateLineItem(cartId, lineId, { quantity }, {}, headers)
          .then(async () => {
            const cartCacheTag = await getCacheTag("carts")
            revalidateTag(cartCacheTag)
      
            const fulfillmentCacheTag = await getCacheTag("fulfillment")
            revalidateTag(fulfillmentCacheTag)
          })
          .catch(medusaError)
      }
      
      export async function deleteLineItem(lineId: string) {
        if (!lineId) {
          throw new Error("Missing lineItem ID when deleting line item")
        }
      
        const cartId = await getCartId()
      
        if (!cartId) {
          throw new Error("Missing cart ID when deleting line item")
        }
      
        const headers = {
          ...(await getAuthHeaders()),
        }
      
        await sdk.store.cart
          .deleteLineItem(cartId, lineId, {}, headers)
          .then(async () => {
            const cartCacheTag = await getCacheTag("carts")
            revalidateTag(cartCacheTag)
      
            const fulfillmentCacheTag = await getCacheTag("fulfillment")
            revalidateTag(fulfillmentCacheTag)
          })
          .catch(medusaError)
      }
      
      export async function setShippingMethod({
        cartId,
        shippingMethodId,
      }: {
        cartId: string
        shippingMethodId: string
      }) {
        const headers = {
          ...(await getAuthHeaders()),
        }
      
        return sdk.store.cart
          .addShippingMethod(cartId, { option_id: shippingMethodId }, {}, headers)
          .then(async () => {
            const cartCacheTag = await getCacheTag("carts")
            revalidateTag(cartCacheTag)
          })
          .catch(medusaError)
      }
      
      export async function initiatePaymentSession(
        cart: HttpTypes.StoreCart,
        data: HttpTypes.StoreInitializePaymentSession
      ) {
        const headers = {
          ...(await getAuthHeaders()),
        }
      
        return sdk.store.payment
          .initiatePaymentSession(cart, data, {}, headers)
          .then(async (resp) => {
            const cartCacheTag = await getCacheTag("carts")
            revalidateTag(cartCacheTag)
            return resp
          })
          .catch(medusaError)
      }
      
      export async function applyPromotions(codes: string[]) {
        const cartId = await getCartId()
      
        if (!cartId) {
          throw new Error("No existing cart found")
        }
      
        const headers = {
          ...(await getAuthHeaders()),
        }
      
        return sdk.store.cart
          .update(cartId, { promo_codes: codes }, {}, headers)
          .then(async () => {
            const cartCacheTag = await getCacheTag("carts")
            revalidateTag(cartCacheTag)
      
            const fulfillmentCacheTag = await getCacheTag("fulfillment")
            revalidateTag(fulfillmentCacheTag)
          })
          .catch(medusaError)
      }
      
      export async function submitPromotionForm(
        currentState: unknown,
        formData: FormData
      ) {
        const code = formData.get("code") as string
        try {
          await applyPromotions([code])
        } catch (error) {
          return error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)
        }
      }
      
      // TODO: Pass a POJO instead of a form entity here
      export async function setAddresses(currentState: unknown, formData: FormData) {
        try {
          if (!formData) {
            throw new Error("No form data found when setting addresses")
          }
          const cartId = getCartId()
          if (!cartId) {
            throw new Error("No existing cart found when setting addresses")
          }
      
          // FormData values are `string | File | null`; the cart API takes text only.
          const text = (name: string) => String(formData.get(name) ?? "")
      
          const addressFromForm = (prefix: "shipping_address" | "billing_address") => ({
            first_name: text(`${prefix}.first_name`),
            last_name: text(`${prefix}.last_name`),
            address_1: text(`${prefix}.address_1`),
            address_2: "",
            company: text(`${prefix}.company`),
            postal_code: text(`${prefix}.postal_code`),
            city: text(`${prefix}.city`),
            country_code: text(`${prefix}.country_code`),
            province: text(`${prefix}.province`),
            phone: text(`${prefix}.phone`),
          })
      
          const data: HttpTypes.StoreUpdateCart = {
            shipping_address: addressFromForm("shipping_address"),
            email: text("email"),
          }
      
          const sameAsBilling = formData.get("same_as_billing")
      
          data.billing_address =
            sameAsBilling === "on"
              ? data.shipping_address
              : addressFromForm("billing_address")
      
          await updateCart(data)
        } catch (error) {
          return error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)
        }
      
        redirect(
          `/${formData.get("shipping_address.country_code")}/checkout?step=delivery`
        )
      }
      
      /**
       * Places an order for a cart. If no cart ID is provided, it will use the cart ID from the cookies.
       * @param cartId - optional - The ID of the cart to place an order for.
       * @returns The cart object if the order was successful, or null if not.
       */
      export async function placeOrder(cartId?: string) {
        const id = cartId || (await getCartId())
      
        if (!id) {
          throw new Error("No existing cart found when placing an order")
        }
      
        const headers = {
          ...(await getAuthHeaders()),
        }
      
        const cartRes = await sdk.store.cart
          .complete(id, {}, headers)
          .then(async (cartRes) => {
            const cartCacheTag = await getCacheTag("carts")
            revalidateTag(cartCacheTag)
            return cartRes
          })
          .catch(medusaError)
      
        if (cartRes?.type === "order") {
          const countryCode =
            cartRes.order.shipping_address?.country_code?.toLowerCase()
      
          const orderCacheTag = await getCacheTag("orders")
          revalidateTag(orderCacheTag)
      
          removeCartId()
          redirect(`/${countryCode}/order/${cartRes?.order.id}/confirmed`)
        }
      
        return cartRes.cart
      }
      
      /**
       * Updates the countrycode param and revalidates the regions cache
       * @param regionId
       * @param countryCode
       */
      export async function updateRegion(countryCode: string, currentPath: string) {
        const cartId = await getCartId()
        const region = await getRegion(countryCode)
      
        if (!region) {
          throw new Error(`Region not found for country code: ${countryCode}`)
        }
      
        if (cartId) {
          await updateCart({ region_id: region.id })
          const cartCacheTag = await getCacheTag("carts")
          revalidateTag(cartCacheTag)
        }
      
        const regionCacheTag = await getCacheTag("regions")
        revalidateTag(regionCacheTag)
      
        const productsCacheTag = await getCacheTag("products")
        revalidateTag(productsCacheTag)
      
        redirect(`/${countryCode}${currentPath}`)
      }
      
      export async function listCartOptions() {
        const cartId = await getCartId()
        const headers = {
          ...(await getAuthHeaders()),
        }
        const next = {
          ...(await getCacheOptions("shippingOptions")),
        }
      
        return await sdk.client.fetch<{
          shipping_options: HttpTypes.StoreCartShippingOption[]
        }>("/store/shipping-options", {
          query: { cart_id: cartId },
          next,
          headers,
          cache: "force-cache",
        })
      }

      | ID | Pri | Feature | Acceptance criteria |
      |----|-----|---------|---------------------|
      | C1 | 🟢 | Homepage | Hero section, featured products, category links, collection section; data from Medusa (or CMS if the starter has one); responsive |
      | C2 | 🟢 | Product listing | Grid with pagination or infinite scroll; shows image, title, price; empty + loading states |
      | C3 | 🟢 | Category & collection pages | Routes resolve by handle; show only matching products; 404 for unknown handle |
      | C4 | 🟢 | Product detail | Image gallery, variant selectors (options → variant), correct price per variant, stock state (in stock / out of stock), add-to-cart disabled when unavailable |
      | C5 | 🟢 | Sort & filter | Sort by newest / price asc / price desc; filter by category and price range; state reflected in URL query params |
      | C6 | 🟡 | Search | Meilisearch index of products; typo-tolerant instant results; reindex on product create/update/delete via subscribers |
      | C7 | 🟡 | Related products | Product page shows ≥4 related items (same category/collection), excluding current |
      | C8 | 🔵 | Reviews & ratings | See §5.5 |
      
      ### 5.2 Cart & Checkout
      
      | ID | Pri | Feature | Acceptance criteria |
      |----|-----|---------|---------------------|
      | K1 | 🟢 | Cart | Add, remove, change quantity; persists across reload (cart ID cookie); totals update correctly; handles out-of-stock errors gracefully |
      | K2 | 🟢 | Checkout steps | Email → shipping address → shipping method → payment → review; validation on every step; can go back without data loss |
      | K3 | 🟢 | Guest + logged-in checkout | Both flows complete; logged-in users get saved address prefill |
      | K4 | 🟢 | Stripe payment | PaymentIntent via Medusa payment session; Stripe Elements UI; success creates order; declined card shows a clear error and leaves cart intact |
      | K5 | 🟢 | Order confirmation | Page shows order number, items, totals, address; accessible right after checkout |
      | K6 | 🟡 | Promo codes | Apply/remove code in cart/checkout; totals reflect discount; invalid code shows error |
      | K7 | 🟡 | Stripe webhook | Webhook endpoint verified; handles late/missed completion safely (idempotent) |
      | K8 | 🔵 | Multi-region / multi-currency | Region switch changes currency and prices |
      
      ### 5.3 Customer Account
      
      | ID | Pri | Feature | Acceptance criteria |
      |----|-----|---------|---------------------|
      | A1 | 🟢 | Register / login / logout | Works with Medusa auth; errors shown for bad credentials/duplicate email; protected routes redirect to login |
      | A2 | 🟢 | Order history | List + detail page for the logged-in customer only |
      | A3 | 🟡 | Saved addresses | Add, edit, delete, set default |
      | A4 | 🟡 | Profile & password reset | Edit name/phone; reset-password email flow end-to-end |
      | A5 | 🔵 | Wishlist | See §5.5 |
      
      ### 5.4 Email (🟡 Phase 2)
      
      | ID | Feature | AC |
      |----|---------|----|
      | E1 | Order confirmation email | Subscriber on `order.placed` sends email via Resend with order summary; failure is logged and does NOT break order creation |
      | E2 | Password reset email | Link works and expires |
      | E3 | Shipment notification | Sent when a fulfillment is created/shipped |
      
      Emails: HTML + plain-text fallback; simple, consistent template; templates stored in `backend/src/modules/<notification>/templates/`.
