      "use server"
      
      import { sdk } from "@lib/config"
      import { HttpTypes } from "@medusajs/types"
      import { getAuthHeaders, getCacheOptions } from "./cookies"
      
      export const listCartShippingMethods = async (cartId: string) => {
        const headers = {
          ...(await getAuthHeaders()),
        }
      
        const next = {
          ...(await getCacheOptions("fulfillment")),
        }
      
        return sdk.client
          .fetch<HttpTypes.StoreShippingOptionListResponse>(
            `/store/shipping-options`,
            {
              method: "GET",
              query: {
                cart_id: cartId,
              },
              headers,
              next,
              cache: "force-cache",
            }
          )
          .then(({ shipping_options }) => shipping_options)
          .catch(() => {
            return null
          })
      }
      
      export const calculatePriceForShippingOption = async (
        optionId: string,
        cartId: string,
        data?: Record<string, unknown>
      ) => {
        const headers = {
          ...(await getAuthHeaders()),
        }
      
        const next = {
          ...(await getCacheOptions("fulfillment")),
        }
      
        const body = { cart_id: cartId, data }
      
        if (data) {
          body.data = data
        }
      
        return sdk.client
          .fetch<{ shipping_option: HttpTypes.StoreCartShippingOption }>(
            `/store/shipping-options/${optionId}/calculate`,
            {
              method: "POST",
              body,
              headers,
              next,
            }
          )
          .then(({ shipping_option }) => shipping_option)
          .catch((_e) => {
            return null
          })
      }

      "use server"
      
      import { sdk } from "@lib/config"
      import { getAuthHeaders, getCacheOptions } from "./cookies"
      import { HttpTypes } from "@medusajs/types"
      
      export const listCartPaymentMethods = async (regionId: string) => {
        const headers = {
          ...(await getAuthHeaders()),
        }
      
        const next = {
          ...(await getCacheOptions("payment_providers")),
        }
      
        return sdk.client
          .fetch<HttpTypes.StorePaymentProviderListResponse>(
            `/store/payment-providers`,
            {
              method: "GET",
              query: { region_id: regionId },
              headers,
              next,
              cache: "force-cache",
            }
          )
          .then(({ payment_providers }) =>
            payment_providers.sort((a, b) => {
              return a.id > b.id ? 1 : -1
            })
          )
          .catch(() => {
            return null
          })
      }

          title: "PayPal",
          icon: <PayPal />,
        },
        pp_system_default: {
          title: "Manual Payment",
          icon: <CreditCard />,
        },
        // Add more payment providers here
      }
      
      // This only checks if it is native stripe or medusa payments for card payments, it ignores the other stripe-based providers
      export const isStripeLike = (providerId?: string) => {
        return (
          providerId?.startsWith("pp_stripe_") || providerId?.startsWith("pp_medusa-")
        )
      }
      
      export const isPaypal = (providerId?: string) => {
        return providerId?.startsWith("pp_paypal")
      }
      export const isManual = (providerId?: string) => {
        return providerId?.startsWith("pp_system_default")

  content: |
      import { Radio as RadioGroupOption } from "@headlessui/react"
      import { Text, clx } from "@modules/common/components/ui"
      import React, { useContext, type JSX } from "react"
      
      import Radio from "@modules/common/components/radio"
      
      import { isManual } from "@lib/constants"
      import SkeletonCardDetails from "@modules/skeletons/components/skeleton-card-details"
      import { PaymentElement } from "@stripe/react-stripe-js"
      import PaymentTest from "../payment-test"
      import { StripeContext } from "../payment-wrapper/stripe-wrapper"
      
      type PaymentContainerProps = {
        paymentProviderId: string
        selectedPaymentOptionId: string | null
        disabled?: boolean
        paymentInfoMap: Record<string, { title: string; icon: JSX.Element }>
        children?: React.ReactNode
      }
      
      const PaymentContainer: React.FC<PaymentContainerProps> = ({
        paymentProviderId,
        selectedPaymentOptionId,
        paymentInfoMap,
        disabled = false,
        children,
      }) => {
        const isDevelopment = process.env.NODE_ENV === "development"
      
        return (
          <RadioGroupOption
            key={paymentProviderId}
            value={paymentProviderId}
            disabled={disabled}
            className={clx(
              "flex flex-col gap-y-2 text-small-regular cursor-pointer py-4 border rounded-rounded px-8 mb-2 hover:shadow-borders-interactive-with-active",
              {
                "border-ui-border-interactive":
                  selectedPaymentOptionId === paymentProviderId,
              }
            )}
          >
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between ">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-x-4">
                <Radio checked={selectedPaymentOptionId === paymentProviderId} />
                <Text className="text-base-regular">
                  {paymentInfoMap[paymentProviderId]?.title || paymentProviderId}
                </Text>
                {isManual(paymentProviderId) && isDevelopment && (
                  <PaymentTest className="hidden small:block" />
                )}
              </div>
              <span className="justify-self-end text-ui-fg-base">
                {paymentInfoMap[paymentProviderId]?.icon}
              </span>
            </div>
            {isManual(paymentProviderId) && isDevelopment && (
              <PaymentTest className="small:hidden text-[10px]" />
            )}
            {children}
          </RadioGroupOption>
        )
      }
      
      export default PaymentContainer
      
      export const StripePaymentContainer = ({
        paymentProviderId,
        selectedPaymentOptionId,
        paymentInfoMap,
        disabled = false,
        setError,
        setPaymentComplete,
      }: Omit<PaymentContainerProps, "children"> & {
        setError: (error: string | null) => void
        setPaymentComplete: (complete: boolean) => void
      }) => {
        const stripeReady = useContext(StripeContext)
      
        return (
          <PaymentContainer
            paymentProviderId={paymentProviderId}
            selectedPaymentOptionId={selectedPaymentOptionId}
            paymentInfoMap={paymentInfoMap}
            disabled={disabled}
          >
            {selectedPaymentOptionId === paymentProviderId &&
              (stripeReady ? (
                <div className="my-4 transition-all duration-150 ease-in-out">
                  <Text className="txt-medium-plus text-ui-fg-base mb-1">
                    Enter your payment details:
                  </Text>
                  <PaymentElement
                    options={{ layout: "accordion" }}
                    onChange={(e) => {
                      setError(null)
                      setPaymentComplete(e.complete)
                    }}
                    // Without a handler Stripe.js reports a failed mount as an
                    // unhandled "payment Element loaderror" and the option renders
                    // blank with no explanation. Surface it in the checkout's own
                    // error slot instead.
                    onLoadError={(e) => {
                      setPaymentComplete(false)
                      setError(
                        e.error?.message ?? "Could not load the payment methods."
                      )
                    }}
                  />
                </div>
              ) : (
                <SkeletonCardDetails />
              ))}
          </PaymentContainer>
        )
      }
      
  referencedBy: {}

  content: |
      "use client"
      
      import { loadStripe } from "@stripe/stripe-js"
      import React from "react"
      import StripeWrapper from "./stripe-wrapper"
      import { HttpTypes } from "@medusajs/types"
      import { isStripeLike } from "@lib/constants"
      
      type PaymentWrapperProps = {
        cart: HttpTypes.StoreCart
        children: React.ReactNode
      }
      
      const stripeKey =
        process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_KEY ||
        process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_MEDUSA_PAYMENTS_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
      
      const medusaAccountId = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_MEDUSA_PAYMENTS_ACCOUNT_ID
      const stripePromise = stripeKey
        ? loadStripe(
            stripeKey,
            medusaAccountId ? { stripeAccount: medusaAccountId } : undefined
          )
        : null
      
      const PaymentWrapper: React.FC<PaymentWrapperProps> = ({ cart, children }) => {
        const paymentSession = cart.payment_collection?.payment_sessions?.find(
          (s) => s.status === "pending"
        )
      
        if (
          isStripeLike(paymentSession?.provider_id) &&
          paymentSession &&
          stripePromise
        ) {
          return (
            <StripeWrapper
              paymentSession={paymentSession}
              stripeKey={stripeKey}
              stripePromise={stripePromise}
            >
              {children}
            </StripeWrapper>
          )
        }
      
        return <div>{children}</div>
      }
      
      export default PaymentWrapper
      
  referencedBy: {}
- path: apps/storefront/src/modules/checkout/components/payment-wrapper/stripe-wrapper.tsx
  content: |
      "use client"
      
      import { Stripe, StripeElementsOptions } from "@stripe/stripe-js"
      import { Elements } from "@stripe/react-stripe-js"
      import { HttpTypes } from "@medusajs/types"
      import { createContext } from "react"
      
      type StripeWrapperProps = {
        paymentSession: HttpTypes.StorePaymentSession
        stripeKey?: string
        stripePromise: Promise<Stripe | null> | null
        children: React.ReactNode
      }
      
      export const StripeContext = createContext(false)
      
      const StripeWrapper: React.FC<StripeWrapperProps> = ({
        paymentSession,
        stripeKey,
        stripePromise,
        children,
      }) => {
        const options: StripeElementsOptions = {
          clientSecret: paymentSession!.data?.client_secret as string | undefined,
        }
      
        if (!stripeKey) {
          throw new Error(
            "Stripe key is missing. Set NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_KEY environment variable."
          )
        }
      
        if (!stripePromise) {
          throw new Error(
            "Stripe promise is missing. Make sure you have provided a valid Stripe key."
          )
        }
      
        if (!paymentSession?.data?.client_secret) {
          throw new Error(
            "Stripe client secret is missing. Cannot initialize Stripe."
          )
        }
      
        return (
          <StripeContext.Provider value={true}>
            <Elements options={options} stripe={stripePromise}>
              {children}
            </Elements>
          </StripeContext.Provider>
        )
      }
      
      export default StripeWrapper
      
  referencedBy: {}

      const ErrorMessage = ({
        error,
        "data-testid": dataTestid,
      }: {
        error?: string | null
        "data-testid"?: string
      }) => {
        if (!error) {
          return null
        }
      
        /*
         * Ink words behind a riso-pink rule. Pink is a marker here, not text: at this
         * size it fails AA as a foreground (docs/DESIGN.md §2.1), and it still reads
         * as "something is wrong" without shouting in red.
         */
        return (
          <p
            role="alert"
            className="border-l-2 border-riso-pink pl-3 text-small text-ink"
            data-testid={dataTestid}
          >
            {error}
          </p>
        )
      }
      
      export default ErrorMessage

          "billing_address.last_name": cart?.billing_address?.last_name || "",

          "billing_address.country_code": cart?.billing_address?.country_code || "",
          "billing_address.province": cart?.billing_address?.province || "",
          "billing_address.phone": cart?.billing_address?.phone || "",
        })
      
        const handleChange = (
          e: React.ChangeEvent<
            HTMLInputElement | HTMLInputElement | HTMLSelectElement
          >
        ) => {
          setFormData({

            [e.target.name]: e.target.value,

        return (

                data-testid="billing-first-name-input"

              <Input
                label="Last name"

                onChange={handleChange}
                required

              />
              <Input
                label="Address"
                name="billing_address.address_1"
                autoComplete="address-line1"
                value={formData["billing_address.address_1"]}
                onChange={handleChange}
                required
                data-testid="billing-address-input"
              />
              <Input
                label="Company"
                name="billing_address.company"
                value={formData["billing_address.company"]}
                onChange={handleChange}
                autoComplete="organization"
                data-testid="billing-company-input"
              />
              <Input
                label="Postal code"
                name="billing_address.postal_code"
                autoComplete="postal-code"
                value={formData["billing_address.postal_code"]}
                onChange={handleChange}
                required
                data-testid="billing-postal-input"
              />
              <Input

              />
              <CountrySelect

              <Input

              <Input

              />

          </>

      }
      
      export default BillingAddress

- path: apps/storefront/src/modules/checkout/components/address-select/index.tsx
  content: |
      import { Listbox, Transition } from "@headlessui/react"
      import { ChevronUpDown } from "@medusajs/icons"
      import { clx } from "@modules/common/components/ui"
      import { Fragment, useMemo } from "react"
      
      import compareAddresses from "@lib/util/compare-addresses"
      import { HttpTypes } from "@medusajs/types"
      import Radio from "@modules/common/components/radio"
      
      type AddressSelectProps = {
        addresses: HttpTypes.StoreCustomerAddress[]
        addressInput: HttpTypes.StoreCartAddress | null
        onSelect: (
          address: HttpTypes.StoreCartAddress | undefined,
          email?: string
        ) => void
      }
      
      const AddressSelect = ({
        addresses,
        addressInput,
        onSelect,
      }: AddressSelectProps) => {
        const handleSelect = (id: string) => {
          const savedAddress = addresses.find((a) => a.id === id)
          if (savedAddress) {
            onSelect(savedAddress as HttpTypes.StoreCartAddress)
          }
        }
      
        const selectedAddress = useMemo(() => {
          return addresses.find((a) => addressInput && compareAddresses(a, addressInput))
        }, [addresses, addressInput])
      
        return (
          <Listbox onChange={handleSelect} value={selectedAddress?.id}>
            <div className="relative">
              <Listbox.Button
                className="relative w-full flex justify-between items-center px-4 py-[10px] text-left bg-white cursor-default focus:outline-none border rounded-rounded focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-opacity-75 focus-visible:ring-white focus-visible:ring-offset-gray-300 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:border-gray-300 text-base-regular"
                data-testid="shipping-address-select"
              >
                {({ open }) => (
                  <>
                    <span className="block truncate">
                      {selectedAddress
                        ? selectedAddress.address_1
                        : "Choose an address"}
                    </span>
                    <ChevronUpDown
                      className={clx("transition-rotate duration-200", {
                        "transform rotate-180": open,
                      })}
                    />
                  </>
                )}
              </Listbox.Button>
              <Transition
                as={Fragment}
                leave="transition ease-in duration-100"
                leaveFrom="opacity-100"
                leaveTo="opacity-0"
              >
                <Listbox.Options
                  className="absolute z-20 w-full overflow-auto text-small-regular bg-white border border-top-0 max-h-60 focus:outline-none sm:text-sm"
                  data-testid="shipping-address-options"
                >
                  {addresses.map((address) => {
                    return (
                      <Listbox.Option
                        key={address.id}
                        value={address.id}
                        className="cursor-default select-none relative pl-6 pr-10 hover:bg-gray-50 py-4"
                        data-testid="shipping-address-option"
                      >
                        <div className="flex gap-x-4 items-start">
                          <Radio
                            checked={selectedAddress?.id === address.id}
                            data-testid="shipping-address-radio"
                          />
                          <div className="flex flex-col">
                            <span className="text-left text-base-semi">
                              {address.first_name} {address.last_name}
                            </span>
                            {address.company && (
                              <span className="text-small-regular text-ui-fg-base">
                                {address.company}
                              </span>
                            )}
                            <div className="flex flex-col text-left text-base-regular mt-2">
                              <span>
                                {address.address_1}
                                {address.address_2 && (
                                  <span>, {address.address_2}</span>
                                )}
                              </span>
                              <span>
                                {address.postal_code}, {address.city}
                              </span>
                              <span>
                                {address.province && `${address.province}, `}
                                {address.country_code?.toUpperCase()}
                              </span>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </Listbox.Option>
                    )
                  })}
                </Listbox.Options>
              </Transition>
            </div>
          </Listbox>
        )
      }
      
      export default AddressSelect

  content: |
      import { forwardRef, useImperativeHandle, useMemo, useRef } from "react"
      
      import NativeSelect, {
        NativeSelectProps,
      } from "@modules/common/components/native-select"
      import { HttpTypes } from "@medusajs/types"
      
      const CountrySelect = forwardRef<
        HTMLSelectElement,
        NativeSelectProps & {
          region?: HttpTypes.StoreRegion
        }
      >(({ placeholder = "Country", region, defaultValue, ...props }, ref) => {
        const innerRef = useRef<HTMLSelectElement>(null)
      
        useImperativeHandle<HTMLSelectElement | null, HTMLSelectElement | null>(
          ref,
          () => innerRef.current
        )
      
        const countryOptions = useMemo(() => {
          if (!region) {
            return []
          }
      
          return region.countries?.map((country) => ({
            value: country.iso_2,
            label: country.display_name,
          }))
        }, [region])
      
        return (
          <NativeSelect
            ref={innerRef}
            placeholder={placeholder}
            defaultValue={defaultValue}
            {...props}
          >
            {countryOptions?.map(({ value, label }, index) => (
              <option key={index} value={value}>
                {label}
              </option>
            ))}
          </NativeSelect>
        )
      })
      
      CountrySelect.displayName = "CountrySelect"
      
      export default CountrySelect
      
  referencedBy: {}

- path: docs/DESIGN.md
  content: |
      # DevCart — Design Plan
      
      Status: **proposal, awaiting owner approval.** No page is built from this yet.
      
      ## 1. Subject, audience, and job
      
      The spec names the store **DevCart** but does not define what it sells, so this is a proposal.
      
      - **Subject:** a small direct-to-consumer brand selling merchandise for people who build software — apparel (tees, hoodies, caps, totes) plus desk objects (mugs, keycaps, notebooks, stickers). Everything is drawn from software-making culture: version numbers, changelogs, compiler and terminal culture, hardware and keyboards.
      - **Audience:** developers, computer-science students, and engineering teams buying personal items or small team swag. They read Latin text in English, know what a keyboard shortcut is, and are unimpressed by generic tech-bro marketing. They buy on the strength of the joke, the typography, and the print quality.
      - **Primary job:** make it easy to find one product, understand exactly what it is and what it costs, and check out in a few steps. Personality lives in the catalogue, not in the checkout.
      
      The seed data in this repository is already apparel (tee, sweatshirt, sweatpants, shorts) with generic "Medusa" titles. The demo catalogue will be rewritten to fit the DevCart brand in Phase 1; the item types stay the same.
      
      ## 2. Colour — riso inks on uncoated stock
      
      DevCart's catalogue is printed merchandise, so the palette is built from actual risograph ink behaviour: flat, slightly translucent inks, limited to one or two per impression, misregistering by a hair against each other. That constraint is the identity. It is also deliberately not the warm-cream-plus-terracotta look, and not near-black-plus-acid-green.
      
      | Token | Hex | Role |
      |-------|-----|------|
      | `stock` | `#E8E9E3` | Page background. Cool uncoated paper, not a warm cream. |
      | `ink` | `#17181B` | Body text, rules, plate borders. The "black" plate. |
      | `riso-blue` | `#006DAE` | Primary brand colour: links, primary buttons, focus ring. |
      | `riso-pink` | `#FB008E` | The accent. Large display text on stock, fills, markers. |
      | `riso-yellow` | `#FFD400` | Fill only. Highlight behind ink text, used rarely. |
      | `riso-green` | `#007942` | State: in stock, order confirmed. Text or fill. |
      
      **AA adjustment.** `riso-blue`, `riso-pink` and `riso-green` are darkened from the raw riso ink values (`#0078BF`, `#FF48B0`, `#00A95C`) so that every permitted text usage meets WCAG AA. Hue is preserved in each case. §2.1 records the measurements; `stock`, `ink` and `riso-yellow` are unchanged.
      
      Rules of use:
      
      - **Two inks per view, maximum.** `ink` + `riso-blue` is the default impression. `riso-pink` is the second ink, and it earns its place by marking something specific (an on-sale price, the current filter, the hero headline).
      - **Overprint, not shadow.** Where two inks meet, use `mix-blend-mode: multiply` so the overlap darkens like real ink. This replaces drop shadows entirely — no soft grey card shadows anywhere.
      - Yellow and green never carry meaning on their own; they always sit next to a word that says the same thing.
      
      ### 2.1 Contrast, measured
      
      Ratios are WCAG 2.1 relative-luminance contrast ratios against the token pairs actually used. AA needs 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text (24px+, or 19px+ bold) and for non-text markers and boundaries.
      
      | Foreground | Background | Ratio | AA normal text | AA large text / markers |
      |---|---|---|---|---|
      | `ink` | `stock` | 14.54:1 | pass | pass |
      | `stock` | `ink` | 14.54:1 | pass | pass |
      | `ink` | `riso-yellow` | 12.40:1 | pass | pass |
      | `ink` | `riso-pink` | 4.64:1 | pass | pass |
      | `riso-blue` | `stock` | 4.53:1 | pass | pass |
      | `stock` | `riso-blue` | 4.53:1 | pass | pass |
      | `riso-green` | `stock` | 4.51:1 | pass | pass |
      | `stock` | `riso-green` | 4.51:1 | pass | pass |
      | `riso-pink` | `stock` | 3.13:1 | **fail** | pass |
      | `stock` | `riso-pink` | 3.13:1 | **fail** | pass |
      | `ink` | `riso-green` | 3.22:1 | **fail** | pass |
      | `ink` | `riso-blue` | 3.21:1 | **fail** | pass |
      | `riso-green` | `ink` | 3.22:1 | **fail** | pass |
      | `blue` | `ink` | 3.21:1 | **fail** | pass |
      | `riso-yellow` | `stock` | 1.17:1 | **fail** | **fail** |
      
      Rules that follow from the table, and which the base components enforce:
      
      - **`riso-pink` is never text below 24px.** It passes AA only as large display type, as a fill, or as a marker (3:1 for non-text). No body copy, no links, no form labels, no button labels.
      - **Never `stock` on `riso-pink`** (3.13:1). Text on a pink fill is `ink` (4.64:1).
      - **Never `ink` on `riso-blue`** (3.21:1). Text on a blue fill is `stock` (4.53:1).
      - **Never `ink` on `riso-green`; use `stock` on green** (4.51:1). `riso-green` as text on `stock` is fine.
      - **`riso-yellow` is a fill, never text**, and only ever behind `ink` (12.40:1).
      - `riso-blue` and `riso-green` as text on `stock` both clear normal-text AA, so links and state labels may use them directly.
      
      ## 3. Typography
      
      Two families plus one data face. Not Inter, not Space Grotesk, not a system stack.
      
      - **Display — Bricolage Grotesque** (variable, Google Fonts). Headlines, the hero, product titles, category names. It has a slightly irregular poster-grotesque character that suits printed merchandise and looks unlike a default UI font. Used at large sizes with tight tracking, and only at large sizes.
      - **Body / UI — IBM Plex Sans.** Paragraphs, labels, buttons, forms, navigation. Engineering heritage that fits the subject and stays legible at 14–16px, which is where a store's real reading happens.
      - **Data — IBM Plex Mono.** Reserved for content that is genuinely machine data: SKUs, spec tables ("100% cotton / 240 gsm"), order numbers, and code-like product names. Not used for eyebrows, nav labels, or decorative captions.
      
      Type scale (1.25 ratio, base 16px): 14 / 16 / 20 / 25 / 31 / 39 / 49 / 61. Body line length capped at ~72 characters; display lines at ~40.
      
      Weights: Bricolage Grotesque 700 for display; IBM Plex Sans 400 for body, 600 for buttons and labels. Normal sentence case everywhere — no all-caps labels.
      
      ## 4. Layout — the press sheet
      
      The page is treated as a print sheet, not a stack of floating cards. A visible hairline grid and small corner registration marks define the content area; every element is aligned to that grid.
      
      - Content is **left-aligned** on a centred max-width column of 1280px, with a lopsided editorial rhythm: the 12-column grid is divided roughly 7/5 rather than 6/6, so nothing sits dead centre.
      - Product cards are **plates**: square corners, a hairline `ink` border, the image on `stock`, and the title/price set below in a fixed type block. No border-radius, no shadow, no gradient. One consistent square edge is the system; rounded corners are never introduced.
      - **No numbered markers** except where something really is a sequence — order status (placed → paid → shipped) and checkout steps. Product plates are not numbered.
      - Sections are separated by rules and whitespace, not by alternating background colours.
      - Mobile (360 / 768 / 1280) collapses the grid to one and two columns; the alignment stays left.
      
      ### Home
      
      ```
      +----------------------------------------------------------+
      | DevCart        Shop  Collections  About      Search  Cart |
      +----------------------------------------------------------+
      |                                                          |
      |  Merch for                                               |
      |  people who        [ hero: product photo with            |
      |  build software    riso-pink and riso-blue plates        |
      |                    offset against it ]                   |
      |  [ Shop new ]  [ Browse all ]                             |
      |                                                          |
      +----------------------------------------------------------+
      |  New this drop                                            |
      |  +--------+  +--------+  +--------+  +--------+           |
      |  | plate  |  | plate  |  | plate  |  | plate  |           |
      |  +--------+  +--------+  +--------+  +--------+           |
      +----------------------------------------------------------+
      |  Collections:  Everyday  /  Desk  /  Limited Run          |
      +----------------------------------------------------------+
      ```
      
      ### Listing (`/store`, category, collection)
      
      ```
      +----------------------------------------------------------+
      |  All products                 [ search ]                  |
      +---------------+------------------------------------------+
      | Sort          |  +--------+  +--------+  +--------+       |
      |  Newest       |  | plate  |  | plate  |  | plate  |       |
      | Category      |  +--------+  +--------+  +--------+       |
      |  [x] Shirts   |  +--------+  +--------+  +--------+       |
      | Price         |  | plate  |  | plate  |  | plate  |       |
      |  |----o----|  |  +--------+  +--------+  +--------+       |
      +---------------+------------------------------------------+
      |                    <  1 2 3  >                            |
      ```
      
      ### Product
      
      ```
      +-------------------------------+--------------------------+
      |  [ gallery: main image ]      |  Hoodie                  |
      |  +----+ +----+ +----+         |  EUR 45.00   in stock    |
      |  |    | |    | |    |         |                          |
      |  +----+ +----+ +----+         |  Size  [S] [M] [L] [XL]  |
      |                               |  Colour [ink] [pink]     |
      |                               |  [ Add to cart ]         |
      |                               |  ---------------------   |
      |                               |  Specs (mono table)      |
      |                               |  SKU  DC-HOOD-INK-M      |
      +-------------------------------+--------------------------+
      ```
      
      ## 5. Principles
      
      1. **Ink is scarce.** Two colours per screen, one of them loud. If a third appears, something above it gets removed.
      2. **The grid is visible and load-bearing.** Rules, registration marks, and plate edges carry real structure; they are not decoration. Removing them should break the layout's legibility, not just its mood.
      3. **Type is the image.** Display headlines are content and are set as such. No stock-photo hero collages, no gradient washes, no icon-and-heading card trios.
      4. **Products are editions.** Specs, SKUs and print details are shown as plain, useful facts — an honest product page is the brand's tone, not a marketing one.
      5. **Motion is mechanical and rare.** Motion answers a click: adding to cart, opening the cart drawer, switching a variant image. No scroll-triggered fade-up on every section, no hover lift on every card. See §5.1.
      
      ### 5.1 Deferred polish
      
      Three visual devices are **optional polish, built last** — after the pages and the commerce flows work, and only if they still earn their place:
      
      1. **Registration marks** — small corner crop marks on plates and page sections.
      2. **Overprint** — `mix-blend-mode: multiply` where two inks overlap.
      3. **Settle-into-register** — the single page-load animation where plates align, respecting `prefers-reduced-motion`.
      
      Until then, plates use plain hairline borders and no blend modes. The base components must look finished without any of these, so none of them may be load-bearing.
      6. **Copy is plain.** Sentence case, active voice, one job per string. The button says "Add to cart", the toast says "Added to cart". Empty cart says what to do next; an error says what failed and how to fix it. No filler, no exclamation marks.
      
      ## 6. Review against the brief
      
      Checked against the common generated-design defaults before building:
      
      - **Changed:** the original pass used a warm cream `#F4F1EA` background with a serif display and a clay accent. That is the single most recognisable generated palette, so the ground moved to a cool uncoated `stock` `#E8E9E3`, the display face to Bricolage Grotesque, and the accent to riso pink — a colour that comes from the subject's actual production method rather than from a mood board.
      - **Changed:** an early layout used rounded cards with soft shadows (the SaaS-card kit). Replaced with square hairline plates and multiply overprint, which is what printed merchandise actually looks like.
      - **Changed:** mono was initially going to label nav items and eyebrows. Cut back to machine data only, since mono-for-labels is a template tell and this brief does not need it.
      - **Changed:** the raw riso inks were kept for shape but darkened where they failed AA. Blue and green moved just far enough to clear 4.5:1 on `stock`; pink moved to 3.13:1 on stock while holding 4.64:1 for `ink` text on a pink fill. The exact riso values survive only as the hue reference in §2.
      - **Kept, because the brief justifies it:** tight display typography and hard grid edges — this is a print catalogue, and those are its real conventions, not a stylistic costume.
      
      ## 7. Decisions confirmed by the owner
      
      1. **Subject:** developer merchandise, as described in §1.
      2. **Name:** DevCart.
      3. **Mode:** light mode only for now; dark mode deferred (Phase 3 marks it optional).
      4. **Headlines:** sentence case everywhere, including the wireframes above.
      5. **Accessibility:** `riso-pink` and `riso-blue` must meet WCAG AA for any text usage; see §2.1.
      6. **Polish:** registration marks, overprint and the settle animation are deferred to last; see §5.1.

- path: apps/storefront/src/modules/design-system/components/plate/index.tsx
  content: |
      import clsx from "clsx"
      import { forwardRef, HTMLAttributes } from "react"
      
      /*
       * A plate is the shell every product appears in: a square, hairline-bordered
       * block with no shadow and no rounding. Registration marks and overprint are
       * deferred polish (docs/DESIGN.md §5.1) — a plate must look finished without them.
       */
      export type PlateProps = HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> & {
        as?: "div" | "article" | "li"
      }
      
      const PlateRoot = forwardRef<HTMLElement, PlateProps>(
        ({ className, as = "article", children, ...props }, ref) => {
          // `as` lets a plate be a grid item (`li`) or a standalone block without
          // duplicating the styling; ElementType keeps the ref valid across both.
          const Component = as as React.ElementType
      
          return (
            <Component
              ref={ref}
              className={clsx(
                "relative flex w-full flex-col rounded-square border border-ink bg-stock",
                className
              )}
              {...props}
            >
              {children}
            </Component>
          )
        }
      )
      PlateRoot.displayName = "Plate"
      
      /** Fixed-ratio image well. Keeps every plate in a grid the same height. */
      const PlateMedia = ({ className, children, ...props }: HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>) => (
        <div
          className={clsx("relative aspect-square w-full overflow-hidden bg-ink/5", className)}
          {...props}
        >
          {children}
        </div>
      )
      
      /** Text block below the media. */
      const PlateBody = ({ className, ...props }: HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>) => (
        <div className={clsx("flex flex-col gap-2 border-t border-ink p-4", className)} {...props} />
      )
      
      /**
       * Product name. Display voice, sentence case. `break-words` keeps a long
       * single word ("Coffee-Driven") inside a narrow two-up plate on a phone
       * instead of pushing past the plate edge.
       */
      const PlateTitle = ({ className, ...props }: HTMLAttributes<HTMLHeadingElement>) => (
        <h3
          className={clsx(
            "break-words font-display text-lead font-semibold leading-tight text-ink",
            className
          )}
          {...props}
        />
      )
      
      /** Price. Mono, because it is machine data and must align across a grid. */
      const PlatePrice = ({ className, ...props }: HTMLAttributes<HTMLParagraphElement>) => (
        <p className={clsx("font-mono text-small text-ink", className)} {...props} />
      )
      
      /** Secondary facts: stock state, SKU, material. */
      const PlateMeta = ({ className, ...props }: HTMLAttributes<HTMLParagraphElement>) => (
        <p className={clsx("text-small text-ink", className)} {...props} />
      )
      
      export const Plate = Object.assign(PlateRoot, {
        Media: PlateMedia,
        Body: PlateBody,
        Title: PlateTitle,
        Price: PlatePrice,
        Meta: PlateMeta,
      })
      
  referencedBy: {}

      import clsx from "clsx"
      import { forwardRef, HTMLAttributes } from "react"
      
      export type RuleProps = HTMLAttributes<HTMLHRElement> & {
        /** `hairline` is the default divider; `heavy` closes a band. */
        weight?: "hairline" | "heavy"
      }
      
      /**
       * A horizontal rule is real structure in this design — it separates bands and
       * closes plates — so it always uses the ink plate, never a tinted grey.
       */
      export const Rule = forwardRef<HTMLHRElement, RuleProps>(
        ({ className, weight = "hairline", ...props }, ref) => {
          return (
            <hr
              ref={ref}
              className={clsx(
                "w-full border-0 border-t border-solid border-ink",
                weight === "heavy" && "border-t-2",
                className
              )}
              {...props}
            />
          )
        }
      )
      
      Rule.displayName = "Rule"

- path: apps/storefront/src/modules/design-system/components/button/index.tsx
  content: |
      import clsx from "clsx"
      import { ButtonHTMLAttributes, forwardRef } from "react"
      
      export type ButtonVariant = "primary" | "secondary"
      export type ButtonSize = "small" | "medium" | "large"
      
      export type ButtonProps = ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> & {
        variant?: ButtonVariant
        size?: ButtonSize
        /** Blocks the button and shows a spinner without shifting the layout. */
        loading?: boolean
      }
      
      /*
       * Colour choices are fixed by the contrast rules in docs/DESIGN.md §2.1:
       * `stock` on `riso-blue` is 4.53:1, so that pairing is the only blue fill.
       * `ink` is never placed on `riso-blue` (3.21:1).
       */
      const VARIANTS: Record<ButtonVariant, string> = {
        primary:
          "bg-riso-blue text-stock border border-riso-blue hover:bg-ink hover:border-ink " +
          "disabled:bg-riso-blue/40 disabled:border-transparent disabled:text-stock/80",
        secondary:
          "bg-transparent text-ink border border-ink hover:bg-ink hover:text-stock " +
          "disabled:border-ink/30 disabled:text-ink/40 disabled:hover:bg-transparent disabled:hover:text-ink/40",
      }
      
      const SIZES: Record<ButtonSize, string> = {
        small: "h-9 px-3 text-small",
        medium: "h-11 px-5 text-body",
        large: "h-14 px-7 text-lead",
      }
      
      const BASE =
        "inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-square font-sans font-semibold " +
        "transition-colors duration-150 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
      
      /**
       * The button look as a class string, for the places that need a button-shaped
       * *link* (`<a>` inside `<button>` is invalid markup). `Button` itself is built
       * from this, so a link styled with it cannot drift from the real button.
       */
      export const buttonClass = ({
        className,
        variant = "primary",
        size = "medium",
      }: {
        className?: string
        variant?: ButtonVariant
        size?: ButtonSize
      } = {}) => clsx(BASE, VARIANTS[variant], SIZES[size], className)
      
      export const Button = forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, ButtonProps>(
        (
          { className, variant = "primary", size = "medium", loading, disabled, children, ...props },
          ref
        ) => {
          return (
            <button
              ref={ref}
              type={props.type ?? "button"}
              // aria-busy tells assistive tech the action is running; `disabled` alone
              // just looks inert.
              aria-busy={loading || undefined}
              disabled={disabled || loading}
              className={buttonClass({ variant, size, className })}
              {...props}
            >
              {loading && (
                <span
                  aria-hidden="true"

  content: |
      import clsx from "clsx"
      import { forwardRef, InputHTMLAttributes } from "react"
      
      export type InputProps = Omit<InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>, "id"> & {
        /** Required: the label is associated with the field through this id. */
        id: string
        label: string
        /** Guidance shown below the field when there is no error. */
        hint?: string
        /**
         * Error message. Rendered in ink, not pink: `riso-pink` is 3.13:1 on `stock`
         * (docs/DESIGN.md §2.1) so it may only mark, never carry words. The pink
         * border is the marker; this text says what went wrong.
         */
        error?: string
      }
      
      export const Input = forwardRef<HTMLInputElement, InputProps>(
        ({ className, id, label, hint, error, disabled, ...props }, ref) => {
          const hintId = hint ? `${id}-hint` : undefined
          const errorId = error ? `${id}-error` : undefined
          const describedBy = errorId ?? hintId
      
          return (
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
              <label htmlFor={id} className="text-small font-semibold text-ink">
                {label}
              </label>
      
              <input
                ref={ref}
                id={id}
                disabled={disabled}
                aria-invalid={error ? true : undefined}
                aria-describedby={describedBy}
                className={clsx(
                  "h-11 w-full rounded-square border bg-stock px-3 text-body text-ink",
                  "placeholder:text-ink/60",
                  "disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:border-ink/30 disabled:bg-ink/5 disabled:text-ink/40",
                  error ? "border-riso-pink" : "border-ink",
                  className
                )}
                {...props}
              />
      
              {hint && !error && (
                <p id={hintId} className="text-small text-ink">
                  {hint}
                </p>
              )}
      
              {error && (
                <p id={errorId} className="text-small text-ink">
                  {error}
                </p>
              )}
            </div>
          )
        }
      )
      
      Input.displayName = "Input"
      
  referencedBy: {}

      import { Label } from "@modules/common/components/ui"
      import React, { useEffect, useImperativeHandle, useState } from "react"
      
      import Eye from "@modules/common/icons/eye"
      import EyeOff from "@modules/common/icons/eye-off"
      
      type InputProps = Omit<
        Omit<React.InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>, "size">,
        "placeholder"
      > & {
        label: string
        errors?: Record<string, unknown>
        touched?: Record<string, unknown>
        name: string
        topLabel?: string
      }
      
      const Input = React.forwardRef<HTMLInputElement, InputProps>(
        ({ type, name, label, touched: _touched, required, topLabel, ...props }, ref) => {
          const inputRef = React.useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null)
          const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false)
          const [inputType, setInputType] = useState(type)
      
          useEffect(() => {
            if (type === "password" && showPassword) {
              setInputType("text")
            }
      
            if (type === "password" && !showPassword) {
              setInputType("password")
            }
          }, [type, showPassword])
      
          useImperativeHandle(ref, () => inputRef.current!)
      
          return (
            <div className="flex flex-col w-full">
              {topLabel && (
                <Label className="mb-2 txt-compact-medium-plus">{topLabel}</Label>
              )}
              <div className="flex relative z-0 w-full txt-compact-medium">
                <input
                  type={inputType}
                  name={name}
                  placeholder=" "
                  required={required}
                  className="pt-4 pb-1 block w-full h-11 px-4 mt-0 bg-ui-bg-field border rounded-md appearance-none focus:outline-none focus:ring-0 focus:shadow-borders-interactive-with-active border-ui-border-base hover:bg-ui-bg-field-hover"
                  {...props}
                  ref={inputRef}
                />
                <label
                  htmlFor={name}
                  onClick={() => inputRef.current?.focus()}
                  className="flex items-center justify-center mx-3 px-1 transition-all absolute duration-300 top-3 -z-1 origin-0 text-ui-fg-subtle"
                >
                  {label}
                  {required && <span className="text-rose-500">*</span>}
                </label>
                {type === "password" && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setShowPassword(!showPassword)}
                    className="text-ui-fg-subtle px-4 focus:outline-none transition-all duration-150 outline-none focus:text-ui-fg-base absolute right-0 top-3"
                  >
                    {showPassword ? <Eye /> : <EyeOff />}
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          )
        }
      )
      
      Input.displayName = "Input"
      
      export default Input

  content: |
      import { ChevronUpDown } from "@medusajs/icons"
      import { clx } from "@modules/common/components/ui"
      import {
        SelectHTMLAttributes,
        forwardRef,
        useEffect,
        useImperativeHandle,
        useRef,
        useState,
      } from "react"
      
      export type NativeSelectProps = {
        placeholder?: string
        errors?: Record<string, unknown>
        touched?: Record<string, unknown>
      } & SelectHTMLAttributes<HTMLSelectElement>
      
      const NativeSelect = forwardRef<HTMLSelectElement, NativeSelectProps>(
        (
          { placeholder = "Select...", defaultValue, className, children, ...props },
          ref
        ) => {
          const innerRef = useRef<HTMLSelectElement>(null)
          const [isPlaceholder, setIsPlaceholder] = useState(false)
      
          useImperativeHandle<HTMLSelectElement | null, HTMLSelectElement | null>(
            ref,
            () => innerRef.current
          )
      
          useEffect(() => {
            if (innerRef.current && innerRef.current.value === "") {
              setIsPlaceholder(true)
            } else {
              setIsPlaceholder(false)
            }
          }, [innerRef.current?.value])
      
          return (
            <div>
              <div
                onFocus={() => innerRef.current?.focus()}
                onBlur={() => innerRef.current?.blur()}
                className={clx(
                  "relative flex items-center text-base-regular border border-ui-border-base bg-ui-bg-subtle rounded-md hover:bg-ui-bg-field-hover",
                  className,
                  {
                    "text-ui-fg-muted": isPlaceholder,
                  }
                )}
              >
                <select
                  ref={innerRef}
                  defaultValue={defaultValue}
                  {...props}
                  className="appearance-none flex-1 bg-transparent border-none px-4 py-2.5 transition-colors duration-150 outline-none "
                >
                  <option disabled value="">
                    {placeholder}
                  </option>
                  {children}
                </select>
                <span className="absolute right-4 inset-y-0 flex items-center pointer-events-none ">
                  <ChevronUpDown />
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          )
        }
      )
      
      NativeSelect.displayName = "NativeSelect"
      
      export default NativeSelect
      
  referencedBy: {}

      "use client"
      
      import repeat from "@lib/util/repeat"
      import { HttpTypes } from "@medusajs/types"
      import { Table, clx } from "@modules/common/components/ui"
      
      import Item from "@modules/cart/components/item"
      import SkeletonLineItem from "@modules/skeletons/components/skeleton-line-item"
      
      type ItemsTemplateProps = {
        cart: HttpTypes.StoreCart
      }
      
      const ItemsPreviewTemplate = ({ cart }: ItemsTemplateProps) => {
        const items = cart.items
        const hasOverflow = items && items.length > 4
      
        return (
          <div
            className={clx({
              "pl-[1px] overflow-y-scroll overflow-x-hidden no-scrollbar max-h-[420px]":
                hasOverflow,
            })}
          >
            <Table>
              <Table.Body data-testid="items-table">
                {items
                  ? items
                      .sort((a, b) => {
                        return (a.created_at ?? "") > (b.created_at ?? "") ? -1 : 1
                      })
                      .map((item) => {
                        return (
                          <Item
                            key={item.id}
                            item={item}
                            type="preview"
                            currencyCode={cart.currency_code}
                          />
                        )
                      })
                  : repeat(5).map((i) => {
                      return <SkeletonLineItem key={i} />
                    })}
              </Table.Body>
            </Table>
          </div>
        )
      }
      
      export default ItemsPreviewTemplate

  content: |
      "use client"
      
      import { convertToLocale } from "@lib/util/money"
      import { Rule } from "@modules/design-system"
      import React from "react"
      
      type CartTotalsProps = {
        totals: {
          total?: number | null
          subtotal?: number | null
          tax_total?: number | null
          currency_code: string
          item_subtotal?: number | null
          shipping_subtotal?: number | null
          discount_subtotal?: number | null
        }
      }
      
      /**
       * The money breakdown, shared by the cart, checkout and order pages. Amounts are
       * mono so the columns line up down the page — this is machine data, which is
       * exactly what docs/DESIGN.md reserves the mono face for.
       */
      const CartTotals: React.FC<CartTotalsProps> = ({ totals }) => {
        const {
          currency_code,
          total,
          tax_total,
          item_subtotal,
          shipping_subtotal,
          discount_subtotal,
        } = totals
      
        const amount = (value?: number | null) =>
          convertToLocale({ amount: value ?? 0, currency_code })
      
        return (
          <div data-testid="cart-totals">
            <dl className="flex flex-col gap-2 text-small text-ink">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
                <dt>Subtotal (excl. shipping and taxes)</dt>
                <dd className="font-mono" data-testid="cart-subtotal" data-value={item_subtotal || 0}>
                  {amount(item_subtotal)}
                </dd>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
                <dt>Shipping</dt>
                <dd className="font-mono" data-testid="cart-shipping" data-value={shipping_subtotal || 0}>
                  {amount(shipping_subtotal)}
                </dd>
              </div>
              {!!discount_subtotal && (
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
                  <dt>Discount</dt>
                  <dd
                    className="font-mono text-riso-green"
                    data-testid="cart-discount"
                    data-value={discount_subtotal || 0}
                  >
                    -{amount(Math.abs(discount_subtotal))}
                  </dd>
                </div>
              )}
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
                <dt>Taxes</dt>
                <dd className="font-mono" data-testid="cart-taxes" data-value={tax_total || 0}>
                  {amount(tax_total)}
                </dd>
              </div>
            </dl>
      
            <Rule className="my-4" weight="heavy" />
      
            <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between gap-4">
              <span className="text-body font-semibold">Total</span>
              <span
                className="font-mono text-lead"
                data-testid="cart-total"
                data-value={total || 0}
              >
                {amount(total)}
              </span>
            </div>
      
            <Rule className="mt-4" />
          </div>
        )
      }
      
      export default CartTotals
      
  referencedBy: {}

  content: |
      "use client"
      
      import { HttpTypes } from "@medusajs/types"
      
      import CartTotals from "@modules/common/components/cart-totals"
      import LocalizedClientLink from "@modules/common/components/localized-client-link"
      import { Rule, buttonClass } from "@modules/design-system"
      import DiscountCode from "@modules/checkout/components/discount-code"
      
      type SummaryProps = {
        cart: HttpTypes.StoreCart
        /** Units left per variant id; `null` where stock is not a limit. */
        availability?: Record<string, number | null>
      }
      
      function getCheckoutStep(cart: HttpTypes.StoreCart) {
        if (!cart?.shipping_address?.address_1 || !cart.email) {
          return "address"
        } else if (cart?.shipping_methods?.length === 0) {
          return "delivery"
        } else {
          return "payment"
        }
      }
      
      const Summary = ({ cart, availability = {} }: SummaryProps) => {
        const step = getCheckoutStep(cart)
      
        /*
         * A line can be left holding more units than the catalogue has: the stock can
         * drop under it while the cart waits. Checkout would fail on it later, so the
         * cart says what to fix and holds the button until it is fixed.
         */
        const linesOverStock = (cart.items ?? []).filter((item) => {
          const available = item.variant_id ? availability[item.variant_id] : undefined
      
          return typeof available === "number" && item.quantity > available
        })
      
        return (
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
            <h2 className="font-display text-lead font-semibold text-ink">Summary</h2>
      
            <DiscountCode cart={cart} />
      
            <Rule />
      
            <CartTotals totals={cart} />
      
            {linesOverStock.length > 0 ? (
              <p
                role="status"
                className="text-small font-semibold text-ink"
                data-testid="checkout-stock-warning"
              >
                Some quantities are above what is left in stock. Lower them to
                continue.
              </p>
            ) : null}
      
            {linesOverStock.length > 0 ? (
              <button
                type="button"
                disabled
                className={buttonClass({ size: "large", className: "w-full" })}
                data-testid="checkout-button"
              >
                Go to checkout
              </button>
            ) : (
              <LocalizedClientLink
                href={"/checkout?step=" + step}
                className={buttonClass({ size: "large", className: "w-full" })}
                data-testid="checkout-button"
              >
                Go to checkout
              </LocalizedClientLink>
            )}
          </div>
        )
      }
      
      export default Summary

- path: apps/storefront/src/app/api/payment-return/route.ts
  content: |
      import { sdk } from "@lib/config"
      import { placeOrder } from "@lib/data/cart"
      import { getAuthHeaders, setCartId } from "@lib/data/cookies"
      import { HttpTypes } from "@medusajs/types"
      import { unstable_rethrow } from "next/navigation"
      import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server"
      
      export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
        const { origin, searchParams } = req.nextUrl
      
        const cartId = searchParams.get("cart_id")
        const countryCode = searchParams.get("country_code")
        const paymentIntent = searchParams.get("payment_intent")
        const paymentIntentClientSecret = searchParams.get(
          "payment_intent_client_secret"
        )
        const redirectStatus = searchParams.get("redirect_status")
      
        // Without a country code the middleware resolves the customer's region and
        // prefixes it; either way every redirect below stays on this origin.
        const prefix = countryCode ? `/${countryCode}` : ""
        const rejected = () =>
          NextResponse.redirect(`${origin}${prefix}/cart?error=payment_failed`)
      
        if (!cartId || !paymentIntent || !paymentIntentClientSecret) {
          return rejected()
        }
      
        const cart = await sdk.client
          .fetch<HttpTypes.StoreCartResponse>(`/store/carts/${cartId}`, {
            method: "GET",
            query: { fields: "payment_collection.payment_sessions.data" },
            headers: { ...(await getAuthHeaders()) },
            cache: "no-store",
          })
          .then(({ cart }) => cart)
          .catch(() => null)
      
        const paymentSession = cart?.payment_collection?.payment_sessions?.find(
          (session) => session.data?.id === paymentIntent
        )
      
        if (
          !paymentSession ||
          paymentSession.data?.client_secret !== paymentIntentClientSecret
        ) {
          return rejected()
        }
      
        await setCartId(cartId)
      
        // The customer backed out or the bank declined. Stripe puts the PaymentIntent
        // back into `requires_payment_method`, so the Payment Element can mount
        // against it again — return to the payment step and let them retry.
        if (redirectStatus === "failed") {
          const params = new URLSearchParams({ step: "payment" })
      
          // Forward Stripe's own return parameters so the checkout step can tell how
          // the off-site authorization ended.
          for (const key of [
            "payment_intent",
            "payment_intent_client_secret",
            "redirect_status",
          ]) {
            const value = searchParams.get(key)
      
            if (value) {
              params.set(key, value)
            }
          }
      
          return NextResponse.redirect(`${origin}${prefix}/checkout?${params}`)
        }
      
        try {
          await placeOrder(cartId)
        } catch (error) {
          unstable_rethrow(error)
      
          return NextResponse.redirect(`${origin}${prefix}/cart?error=order_failed`)
        }
      
        // Only reached when the cart did not convert into an order.
        return NextResponse.redirect(`${origin}${prefix}/cart?error=order_failed`)
      }

  content: |
      "use client"
      
      import { Badge, Heading, Input, Label, Text } from "@modules/common/components/ui"
      import React from "react"
      
      import { applyPromotions } from "@lib/data/cart"
      import { convertToLocale } from "@lib/util/money"
      import { HttpTypes } from "@medusajs/types"
      import Trash from "@modules/common/icons/trash"
      import ErrorMessage from "../error-message"
      import { SubmitButton } from "../submit-button"
      
      type DiscountCodeProps = {
        cart: HttpTypes.StoreCart
      }
      
      const DiscountCode: React.FC<DiscountCodeProps> = ({ cart }) => {
        const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = React.useState(false)
        const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = React.useState("")
      
        const { promotions = [] } = cart
        const removePromotionCode = async (code: string) => {
          const validPromotions = promotions.filter(
            (promotion) => promotion.code !== code
          )
      
          await applyPromotions(
            validPromotions.filter((p) => p.code !== undefined).map((p) => p.code!)
          )
        }
      
        const addPromotionCode = async (formData: FormData) => {
          setErrorMessage("")
      
          const code = formData.get("code")
          if (!code) {
            return
          }
          const input = document.getElementById("promotion-input") as HTMLInputElement
          const codes = promotions
            .filter((p) => p.code !== undefined)
            .map((p) => p.code!)
          codes.push(code.toString())
      
          try {
            await applyPromotions(codes)
          } catch (e) {
            setErrorMessage(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e))
          }
      
          if (input) {
            input.value = ""
          }
        }
      
        return (
          <div className="w-full bg-white flex flex-col">
            <div className="txt-medium">
              <form action={(a) => addPromotionCode(a)} className="w-full mb-5">
                <Label className="flex gap-x-1 my-2 items-center">
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setIsOpen(!isOpen)}
                    type="button"
                    className="txt-medium text-ui-fg-interactive hover:text-ui-fg-interactive-hover"
                    data-testid="add-discount-button"
                  >
                    Add Promotion Code(s)
                  </button>
      
                  {/* <Tooltip content="You can add multiple promotion codes">
                    <InformationCircleSolid color="var(--fg-muted)" />
                  </Tooltip> */}
                </Label>
      
                {isOpen && (
                  <>
                    <div className="flex w-full gap-x-2">
                      <Input
                        className="size-full"
                        id="promotion-input"
                        name="code"
                        type="text"
                        autoFocus={false}
                        data-testid="discount-input"
                      />
                      <SubmitButton
                        variant="secondary"
                        data-testid="discount-apply-button"
                      >
                        Apply
                      </SubmitButton>
                    </div>
      
                    <ErrorMessage
                      error={errorMessage}
                      data-testid="discount-error-message"
                    />
                  </>
                )}
              </form>
      
              {promotions.length > 0 && (
                <div className="w-full flex items-center">
                  <div className="flex flex-col w-full">
                    <Heading className="txt-medium mb-2">
                      Promotion(s) applied:
                    </Heading>
      
                    {promotions.map((promotion) => {
                      return (
                        <div
                          key={promotion.id}
                          className="flex items-center justify-between w-full max-w-full mb-2"
                          data-testid="discount-row"
                        >
                          <Text className="flex gap-x-1 items-baseline txt-small-plus w-4/5 pr-1">
                            <span className="truncate" data-testid="discount-code">
                              <Badge
                                color={promotion.is_automatic ? "green" : "grey"}
                              >
                                {promotion.code}
                              </Badge>{" "}
                              (
                              {promotion.application_method?.value !== undefined &&
                                promotion.application_method.currency_code !==
                                  undefined && (
                                  <>
                                    {promotion.application_method.type ===
                                    "percentage"
                                      ? `${promotion.application_method.value}%`
                                      : convertToLocale({
                                          amount: +promotion.application_method.value,
                                          currency_code:
                                            promotion.application_method
                                              .currency_code,
                                        })}
                                  </>
                                )}
                              )
                              {/* {promotion.is_automatic && (
                                <Tooltip content="This promotion is automatically applied">
                                  <InformationCircleSolid className="inline text-zinc-400" />
                                </Tooltip>
                              )} */}
                            </span>
                          </Text>
                          {!promotion.is_automatic && (
                            <button
                              className="flex items-center"
                              onClick={() => {
                                if (!promotion.code) {
                                  return
                                }
      
                                removePromotionCode(promotion.code)
                              }}
                              data-testid="remove-discount-button"
                            >
                              <Trash size={14} />
                              <span className="sr-only">
                                Remove discount code from order
                              </span>
                            </button>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      )
                    })}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        )
      }
      
      export default DiscountCode

- path: apps/storefront/src/modules/store/components/store-hits/index.tsx
  content: |
      "use client"
      
      import type { Hit } from "instantsearch.js"
      import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react"
      import { useHits, useInstantSearch } from "react-instantsearch"
      
      import useSearchSettled from "@lib/hooks/use-search-settled"
      import { Button } from "@modules/design-system"
      import ProductCard from "@modules/products/components/product-card"
      import SkeletonProductGrid from "@modules/skeletons/templates/skeleton-product-grid"
      import SearchPagination from "./pagination"
      import HitPrice, { HitPricing } from "./price"
      
      type ProductHit = Hit<
        {
          title: string | null
          handle: string | null
          thumbnail: string | null
        } & HitPricing
      >
      
      type StoreHitsProps = {
        hitsPerPage: number
        currencyCode: string
      }
      
      /**
       * How long the grid waits for a first response before calling it a failure. A
       * search that only stalls keeps InstantSearch in a loading state with no error,
       * so the timeout is what turns "nothing ever arrives" into something the
       * customer can act on.
       */
      const RESPONSE_TIMEOUT_MS = 10_000
      
      const StoreHits = ({ hitsPerPage, currencyCode }: StoreHitsProps) => {
        const { items } = useHits<ProductHit>()
        const { status, error, indexUiState, refresh } = useInstantSearch()
        const { isSearching, hasNoResultsYet } = useSearchSettled()
        const [timedOut, setTimedOut] = useState(false)
      
        const { page, ...refinements } = indexUiState
        const currentPage = page ?? 1
        const refinementKey = JSON.stringify(refinements)
      
        const settled = useRef({ page: currentPage, refinementKey })
      
        useEffect(() => {
          if (!isSearching) {
            settled.current = { page: currentPage, refinementKey }
          }
        }, [isSearching, currentPage, refinementKey])
      
        /*
         * Time the wait from when a query starts, not from the last status change: a
         * client that keeps retrying a dead endpoint keeps emitting status updates,
         * and a resettable timeout would never fire. Answering the query clears the
         * guard so the next failure gets its own countdown.
         */
        useEffect(() => {
          if (!hasNoResultsYet) {
            setTimedOut(false)
            return
          }
      
          const startedAt = Date.now()
          const timer = window.setInterval(() => {
            if (Date.now() - startedAt >= RESPONSE_TIMEOUT_MS) {
              window.clearInterval(timer)
              setTimedOut(true)
            }
          }, 500)
      
          return () => window.clearInterval(timer)
        }, [hasNoResultsYet, refinementKey])
      
        const isPagingOnly =
          refinementKey === settled.current.refinementKey &&
          currentPage !== settled.current.page
      
        const showSkeleton = !timedOut && (hasNoResultsYet || (isSearching && isPagingOnly))
      
        if (status === "error" || timedOut) {
          return (
            <div
              role="alert"
              className="flex flex-col items-start gap-4 border-y border-ink/20 py-12"
              data-testid="products-error"
            >
              <p className="text-ink">
                {status === "error" && error?.message
                  ? `Couldn't load products: ${error.message}`
                  : "Couldn't load products. The search service did not respond."}
              </p>
              <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => refresh()}>
                Try again
              </Button>
            </div>
          )
        }
      
        return (
          <>
            {showSkeleton ? (
              <SkeletonProductGrid numberOfProducts={hitsPerPage} />
            ) : !items.length ? (
              <p
                className="border-y border-ink/20 py-16 text-center text-ink/75"
                data-testid="no-products"
              >
                No products matched these filters.
              </p>
            ) : (
              <ul
                className="grid w-full grid-cols-2 gap-x-4 gap-y-8 small:grid-cols-3 small:gap-x-6"
                data-testid="products-list"
              >
                {items.map((hit) =>
                  hit.handle ? (
                    <ProductCard
                      key={hit.objectID}
                      as="li"
                      href={`/products/${hit.handle}`}
                      title={hit.title ?? "Untitled product"}
                      thumbnail={hit.thumbnail}
                      price={<HitPrice hit={hit} currencyCode={currencyCode} />}
                    />
                  ) : null
                )}
              </ul>
            )}
            <SearchPagination />
          </>
        )
      }
      
      export default StoreHits

> **Step model** (`apps/storefront/src/modules/checkout/lib/steps.ts` — new; hmm, other checkout code uses no lib dir. Let me put it at `src/lib/util/checkout-steps.ts`? The design-system lives in modules. I'll use `src/modules/checkout/lib/steps.ts`.)
> 
> ```ts
> export type CheckoutStepId = "contact" | "address" | "delivery" | "payment" | "review"
> export const CHECKOUT_STEPS: { id, label }[] = ...
> export function isStepComplete(step, cart): boolean
> export function firstIncompleteStep(cart): CheckoutStepId
> export function reachableSteps(cart): Set/array — a step is reachable if all previous steps complete
> export function resolveStep(requested, cart): { step, redirect? }
> ```
> 
> Completion rules:
> - contact: `!!cart.email`
> - address: `!!cart.shipping_address?.address_1 && !!cart.billing_address`
> - delivery: `(cart.shipping_methods?.length ?? 0) > 0`
> - payment: `!!cart.payment_collection` (session initiated)
> - review: order placed — not a persistent state; review is reachable once payment complete.
> 
> Important: `firstIncompleteStep` when everything up to payment is done → "review".
> 
> **Reachability = every earlier step complete.** So `reachable("delivery")` = contact && address complete. `reachable("review")` = contact, address, delivery, payment complete.
> 
> **Requested step handling** in the page: if `?step=` is missing or not reachable, redirect to the first incomplete (reachable) step. If a step is missing but all prereqs complete → first incomplete.
> 
> Careful: `contact` complete once email set, but the user should still be able to edit it → reachable always (it's step 1). `address` reachable if contact complete. Right.
>
