- path: apps/storefront/src/styles/globals.css
  content: |
      @import "tailwindcss/base";
      @import "tailwindcss/components";
      @import "tailwindcss/utilities";
      
      /*
       * DevCart theme tokens.
       *
       * Colours are stored as raw sRGB channels so Tailwind can build `rgb(... / <alpha-value>)`
       * utilities from them and opacity modifiers keep working. The hex value in each comment is
       * the source of truth for design work; docs/DESIGN.md §2.1 records the contrast ratios.
       */
      @layer base {
        :root {
          --dc-stock: 232 233 227; /* #E8E9E3 */
          --dc-ink: 23 24 27; /* #17181B */
          --dc-riso-blue: 0 109 174; /* #006DAE */
          --dc-riso-pink: 251 0 142; /* #FB008E */
          --dc-riso-yellow: 255 212 0; /* #FFD400 */
          --dc-riso-green: 0 121 66; /* #007942 */
      
          /* Spacing scale. `--dc-gutter` is the page edge, `--dc-section` the space
             between bands, `--dc-content` the max width of a reading column. */
          --dc-gutter: 1.5rem;
          --dc-section: 6rem;
          --dc-content: 80rem;
      
          /* The system is square. Kept as a variable so the value is stated once. */
          --dc-radius: 0px;
      
          /* Single focus treatment, reused by every interactive component. */
          --dc-focus-ring-width: 2px;
          --dc-focus-ring-offset: 2px;
        }
      }
      
      @layer base {
        /* The design is light-only; say so rather than following the OS preference. */
        html {
          color-scheme: light;
        }
      
        body {
          background-color: rgb(var(--dc-stock));
          color: rgb(var(--dc-ink));
        }
      
        /*
         * One visible focus ring for the whole system. Components do not repeat it
         * except where they paint their own background and need an offset colour.
         */
        :focus-visible {
          outline: var(--dc-focus-ring-width) solid rgb(var(--dc-riso-blue));
          outline-offset: var(--dc-focus-ring-offset);
        }
      }
      
      @layer utilities {
        /* Chrome, Safari and Opera */
        .no-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar {
          display: none;
        }
      
        .no-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
          background-color: transparent;
        }
      
        .no-scrollbar {
          -ms-overflow-style: none; /* IE and Edge */
          scrollbar-width: none; /* Firefox */
        }
      
        input:focus ~ label,
        input:not(:placeholder-shown) ~ label {
          @apply -translate-y-2 text-xsmall-regular;
        }
      
        input:focus ~ label {
          @apply left-0;
        }
      
        input:-webkit-autofill,
        input:-webkit-autofill:hover,
        input:-webkit-autofill:focus,
        textarea:-webkit-autofill,
        textarea:-webkit-autofill:hover,
        textarea:-webkit-autofill:focus,
        select:-webkit-autofill,
        select:-webkit-autofill:hover,
        select:-webkit-autofill:focus {
          border: 1px solid #212121;
          -webkit-text-fill-color: #212121;
          -webkit-box-shadow: 0 0 0px 1000px #fff inset;
          transition: background-color 5000s ease-in-out 0s;
        }
      
        input[type="search"]::-webkit-search-decoration,
        input[type="search"]::-webkit-search-cancel-button,
        input[type="search"]::-webkit-search-results-button,
        input[type="search"]::-webkit-search-results-decoration {
          -webkit-appearance: none;
        }
      }
      
      @layer components {
        .content-container {
          @apply max-w-[1440px] w-full mx-auto px-6;
        }
      
        .contrast-btn {
          @apply px-4 py-2 border border-black rounded-full hover:bg-black hover:text-white transition-colors duration-200 ease-in;
        }
      
        .text-xsmall-regular {
          @apply text-[10px] leading-4 font-normal;
        }
      
        .text-small-regular {
          @apply text-xs leading-5 font-normal;
        }
      
        .text-small-semi {
          @apply text-xs leading-5 font-semibold;
        }
      
        .text-base-regular {
          @apply text-sm leading-6 font-normal;
        }
      
        .text-base-semi {
          @apply text-sm leading-6 font-semibold;
        }
      
        .text-large-regular {
          @apply text-base leading-6 font-normal;
        }
      
        .text-large-semi {
          @apply text-base leading-6 font-semibold;
        }
      
        .text-xl-regular {
          @apply text-2xl leading-[36px] font-normal;
        }
      
        .text-xl-semi {
          @apply text-2xl leading-[36px] font-semibold;
        }
      
        .text-2xl-regular {
          @apply text-[30px] leading-[48px] font-normal;
        }
      
        .text-2xl-semi {
          @apply text-[30px] leading-[48px] font-semibold;
        }
      
        .text-3xl-regular {
          @apply text-[32px] leading-[44px] font-normal;
        }
      
        .text-3xl-semi {
          @apply text-[32px] leading-[44px] font-semibold;
        }
      }

  content: |
      import clsx from "clsx"
      import { ButtonHTMLAttributes, forwardRef } from "react"
      
      export type ButtonVariant = "primary" | "secondary"
      export type ButtonSize = "small" | "medium" | "large"
      
      export type ButtonProps = ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> & {
        variant?: ButtonVariant
        size?: ButtonSize
        /** Blocks the button and shows a spinner without shifting the layout. */
        loading?: boolean
      }
      
      /*
       * Colour choices are fixed by the contrast rules in docs/DESIGN.md §2.1:
       * `stock` on `riso-blue` is 4.53:1, so that pairing is the only blue fill.
       * `ink` is never placed on `riso-blue` (3.21:1).
       */
      const VARIANTS: Record<ButtonVariant, string> = {
        primary:
          "bg-riso-blue text-stock border border-riso-blue hover:bg-ink hover:border-ink " +
          "disabled:bg-riso-blue/40 disabled:border-transparent disabled:text-stock/80",
        secondary:
          "bg-transparent text-ink border border-ink hover:bg-ink hover:text-stock " +
          "disabled:border-ink/30 disabled:text-ink/40 disabled:hover:bg-transparent disabled:hover:text-ink/40",
      }
      
      const SIZES: Record<ButtonSize, string> = {
        small: "h-9 px-3 text-small",
        medium: "h-11 px-5 text-body",
        large: "h-14 px-7 text-lead",
      }
      
      const BASE =
        "inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-square font-sans font-semibold " +
        "transition-colors duration-150 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
      
      /**
       * The button look as a class string, for the places that need a button-shaped
       * *link* (`<a>` inside `<button>` is invalid markup). `Button` itself is built
       * from this, so a link styled with it cannot drift from the real button.
       */
      export const buttonClass = ({
        className,
        variant = "primary",
        size = "medium",
      }: {
        className?: string
        variant?: ButtonVariant
        size?: ButtonSize
      } = {}) => clsx(BASE, VARIANTS[variant], SIZES[size], className)
      
      export const Button = forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, ButtonProps>(
        (
          { className, variant = "primary", size = "medium", loading, disabled, children, ...props },
          ref
        ) => {
          return (
            <button
              ref={ref}
              type={props.type ?? "button"}
              // aria-busy tells assistive tech the action is running; `disabled` alone
              // just looks inert.
              aria-busy={loading || undefined}
              disabled={disabled || loading}
              className={buttonClass({ variant, size, className })}
              {...props}
            >
              {loading && (
                <span
                  aria-hidden="true"
                  className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 animate-spin rounded-full border-2 border-current border-t-transparent motion-reduce:animate-none"
                />
              )}
              {children}
            </button>
          )
        }
      )
      
      Button.displayName = "Button"
      
  referencedBy: {}

  content: |
      import clsx from "clsx"
      import { forwardRef, InputHTMLAttributes } from "react"
      
      export type InputProps = Omit<InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>, "id"> & {
        /** Required: the label is associated with the field through this id. */
        id: string
        label: string
        /** Guidance shown below the field when there is no error. */
        hint?: string
        /**
         * Error message. Rendered in ink, not pink: `riso-pink` is 3.13:1 on `stock`
         * (docs/DESIGN.md §2.1) so it may only mark, never carry words. The pink
         * border is the marker; this text says what went wrong.
         */
        error?: string
      }
      
      export const Input = forwardRef<HTMLInputElement, InputProps>(
        ({ className, id, label, hint, error, disabled, ...props }, ref) => {
          const hintId = hint ? `${id}-hint` : undefined
          const errorId = error ? `${id}-error` : undefined
          const describedBy = errorId ?? hintId
      
          return (
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
              <label htmlFor={id} className="text-small font-semibold text-ink">
                {label}
              </label>
      
              <input
                ref={ref}
                id={id}
                disabled={disabled}
                aria-invalid={error ? true : undefined}
                aria-describedby={describedBy}
                className={clsx(
                  "h-11 w-full rounded-square border bg-stock px-3 text-body text-ink",
                  "placeholder:text-ink/60",
                  "disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:border-ink/30 disabled:bg-ink/5 disabled:text-ink/40",
                  error ? "border-riso-pink" : "border-ink",
                  className
                )}
                {...props}
              />
      
              {hint && !error && (
                <p id={hintId} className="text-small text-ink">
                  {hint}
                </p>
              )}
      
              {error && (
                <p id={errorId} className="text-small text-ink">
                  {error}
                </p>
              )}
            </div>
          )
        }
      )
      
      Input.displayName = "Input"
      
  referencedBy: {}

      import clsx from "clsx"
      import { forwardRef, HTMLAttributes } from "react"
      
      export type RuleProps = HTMLAttributes<HTMLHRElement> & {
        /** `hairline` is the default divider; `heavy` closes a band. */
        weight?: "hairline" | "heavy"
      }
      
      /**
       * A horizontal rule is real structure in this design — it separates bands and
       * closes plates — so it always uses the ink plate, never a tinted grey.
       */
      export const Rule = forwardRef<HTMLHRElement, RuleProps>(
        ({ className, weight = "hairline", ...props }, ref) => {
          return (
            <hr
              ref={ref}
              className={clsx(
                "w-full border-0 border-t border-solid border-ink",
                weight === "heavy" && "border-t-2",
                className
              )}
              {...props}
            />
          )
        }
      )
      
      Rule.displayName = "Rule"
      
  referencedBy: {}

  content: |
      import clsx from "clsx"
      import { AnchorHTMLAttributes, forwardRef } from "react"
      
      /*
       * The link treatment, in one place. `riso-blue` on `stock` is 4.53:1, so it is
       * safe for inline text at any size (docs/DESIGN.md §2.1).
       *
       * The storefront navigates internally with `LocalizedClientLink`, which already
       * owns country-aware routing. Rather than replace it, export `linkClass` so a
       * localized link can carry the same look: `<LocalizedClientLink className={linkClass} />`.
       */
      export const linkClass =
        "text-riso-blue underline decoration-1 underline-offset-4 " +
        "hover:text-ink hover:decoration-2 transition-colors duration-150"
      
      export type LinkProps = AnchorHTMLAttributes<HTMLAnchorElement>
      
      /**
       * A presentational link. Use it for external hrefs and for markup that is not a
       * route; use `LocalizedClientLink` with `linkClass` for in-store navigation.
       */
      export const Link = forwardRef<HTMLAnchorElement, LinkProps>(
        ({ className, children, ...props }, ref) => {
          return (
            <a ref={ref} className={clsx(linkClass, className)} {...props}>
              {children}
            </a>
          )
        }
      )
      
      Link.displayName = "Link"
      
  referencedBy: {}

  content: |
      "use client"
      
      import { Badge, Heading, Input, Label, Text } from "@modules/common/components/ui"
      import React from "react"
      
      import { applyPromotions } from "@lib/data/cart"
      import { convertToLocale } from "@lib/util/money"
      import { HttpTypes } from "@medusajs/types"
      import Trash from "@modules/common/icons/trash"
      import ErrorMessage from "../error-message"
      import { SubmitButton } from "../submit-button"
      
      type DiscountCodeProps = {
        cart: HttpTypes.StoreCart
      }
      
      const DiscountCode: React.FC<DiscountCodeProps> = ({ cart }) => {
        const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = React.useState(false)
        const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = React.useState("")
      
        const { promotions = [] } = cart
        const removePromotionCode = async (code: string) => {
          const validPromotions = promotions.filter(
            (promotion) => promotion.code !== code
          )
      
          await applyPromotions(
            validPromotions.filter((p) => p.code !== undefined).map((p) => p.code!)
          )
        }
      
        const addPromotionCode = async (formData: FormData) => {
          setErrorMessage("")
      
          const code = formData.get("code")
          if (!code) {
            return
          }
          const input = document.getElementById("promotion-input") as HTMLInputElement
          const codes = promotions
            .filter((p) => p.code !== undefined)
            .map((p) => p.code!)
          codes.push(code.toString())
      
          try {
            await applyPromotions(codes)
          } catch (e) {
            setErrorMessage(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e))
          }
      
          if (input) {
            input.value = ""
          }
        }
      
        return (
          <div className="w-full bg-white flex flex-col">
            <div className="txt-medium">
              <form action={(a) => addPromotionCode(a)} className="w-full mb-5">
                <Label className="flex gap-x-1 my-2 items-center">
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setIsOpen(!isOpen)}
                    type="button"
                    className="txt-medium text-ui-fg-interactive hover:text-ui-fg-interactive-hover"
                    data-testid="add-discount-button"
                  >
                    Add Promotion Code(s)
                  </button>
      
                  {/* <Tooltip content="You can add multiple promotion codes">
                    <InformationCircleSolid color="var(--fg-muted)" />
                  </Tooltip> */}
                </Label>
      
                {isOpen && (
                  <>
                    <div className="flex w-full gap-x-2">
                      <Input
                        className="size-full"
                        id="promotion-input"
                        name="code"
                        type="text"
                        autoFocus={false}
                        data-testid="discount-input"
                      />
                      <SubmitButton
                        variant="secondary"
                        data-testid="discount-apply-button"
                      >
                        Apply
                      </SubmitButton>
                    </div>
      
                    <ErrorMessage
                      error={errorMessage}
                      data-testid="discount-error-message"
                    />
                  </>
                )}
              </form>
      
              {promotions.length > 0 && (
                <div className="w-full flex items-center">
                  <div className="flex flex-col w-full">
                    <Heading className="txt-medium mb-2">
                      Promotion(s) applied:
                    </Heading>
      
                    {promotions.map((promotion) => {
                      return (
                        <div
                          key={promotion.id}
                          className="flex items-center justify-between w-full max-w-full mb-2"
                          data-testid="discount-row"
                        >
                          <Text className="flex gap-x-1 items-baseline txt-small-plus w-4/5 pr-1">
                            <span className="truncate" data-testid="discount-code">
                              <Badge
                                color={promotion.is_automatic ? "green" : "grey"}
                              >
                                {promotion.code}
                              </Badge>{" "}
                              (
                              {promotion.application_method?.value !== undefined &&
                                promotion.application_method.currency_code !==
                                  undefined && (
                                  <>
                                    {promotion.application_method.type ===
                                    "percentage"
                                      ? `${promotion.application_method.value}%`
                                      : convertToLocale({
                                          amount: +promotion.application_method.value,
                                          currency_code:
                                            promotion.application_method
                                              .currency_code,
                                        })}
                                  </>
                                )}
                              )
                              {/* {promotion.is_automatic && (
                                <Tooltip content="This promotion is automatically applied">
                                  <InformationCircleSolid className="inline text-zinc-400" />
                                </Tooltip>
                              )} */}
                            </span>
                          </Text>
                          {!promotion.is_automatic && (
                            <button
                              className="flex items-center"
                              onClick={() => {
                                if (!promotion.code) {
                                  return
                                }
      
                                removePromotionCode(promotion.code)
                              }}
                              data-testid="remove-discount-button"
                            >
                              <Trash size={14} />
                              <span className="sr-only">
                                Remove discount code from order
                              </span>
                            </button>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      )
                    })}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        )
      }
      
      export default DiscountCode
      
  referencedBy: {}

  content: |
      import { ChevronUpDown } from "@medusajs/icons"
      import { clx } from "@modules/common/components/ui"
      import {
        SelectHTMLAttributes,
        forwardRef,
        useEffect,
        useImperativeHandle,
        useRef,
        useState,
      } from "react"
      
      export type NativeSelectProps = {
        placeholder?: string
        errors?: Record<string, unknown>
        touched?: Record<string, unknown>
      } & SelectHTMLAttributes<HTMLSelectElement>
      
      const NativeSelect = forwardRef<HTMLSelectElement, NativeSelectProps>(
        (
          { placeholder = "Select...", defaultValue, className, children, ...props },
          ref
        ) => {
          const innerRef = useRef<HTMLSelectElement>(null)
          const [isPlaceholder, setIsPlaceholder] = useState(false)
      
          useImperativeHandle<HTMLSelectElement | null, HTMLSelectElement | null>(
            ref,
            () => innerRef.current
          )
      
          useEffect(() => {
            if (innerRef.current && innerRef.current.value === "") {
              setIsPlaceholder(true)
            } else {
              setIsPlaceholder(false)
            }
          }, [innerRef.current?.value])
      
          return (
            <div>
              <div
                onFocus={() => innerRef.current?.focus()}
                onBlur={() => innerRef.current?.blur()}
                className={clx(
                  "relative flex items-center text-base-regular border border-ui-border-base bg-ui-bg-subtle rounded-md hover:bg-ui-bg-field-hover",
                  className,
                  {
                    "text-ui-fg-muted": isPlaceholder,
                  }

      "use client"
      
      import { Button } from "@modules/common/components/ui"
      import React from "react"
      import { useFormStatus } from "react-dom"
      
      export function SubmitButton({
        children,
        variant = "primary",
        size = "medium",
        className,
        "data-testid": dataTestId,
      }: {
        children: React.ReactNode
        variant?: "primary" | "secondary" | "transparent" | null
        size?: "small" | "medium" | "large"
        className?: string
        "data-testid"?: string
      }) {
        const { pending } = useFormStatus()
      
        return (
          <Button
            size={size}
            className={className}
            type="submit"
            isLoading={pending}
            variant={variant || "primary"}
            data-testid={dataTestId}
          >
            {children}
          </Button>
        )
      }

- path: apps/storefront/src/modules/common/components/cart-totals/index.tsx
  content: |
      "use client"
      
      import { convertToLocale } from "@lib/util/money"
      import { Rule } from "@modules/design-system"
      import React from "react"
      
      type CartTotalsProps = {
        totals: {
          total?: number | null
          subtotal?: number | null
          tax_total?: number | null
          currency_code: string
          item_subtotal?: number | null
          shipping_subtotal?: number | null
          discount_subtotal?: number | null
        }
      }
      
      /**
       * The money breakdown, shared by the cart, checkout and order pages. Amounts are
       * mono so the columns line up down the page — this is machine data, which is
       * exactly what docs/DESIGN.md reserves the mono face for.
       */
      const CartTotals: React.FC<CartTotalsProps> = ({ totals }) => {
        const {
          currency_code,
          total,
          tax_total,
          item_subtotal,
          shipping_subtotal,
          discount_subtotal,
        } = totals
      
        const amount = (value?: number | null) =>
          convertToLocale({ amount: value ?? 0, currency_code })
      
        return (
          <div data-testid="cart-totals">
            <dl className="flex flex-col gap-2 text-small text-ink">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
                <dt>Subtotal (excl. shipping and taxes)</dt>
                <dd className="font-mono" data-testid="cart-subtotal" data-value={item_subtotal || 0}>
                  {amount(item_subtotal)}
                </dd>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
                <dt>Shipping</dt>
                <dd className="font-mono" data-testid="cart-shipping" data-value={shipping_subtotal || 0}>
                  {amount(shipping_subtotal)}
                </dd>
              </div>
              {!!discount_subtotal && (
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
                  <dt>Discount</dt>
                  <dd
                    className="font-mono text-riso-green"
                    data-testid="cart-discount"
                    data-value={discount_subtotal || 0}
                  >
                    -{amount(Math.abs(discount_subtotal))}
                  </dd>
                </div>
              )}
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
                <dt>Taxes</dt>
                <dd className="font-mono" data-testid="cart-taxes" data-value={tax_total || 0}>
                  {amount(tax_total)}
                </dd>
              </div>
            </dl>
      
            <Rule className="my-4" weight="heavy" />
      
            <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between gap-4">
              <span className="text-body font-semibold">Total</span>
              <span
                className="font-mono text-lead"
                data-testid="cart-total"
                data-value={total || 0}
              >
                {amount(total)}
              </span>
            </div>
      
            <Rule className="mt-4" />
          </div>
        )
      }
      
      export default CartTotals
      
  referencedBy: {}
```

  content: |
      "use client"
      
      import { Input } from "@modules/design-system"
      import React from "react"
      
      import { applyPromotions } from "@lib/data/cart"
      import { convertToLocale } from "@lib/util/money"
      import { HttpTypes } from "@medusajs/types"
      import Trash from "@modules/common/icons/trash"
      import ErrorMessage from "../error-message"
      import { SubmitButton } from "../submit-button"
      
      type DiscountCodeProps = {
        cart: HttpTypes.StoreCart
      }
      
      const DiscountCode: React.FC<DiscountCodeProps> = ({ cart }) => {
        const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = React.useState(false)
        const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = React.useState("")
      
        const { promotions = [] } = cart
        const removePromotionCode = async (code: string) => {
          const validPromotions = promotions.filter(
            (promotion) => promotion.code !== code
          )
      
          await applyPromotions(
            validPromotions.filter((p) => p.code !== undefined).map((p) => p.code!)
          )
        }
      
        const addPromotionCode = async (formData: FormData) => {
          setErrorMessage("")
      
          const code = formData.get("code")
          if (!code) {
            return
          }
          const input = document.getElementById("promotion-input") as HTMLInputElement
          const codes = promotions
            .filter((p) => p.code !== undefined)
            .map((p) => p.code!)
          codes.push(code.toString())
      
          try {
            await applyPromotions(codes)
          } catch (e) {
            setErrorMessage(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e))
          }
      
          if (input) {
            input.value = ""
          }
        }
      
        return (
          <div className="flex w-full flex-col">
            <form action={(a) => addPromotionCode(a)} className="mb-5 w-full">
              <div className="my-2 flex items-center gap-x-1">
                <button
                  onClick={() => setIsOpen(!isOpen)}
                  type="button"
                  className="text-small font-semibold text-riso-blue underline decoration-1 underline-offset-4 transition-colors duration-150 hover:text-ink"
                  data-testid="add-discount-button"
                >
                  Add Promotion Code(s)
                </button>
              </div>
      
              {isOpen && (
                <>
                  <div className="flex w-full items-end gap-x-2">
                    {/* The field grows; the button keeps its own width. */}
                    <div className="flex-1">
                      <Input
                        id="promotion-input"
                        label="Promotion code(s)"
                        name="code"
                        type="text"
                        autoFocus={false}
                        data-testid="discount-input"
                      />
                    </div>
                    <SubmitButton
                      variant="secondary"
                      data-testid="discount-apply-button"
                    >
                      Apply
                    </SubmitButton>
                  </div>
      
                  <ErrorMessage
                    error={errorMessage}
                    data-testid="discount-error-message"
                  />
                </>
              )}
            </form>
      
            {promotions.length > 0 && (
              <div className="flex w-full items-center">
                <div className="flex w-full flex-col">
                  <h3 className="mb-2 text-small font-semibold text-ink">
                    Promotion(s) applied:
                  </h3>
      
                  {promotions.map((promotion) => {
                    return (
                      <div
                        key={promotion.id}
                        className="mb-2 flex w-full max-w-full items-center justify-between"
                        data-testid="discount-row"
                      >
                        <span className="flex w-4/5 items-baseline gap-x-1 pr-1 text-small text-ink">
                          <span className="truncate" data-testid="discount-code">
                            <span
                              className={
                                "border px-2 py-0.5 font-mono text-micro " +
                                (promotion.is_automatic
                                  ? "border-riso-green text-riso-green"
                                  : "border-ink text-ink")
                              }
                            >
                              {promotion.code}
                            </span>{" "}
                            (
                            {promotion.application_method?.value !== undefined &&
                              promotion.application_method.currency_code !==
                                undefined && (
                                <>
                                  {promotion.application_method.type === "percentage"
                                    ? `${promotion.application_method.value}%`
                                    : convertToLocale({
                                        amount: +promotion.application_method.value,
                                        currency_code:
                                          promotion.application_method.currency_code,
                                      })}
                                </>
                              )}
                            )
                          </span>
                        </span>
                        {!promotion.is_automatic && (
                          <button
                            className="flex items-center"
                            onClick={() => {
                              if (!promotion.code) {
                                return
                              }
      
                              removePromotionCode(promotion.code)
                            }}
                            data-testid="remove-discount-button"
                          >
                            <Trash size={14} />
                            <span className="sr-only">
                              Remove discount code from order
                            </span>
                          </button>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    )
                  })}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )
      }
      
      export default DiscountCode

- path: apps/storefront/src/modules/common/components/native-select/index.tsx
  content: |
      import { ChevronUpDown } from "@medusajs/icons"
      import clsx from "clsx"
      import {
        SelectHTMLAttributes,
        forwardRef,
        useEffect,
        useImperativeHandle,
        useRef,
        useState,
      } from "react"
      
      export type NativeSelectProps = {
        placeholder?: string
        errors?: Record<string, unknown>
        touched?: Record<string, unknown>
      } & SelectHTMLAttributes<HTMLSelectElement>
      
      const NativeSelect = forwardRef<HTMLSelectElement, NativeSelectProps>(
        (
          { placeholder = "Select...", defaultValue, className, children, ...props },
          ref
        ) => {
          const innerRef = useRef<HTMLSelectElement>(null)
          const [isPlaceholder, setIsPlaceholder] = useState(false)
      
          useImperativeHandle<HTMLSelectElement | null, HTMLSelectElement | null>(
            ref,
            () => innerRef.current
          )
      
          useEffect(() => {
            if (innerRef.current && innerRef.current.value === "") {
              setIsPlaceholder(true)
            } else {
              setIsPlaceholder(false)
            }
          }, [innerRef.current?.value])
      
          return (
            <div>
              <div
                onFocus={() => innerRef.current?.focus()}
                onBlur={() => innerRef.current?.blur()}
                className={clsx(
                  "relative flex items-center border border-ink bg-stock text-body",
                  className
                )}
              >
                <select
                  ref={innerRef}
                  defaultValue={defaultValue}
                  {...props}
                  className={clsx(
                    "flex-1 appearance-none border-none bg-transparent px-3 py-2.5 pr-9 text-body transition-colors duration-150 outline-none",
                    // The placeholder is a disabled option, so the empty value is
                    // what tells us to mute the closed select.
                    isPlaceholder ? "text-ink/60" : "text-ink"
                  )}
                >
                  <option disabled value="">
                    {placeholder}
                  </option>
                  {children}
                </select>
                <span className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-y-0 right-4 flex items-center text-ink">
                  <ChevronUpDown />
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          )
        }
      )
      
      NativeSelect.displayName = "NativeSelect"
      
      export default NativeSelect

What each step collects lives on the cart, so completion is\n * read from the cart rather than tracked separately — that is what lets someone\n * go back, change a step and keep everything they entered after it.\n */\nexport type CheckoutStepId =\n  | \"contact\"\n  | \"address\"\n  | \"delivery\"\n  | \"payment\"\n  | \"review\"\n\nexport type CheckoutStep = {\n  id: CheckoutStepId\n  label: string\n}\n\nexport const CHECKOUT_STEPS: CheckoutStep[] = [\n  { id: \"contact\", label: \"Contact\" },\n  { id: \"address\", label: \"Address\" },\n  { id: \"delivery\", label: \"Delivery\" },\n  { id: \"payment\", label: \"Payment\" },\n  { id: \"review\", label: \"Review\" },\n]\n\nconst STEP_IDS = CHECKOUT_STEPS.map((step) => step.id)\n\nexport const isCheckoutStepId = (value: unknown): value is CheckoutStepId =>\n  typeof value === \"string\" && STEP_IDS.includes(value as CheckoutStepId)\n\n/**\n * Whether the data a step collects is on the cart. `review` collects nothing —\n * it confirms what the earlier steps gathered — so it is never \"complete\" and\n * never holds anyone back.\n */\nexport function isStepComplete(\n  cart: HttpTypes.StoreCart,\n  step: CheckoutStepId\n): boolean {\n  switch (step) {\n    case \"contact\":\n      return Boolean(cart.email)\n    case \"address\":\n      return (\n        Boolean(cart.shipping_address?.address_1) &&\n        Boolean(cart.billing_address?.address_1)\n      )\n    case \"delivery\":\n      return (cart.shipping_methods?.length ?? 0) > 0\n    case \"payment\":\n      return Boolean(cart.payment_collection?.payment_sessions?.length)\n    case \"review\":\n      return false\n  }\n}\n\n/** The step a customer belongs on: the first one still missing its data. */\nexport function firstIncompleteStep(cart: HttpTypes.StoreCart): CheckoutStepId {\n  return (\n    CHECKOUT_STEPS.find((step) => !isStepComplete(cart, step.id))?.id ?? \"review\"\n  )\n}\n\n/**\n * A step can be opened when every step before it is complete. This is what\n * stops a hand-typed or stale URL from skipping payment details, and it still\n * lets a customer walk back to any step they have already filled in.\n */\nexport function isStepReachable(\n  cart: HttpTypes.StoreCart,\n  step: CheckoutStepId\n): boolean {\n  const index = STEP_IDS.indexOf(step)\n\n  return CHECKOUT_STEPS.slice(0, index).every((earlier) =>\n    isStepComplete(cart, earlier.id)\n  )\n}\n\n/** Resolves a requested step to a usable one, falling back to where they are. */\nexport function resolveCheckoutStep(\n  cart: HttpTypes.StoreCart,\n  requested: unknown\n): CheckoutStepId {\n  if (isCheckoutStepId(requested) && isStepReachable(cart, requested)) {\n    return requested\n  }\n\n  return firstIncompleteStep(cart)\n}\n\n/** The step before `step`, for a \"back\" control. */\nexport function previousStep(step: CheckoutStepId): CheckoutStepId | null {\n  const index = STEP_IDS.indexOf(step)\n\n  return index > 0 ? CHECKOUT_STEPS[index - 1].id : null\n}\n"
}

      import { HttpTypes } from "@medusajs/types"
      import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server"
      
      const BACKEND_URL = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_MEDUSA_BACKEND_URL
      const PUBLISHABLE_API_KEY = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_MEDUSA_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
      const DEFAULT_REGION = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_DEFAULT_REGION || "dk"
      
      const regionMapCache = {
        regionMap: new Map<string, HttpTypes.StoreRegion>(),
        regionMapUpdated: Date.now(),
      }
      
      async function getRegionMap(cacheId: string) {
        const { regionMap, regionMapUpdated } = regionMapCache
      
        if (!BACKEND_URL) {
          throw new Error(
            "Middleware.ts: Error fetching regions. Did you set up regions in your Medusa Admin and define a NEXT_PUBLIC_MEDUSA_BACKEND_URL environment variable."
          )
        }
      
        if (
          !regionMap.keys().next().value ||
          regionMapUpdated < Date.now() - 3600 * 1000
        ) {
          // Fetch regions from Medusa. We can't use the JS client here because middleware is running on Edge and the client needs a Node environment.
          const response = await fetch(`${BACKEND_URL}/store/regions`, {
            method: "GET",
            headers: {
              "x-publishable-api-key": PUBLISHABLE_API_KEY!,
            },
            next: {
              revalidate: 3600,
              tags: [`regions-${cacheId}`],
            },
            cache: "force-cache",
          })
      
          if (!response.ok) {
            throw new Error(`Backend returned ${response.status}`)
          }
      
          const json = await response.json()
      
          const { regions } = json
      
          if (!regions?.length) {
            return new Map<string, HttpTypes.StoreRegion>()
          }
      
          // Create a map of country codes to regions.
          regions.forEach((region: HttpTypes.StoreRegion) => {
            region.countries?.forEach((c) => {
              regionMapCache.regionMap.set(c.iso_2 ?? "", region)
            })
          })
      
          regionMapCache.regionMapUpdated = Date.now()
        }
      
        return regionMapCache.regionMap
      }
      
      /**
       * Fetches regions from Medusa and sets the region cookie.
       * @param request
       * @param response
       */
      async function getCountryCode(
        request: NextRequest,
        regionMap: Map<string, HttpTypes.StoreRegion | number>
      ) {
        let countryCode
      
        const urlCountryCode = request.nextUrl.pathname.split("/")[1]?.toLowerCase()
      
        // Cloudflare Workers provides country via request.cf.country
        const cloudflareCountryCode = (request as { cf?: { country?: string } }).cf?.country?.toLowerCase()
      
        // Vercel provides x-vercel-ip-country header
        const vercelCountryCode = request.headers
          .get("x-vercel-ip-country")
          ?.toLowerCase()
      
        if (urlCountryCode && regionMap.has(urlCountryCode)) {
          countryCode = urlCountryCode
        } else if (cloudflareCountryCode && regionMap.has(cloudflareCountryCode)) {
          countryCode = cloudflareCountryCode
        } else if (vercelCountryCode && regionMap.has(vercelCountryCode)) {
          countryCode = vercelCountryCode
        } else if (regionMap.has(DEFAULT_REGION)) {
          countryCode = DEFAULT_REGION
        } else if (regionMap.keys().next().value) {
          countryCode = regionMap.keys().next().value
        }
      
        return countryCode
      }
      
      /**
       * Middleware to handle region selection and onboarding status.
       */
      export async function middleware(request: NextRequest) {
        if (request.nextUrl.pathname.includes(".")) {
          return NextResponse.next()
        }
      
        const cacheIdCookie = request.cookies.get("_medusa_cache_id")
        const cacheId = cacheIdCookie?.value || crypto.randomUUID()
      
        const regionMap = await getRegionMap(cacheId)
        const countryCode = await getCountryCode(request, regionMap)
      
        // if the country code is available, use it, otherwise use the default region
        const country = countryCode || DEFAULT_REGION
        const firstPathSegment = request.nextUrl.pathname.split("/")[1]?.toLowerCase()
        const urlHasCountry = firstPathSegment === country.toLowerCase()
      
        if (urlHasCountry) {
          if (!cacheIdCookie) {
            const response = NextResponse.next()
            response.cookies.set("_medusa_cache_id", cacheId, {
              maxAge: 60 * 60 * 24,
            })
            return response
          }
          return NextResponse.next()
        }
      
        // if the url doesn't have the country, redirect to it
        const redirectPath =
          request.nextUrl.pathname === "/" ? "" : request.nextUrl.pathname
        const queryString = request.nextUrl.search || ""
        const redirectUrl = `${request.nextUrl.origin}/${country}${redirectPath}${queryString}`
      
        return NextResponse.redirect(redirectUrl, 307)
      }
      
      export const config = {
        matcher: [
          "/((?!api|_next/static|_next/image|favicon.ico|images|assets|png|svg|jpg|jpeg|gif|webp).*)",
        ],
      }

- path: apps/storefront/src/lib/util/medusa-error.ts
  content: |
      /*
       * The SDK throws a `FetchError extends Error` that keeps the API's message and
       * status but drops the error `code` (see @medusajs/js-sdk's client), so these
       * translations key off Medusa's wording rather than a code.
       *
       * The API's own copy says what broke, not what to do about it, which is what
       * docs/DESIGN.md §5.6 asks an error to say.
       */
      const CUSTOMER_MESSAGES: { match: RegExp; message: string }[] = [
        {
          match: /does not have the required inventory/i,
          message:
            "There isn't enough stock left for that quantity. Lower it and try again.",
        },
        {
          match: /failed to fetch|fetch failed|network/i,
          message: "Could not reach the store. Check your connection and try again.",
        },
      ]
      
      /**
       * What to show the customer for a failed request.
       *
       * Server actions have to *return* this rather than throw it: a production build
       * replaces a thrown error from a server action with "An error occurred in the
       * Server Components render. The specific message is omitted in production
       * builds", so a thrown message never reaches the customer (measured on K1's
       * rejected quantity change).
       */
      export default function medusaErrorMessage(error: unknown): string {
        const message =
          error instanceof Error && error.message ? error.message : ""
        const status = (error as { status?: number })?.status
      
        if (!message) {
          console.error("Store API request failed:", error)
          return "Something went wrong. Try again."
        }
      
        console.error(
          `Store API request failed${status ? ` (${status})` : ""}: ${message}`
        )
      
        const translation = CUSTOMER_MESSAGES.find((entry) =>
          entry.match.test(message)
        )
      
        if (translation) {
          return translation.message
        }
      
        return message.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + message.slice(1) + "."
      }
      
      /**
       * The throwing form, for the flows whose caller is a `try`/`catch` around a
       * server action that returns state (checkout, account, orders). Anything a
       * customer reads on a page should use the returned-message form instead.
       */
      export function medusaError(error: unknown): never {
        throw new Error(medusaErrorMessage(error))
      }
      
  referencedBy: {}

  content: |
      "use client"
      
      import Link from "next/link"
      import { useParams } from "next/navigation"
      import React, { forwardRef } from "react"
      
      /**
       * Use this component to create a Next.js `<Link />` that persists the current country code in the url,
       * without having to explicitly pass it as a prop.
       *
       * The ref is forwarded to the anchor so the link can stand in as a headless UI
       * trigger (`PopoverButton as={LocalizedClientLink}`), which needs to hold a ref
       * to manage focus.
       */
      type LocalizedClientLinkProps = Omit<
        React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof Link>,
        "href"
      > & { href: string }
      
      const LocalizedClientLink = forwardRef<
        HTMLAnchorElement,
        LocalizedClientLinkProps
      >(({ children, href, ...props }, ref) => {
        const { countryCode } = useParams()
      
        return (
          <Link ref={ref} href={`/${countryCode}${href}`} {...props}>
            {children}
          </Link>
        )
      })
      
      LocalizedClientLink.displayName = "LocalizedClientLink"
      
      export default LocalizedClientLink
      
  referencedBy: {}
- path: apps/storefront/src/modules/design-system/components/link/index.tsx
  content: |
      import clsx from "clsx"
      import { AnchorHTMLAttributes, forwardRef } from "react"
      
      /*
       * The link treatment, in one place. `riso-blue` on `stock` is 4.53:1, so it is
       * safe for inline text at any size (docs/DESIGN.md §2.1).
       *
       * The storefront navigates internally with `LocalizedClientLink`, which already
       * owns country-aware routing. Rather than replace it, export `linkClass` so a
       * localized link can carry the same look: `<LocalizedClientLink className={linkClass} />`.
       */
      export const linkClass =
        "text-riso-blue underline decoration-1 underline-offset-4 " +
        "hover:text-ink hover:decoration-2 transition-colors duration-150"
      
      export type LinkProps = AnchorHTMLAttributes<HTMLAnchorElement>
      
      /**
       * A presentational link. Use it for external hrefs and for markup that is not a
       * route; use `LocalizedClientLink` with `linkClass` for in-store navigation.
       */
      export const Link = forwardRef<HTMLAnchorElement, LinkProps>(
        ({ className, children, ...props }, ref) => {
          return (
            <a ref={ref} className={clsx(linkClass, className)} {...props}>
              {children}
            </a>
          )
        }
      )
      
      Link.displayName = "Link"
      
  referencedBy: {}

  content: |
      import { Metadata } from "next"
      
      import { listCategories } from "@lib/data/categories"
      import { listCollections } from "@lib/data/collections"
      import { listProducts } from "@lib/data/products"
      import { getRegion } from "@lib/data/regions"
      import LocalizedClientLink from "@modules/common/components/localized-client-link"
      import FeaturedProducts from "@modules/home/components/featured-products"
      import Hero from "@modules/home/components/hero"
      
      export const metadata: Metadata = {
        title: "Home",
        description: "Merchandise for people who build software.",
      }
      
      export default async function Home(props: {
        params: Promise<{ countryCode: string }>
      }) {
        const { countryCode } = await props.params
      
        try {
          const region = await getRegion(countryCode)
      
          if (!region) {
            return (
              <HomeError message="This country is not available yet. Choose another region from the menu." />
            )
          }
      
          const [categories, { collections }, featuredData] = await Promise.all([
              listCategories({ limit: 100, fields: "id, name, handle" }),
              listCollections({ fields: "id, handle, title" }),
              listProducts({
                countryCode,
                queryParams: { limit: 1, fields: "id, title, handle, thumbnail" },
              }),
            ])
      
          const featuredProduct = featuredData.response.products[0]
      
          return (
            <>
              <Hero product={featuredProduct} />
      
              <section
                aria-labelledby="categories-heading"
                className="content-container border-b border-ink/20 py-10 small:py-14"
              >
                <div className="mb-5 flex flex-wrap items-baseline justify-between gap-3">
                  <h2
                    id="categories-heading"
                    className="font-display text-h2 font-bold tracking-tight"
                  >
                    Browse by category
                  </h2>
                  <LocalizedClientLink
                    href="/store"
                    className="text-riso-blue underline underline-offset-4"
                  >
                    View all products
                  </LocalizedClientLink>
                </div>
                {categories.length ? (
                  <ul className="grid grid-cols-2 border-l border-t border-ink/20 small:grid-cols-3 medium:grid-cols-5">
                    {categories.map((category) => (
                      <li key={category.id} className="border-b border-r border-ink/20">
                        <LocalizedClientLink
                          href={`/categories/${category.handle}`}
                          className="group flex min-h-16 items-center justify-between gap-3 px-4 py-3 font-semibold transition-colors hover:bg-riso-blue hover:text-stock focus-visible:bg-riso-blue focus-visible:text-stock"
                        >
                          <span>{category.name}</span>
                          <span
                            aria-hidden="true"
                            className="text-riso-blue group-hover:text-stock group-focus-visible:text-stock"
                          >
                            ↗
                          </span>
                        </LocalizedClientLink>
                      </li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                ) : (
                  <p className="border-y border-ink/20 py-5 text-ink/75">
                    Categories are being prepared. Browse the full catalogue instead.
                  </p>
                )}
              </section>
      
              <section aria-label="Featured products">
                {collections.length ? (
                  <FeaturedProducts collections={collections} region={region} />
                ) : (
                  <div className="content-container border-b border-ink/20 py-12">
                    <h2 className="font-display text-h2 font-bold">New this drop</h2>
                    <p className="mt-3 text-ink/75">
                      There are no featured products yet. Browse the full catalogue.
                    </p>
                    <LocalizedClientLink
                      className="mt-4 inline-flex text-riso-blue underline underline-offset-4"
                      href="/store"
                    >
                      Shop all products
                    </LocalizedClientLink>
                  </div>
                )}
              </section>
      
              <section
                aria-labelledby="collections-heading"
                className="content-container border-y border-ink/20 py-10 small:py-14"
              >
                <div className="mb-5 flex flex-wrap items-baseline justify-between gap-3">
                  <h2
                    id="collections-heading"
                    className="font-display text-h2 font-bold tracking-tight"
                  >
                    Shop the collections
                  </h2>
                  <span className="text-ink/75">Small runs, selected by theme</span>
                </div>
                {collections.length ? (
                  <ul className="grid grid-cols-1 border-l border-t border-ink/20 small:grid-cols-3">
                    {collections.map((collection) => (
                      <li
                        key={collection.id}
                        className="border-b border-r border-ink/20"
                      >
                        <LocalizedClientLink
                          href={`/collections/${collection.handle}`}
                          className="group flex min-h-28 flex-col justify-between gap-3 p-5 transition-colors hover:bg-riso-blue hover:text-stock focus-visible:bg-riso-blue focus-visible:text-stock"
                        >
                          <span className="font-display text-h3 font-bold">
                            {collection.title}
                          </span>
                          <span className="text-riso-blue underline underline-offset-4 group-hover:text-stock group-focus-visible:text-stock">
                            Browse collection
                          </span>
                        </LocalizedClientLink>
                      </li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                ) : (
                  <p className="border-y border-ink/20 py-5 text-ink/75">
                    Collections are being prepared. New items will appear in the store.
                  </p>
                )}
              </section>
            </>
          )
        } catch (error) {
          console.error("Failed to load the DevCart homepage", error)
      
          return (
            <HomeError message="The catalogue could not be loaded. Refresh the page to try again." />
          )
        }
      }
      
      function HomeError({ message }: { message: string }) {
        return (
          <div
            role="alert"
            className="content-container border-b border-ink/20 py-16 small:py-24"
          >
            <h1 className="font-display text-h1 font-bold">The store is unavailable</h1>
            <p className="mt-3 max-w-prose text-ink/75">{message}</p>
            <LocalizedClientLink
              href="/store"
              className="mt-5 inline-flex text-riso-blue underline underline-offset-4"
            >
              Browse all products
            </LocalizedClientLink>
          </div>
        )
      }

- path: apps/storefront/src/lib/hooks/use-toggle-state.tsx
  content: |
      import { useState } from "react"
      
      export type StateType = [boolean, () => void, () => void, () => void] & {
        state: boolean
        open: () => void
        close: () => void
        toggle: () => void
      }
      
      /**
       *
       * @param initialState - boolean
       * @returns An array like object with `state`, `open`, `close`, and `toggle` properties
       *  to allow both object and array destructuring
       *
       * ```
       *  const [showModal, openModal, closeModal, toggleModal] = useToggleState()
       *  // or
       *  const { state, open, close, toggle } = useToggleState()
       * ```
       */
      
      const useToggleState = (initialState = false) => {
        const [state, setState] = useState<boolean>(initialState)
      
        const close = () => {
          setState(false)
        }
      
        const open = () => {
          setState(true)
        }
      
        const toggle = () => {
          setState((state) => !state)
        }
      
        const hookData = [state, open, close, toggle] as StateType
        hookData.state = state
        hookData.open = open
        hookData.close = close
        hookData.toggle = toggle
        return hookData
      }
      
      export default useToggleState
      
  referencedBy: {}

  "instructions": "Add the shared stepped-section shell used by every checkout step.",
  "content": "import { CheckCircleSolid } from \"@medusajs/icons\"\nimport LocalizedClientLink from \"@modules/common/components/localized-client-link\"\nimport { linkClass, Rule } from \"@modules/design-system\"\nimport type { ReactNode } from \"react\"\n\nimport type { CheckoutStepId } from \"../../lib/steps\"\n\ntype StepSectionProps = {\n  id: CheckoutStepId\n  /** Position in the sequence, from one. */\n  number: number\n  title: string\n  isOpen: boolean\n  complete: boolean\n  children: ReactNode\n}\n\n/**\n * One step of the checkout: a numbered heading, the step's own content, and a\n * closing rule. Every step is built from this shell so the chrome cannot drift\n * between them, and so \"closed\" always means the same thing — the step has been\n * answered and can be reopened by clicking it in the stepper or its Edit link.\n */\nconst StepSection = ({\n  id,\n  number,\n  title,\n  isOpen,\n  complete,\n  children,\n}: StepSectionProps) => (\n  <section\n    aria-labelledby={`checkout-step-heading-${id}`}\n    data-testid={`checkout-step-${id}`}\n    data-state={isOpen ? \"open\" : \"closed\"}\n  >\n    <div className=\"flex flex-wrap items-baseline justify-between gap-x-4 gap-y-1\">\n      <h2\n        id={`checkout-step-heading-${id}`}\n        className=\"flex items-baseline gap-2 font-display text-h3 font-bold\"\n      >\n        <span aria-hidden=\"true\" className=\"font-mono text-micro text-ink/60\">\n          {String(number).padStart(2, \"0\")}\n        </span>\n        {title}\n      </h2>\n\n      {complete && !isOpen && (\n        <LocalizedClientLink\n          href={`/checkout?step=${id}`}\n          scroll={false}\n          className={`${linkClass} inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-small`}\n          data-testid={`edit-${id}-step`}\n        >\n          <CheckCircleSolid className=\"h-4 w-4\" />\n          Edit\n        </LocalizedClientLink>\n      )}\n    </div>\n\n    <div className=\"pt-4\">{children}</div>\n\n    <Rule className=\"mt-8\" />\n  </section>\n)\n\nexport default StepSection\n"
}

  "content": "import { CheckCircleSolid } from \"@medusajs/icons\"\nimport LocalizedClientLink from \"@modules/common/components/localized-client-link\"\nimport { HttpTypes } from \"@medusajs/types\"\nimport clsx from \"clsx\"\n\nimport {\n  CHECKOUT_STEPS,\n  isStepComplete,\n  isStepReachable,\n  type CheckoutStepId,\n} from \"../../lib/steps\"\n\n/**\n * The sequence, as links. (\n              <LocalizedClientLink\n                href={`/checkout?step=${step.id}`}\n                scroll={false}\n                aria-current={isCurrent ? \"step\" : undefined}\n                className={clsx(\n                  itemClass,\n                  !isCurrent && \"hover:text-riso-blue\"\n                )}\n              >\n                {marker}\n              </LocalizedClientLink>\n            ) : (\n              <span aria-disabled=\"true\" className={itemClass}>\n                {marker}\n              </span>\n            )}\n          </li>\n        )\n      })}\n    </ol>\n  </nav>\n)\n\nexport default CheckoutSteps\n"
}

\"shipping-postal-code-input\" : \"billing-postal-input\",\n  },\n  {\n    field: \"city\",\n    label: \"City\",\n    autoComplete: \"address-level2\",\n    required: true,\n    testId: (key) => `${key}-city-input`,\n  },\n]\n\ntype AddressFieldsProps = {\n  prefix: AddressPrefix\n  values: Record<string, string>\n  errors: Record<string, string>\n  onChange: (\n    event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement | HTMLSelectElement>\n  ) => void\n  region?: HttpTypes.StoreRegion\n}\n\n/**\n * The address inputs, shared by the shipping and billing blocks so both are\n * validated and laid out the same way. \"\"\n  const error = (field: string) => errors[`${prefix}.${field}`]\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 xsmall:grid-cols-2\">\n      {FIELDS.map((field) => (\n        <Input\n          key={field.field}\n          id={`${prefix}-${field.field}`}\n          name={`${prefix}.${field.field}`}\n          label={field.label}\n          autoComplete={field.autoComplete}\n          required={field.required}\n          value={value(field.field)}\n          onChange={onChange}\n          error={error(field.field)}\n          data-testid={field.testId(key)}\n        />\n      ))}\n\n      <div className=\"flex flex-col gap-2\">\n        <label\n          htmlFor={`${prefix}-country_code`}\n          className=\"text-small font-semibold text-ink\"\n        >\n          Country\n        </label>\n        <CountrySelect\n          id={`${prefix}-country_code`}\n          name={`${prefix}.country_code`}\n          autoComplete=\"country\"\n          region={region}\n          required\n          value={value(\"country_code\")}\n          onChange={onChange}\n          aria-invalid={error(\"country_code\") ? true : undefined}\n          data-testid={`${key}-country-select`}\n        />\n        {error(\"country_code\") && (\n          <p className=\"text-small text-ink\">{error(\"country_code\")}</p>\n        )}\n      </div>\n\n      <Input\n        id={`${prefix}-province`}\n        name={`${prefix}.province`}\n        label=\"State / Province (optional)\"\n        autoComplete=\"address-level1\"\n        value={value(\"province\")}\n        onChange={onChange}\n        error={error(\"province\")}\n        data-testid={`${key}-province-input`}\n      />\n\n      <Input\n        id={`${prefix}-phone`}\n        name={`${prefix}.phone`}\n        label=\"Phone (optional)\"\n        type=\"tel\"\n        autoComplete=\"tel\"\n        value={value(\"phone\")}\n        onChange={onChange}\n        error={error(\"phone\")}\n        data-testid={`${key}-phone-input`}\n      />\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n\nexport default AddressFields\n"

Record<string, string>\n}) => {\n  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<Record<string, string>>({\n    \"shipping_address.first_name\": cart?.shipping_address?.first_name || \"\",\n    \"shipping_address.last_name\": cart?.shipping_address?.last_name || \"\",\n    \"shipping_address.address_1\": cart?.shipping_address?.address_1 || \"\",\n    \"shipping_address.company\": cart?.shipping_address?.company || \"\",\n    \"shipping_address.postal_code\": cart?.shipping_address?.postal_code || \"\",\n    \"shipping_address.city\": cart?.shipping_address?.city || \"\",\n cart?.shipping_address?.phone || \"\",\n  })\n\n  const countriesInRegion = useMemo(\n    () => cart?.region?.countries?.map((c) => c.iso_2),\n    [cart?.region]\n  )\n\n  const addressesInRegion = const setFormAddress = (address?: HttpTypes.StoreCartAddress) => {\n    if (!address) {\n      return\n    }\n\n    setFormData((prevState) => ({\n      ...prevState,\n }\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (cart?.shipping_address) {\n      setFormAddress(cart.shipping_address)\n    }\n  }, [cart])\n\n  const handleChange = (\n    e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement | The four steps above are\n * closed and show their own summaries at this point; this is the last look\n * before the order exists, so it repeats the facts a customer checks.\n */\nconst Review = ({\n  cart,\n  isOpen,\n}: {\n  cart: HttpTypes.StoreCart\n  isOpen: boolean\n}) => {\n  const address = cart.shipping_address\n  const method = cart.shipping_methods?.at(-1)\n  const session = cart.payment_collection?.payment_sessions?.find(\n    (paymentSession) => paymentSession.status === \"pending\"\n  )\n\n  const rows: { label: string; value: string; testId: string }[] = [\n    { label: \"Email\", value: cart.email ?? \"—\", testId: \"review-email\" },\n    {\n      label: \"Ship to\",\n      value: address\n        ? `${address.first_name} ${address.last_name}, ${address.address_1}, ${address.postal_code} ${address.city}, ${address.country_code?.toUpperCase()}`\n        : \"—\",\n      testId: \"review-address\",\n    },\n    {\n      label: \"Delivery\",\n      value: method\n        ? `${method.name} — ${convertToLocale({\n            amount: method.amount ?? 0,\n            currency_code: cart.currency_code,\n          })}`\n        : \"—\",\n      testId: \"review-delivery\",\n    },\n    {\n      label: \"Payment\",\n      value: paymentInfoMap[session?.provider_id ?? \"\"]?.title ??\n        session?.provider_id ??\n        \"—\",\n      testId: \"review-payment\",\n    },\n  ]\n\n  return (\n    <StepSection\n      id=\"review\"\n      number={5}\n      title=\"Review\"\n      isOpen={isOpen}\n      complete={false}\n    >\n      {isOpen && (\n        <div className=\"flex flex-col gap-6\">\n          <dl className=\"grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 border border-ink p-5 small:grid-cols-2\">\n            {rows.map((row) => (\n              <div key={row.testId} className=\"flex flex-col gap-1\">\n                <dt className=\"text-small font-semibold text-ink\">\n                  {row.label}\n                </dt>\n                <dd className=\"text-small text-ink/80\" data-testid={row.testId}>\n                  {row.value}\n                </dd>\n              </div>\n            ))}\n          </dl>\n\n          <p className=\"max-w-prose text-small text-ink/80\">\n            Placing the order confirms that you have read and accept our terms\n            of sale and returns policy.\n          </p>\n\n          <PaymentButton cart={cart} data-testid=\"submit-order-button\" />\n        </div>\n      )}\n    </StepSection>\n  )\n}\n\nexport default Review\n"
}

  "content": "import { listCartShippingMethods } from \"@lib/data/fulfillment\"\nimport { listCartPaymentMethods } from \"@lib/data/payment\"\nimport { HttpTypes } from \"@medusajs/types\"\nimport LocalizedClientLink from \"@modules/common/components/localized-client-link\"\nimport { linkClass } from \"@modules/design-system\"\nimport Addresses from \"@modules/checkout/components/addresses\"\nimport Contact from \"@modules/checkout/components/contact\"\nimport Payment from \"@modules/checkout/components/payment\"\nimport Review from \"@modules/checkout/components/review\"\nimport Shipping from \"@modules/checkout/components/shipping\"\nimport type { CheckoutStepId } from \"@modules/checkout/lib/steps\"\n\nexport default async function CheckoutForm({\n  cart,\n  customer,\n  currentStep,\n}: {\n  cart: HttpTypes.StoreCart | null\n  customer: HttpTypes.StoreCustomer | null\n  currentStep: CheckoutStepId\n}) {\n  if (!cart) {\n    return null\n  }\n\n  const [shippingMethods, paymentMethods] = await Promise.all([\n    listCartShippingMethods(cart.id),\n    listCartPaymentMethods(cart.region?.id ?? \"\"),\n  ])\n\n  /*\n   * Without delivery options there is nothing to choose, and without a payment\n   * provider there is nothing to pay with. Saying so beats rendering a form\n   * that cannot be completed.\n   */\n  if (!shippingMethods?.length || !paymentMethods?.length) {\n    return (\n      <div\n        role=\"alert\"\n        className=\"flex flex-col items-start gap-3 border border-ink p-6\"\n        data-testid=\"checkout-unavailable\"\n      >\n        <h2 className=\"font-display text-lead font-bold\">\n          Checkout is unavailable\n        </h2>\n        <p className=\"text-small text-ink/80\">\n          Delivery or payment options could not be loaded for this region.\n          Try again in a moment.\n        </p>\n        <LocalizedClientLink href=\"/cart\" className={linkClass}>\n          Back to the cart\n        </LocalizedClientLink>\n      </div>\n    )\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"flex w-full flex-col gap-8\">\n      <Contact cart={cart} isOpen={currentStep === \"contact\"} />\n\n      <Addresses\n        cart={cart}\n        customer={customer}\n        isOpen={currentStep === \"address\"}\n      />\n\n      <Shipping\n        cart={cart}\n        availableShippingMethods={shippingMethods}\n        isOpen={currentStep === \"delivery\"}\n      />\n\n      <Payment\n        cart={cart}\n        availablePaymentMethods={paymentMethods}\n        isOpen={currentStep === \"payment\"}\n      />\n\n      <Review cart={cart} isOpen={currentStep === \"review\"} />\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n"

{

  "instructions": "Resolve the requested checkout step server-side and render the stepper plus the form.",
  "content": "import { retrieveCart } from \"@lib/data/cart\"\nimport { retrieveCustomer } from \"@lib/data/customer\"\nimport CheckoutSteps from \"@modules/checkout/components/checkout-steps\"\nimport { resolveCheckoutStep } from \"@modules/checkout/lib/steps\"\nimport PaymentWrapper from \"@modules/checkout/components/payment-wrapper\"\nimport CheckoutForm from \"@modules/checkout/templates/checkout-form\"\nimport CheckoutSummary from \"@modules/checkout/templates/checkout-summary\"\nimport { Rule } from \"@modules/design-system\"\nimport { Metadata } from \"next\"\nimport { notFound, redirect } from \"next/navigation\"\n\nexport const metadata: Metadata = {\n  title: \"Checkout\",\n}\n\nexport default async function Checkout(props: {\n  params: Promise<{ countryCode: string }>\n  searchParams: Promise<Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>>\n}) {\n  const [{ countryCode }, searchParams] = await Promise.all([\n    props.params,\n    props.searchParams,\n  ])\n\n  const cart = await retrieveCart()\n\n  if (!cart) {\n    return notFound()\n  }\n\n  /*\n   * The URL names the step; the cart decides whether it is a step the customer\n   * is allowed to be on. A step whose prerequisites are missing sends them back\n   * to the first thing still unfinished rather than rendering a form that\n   * cannot be submitted.\n   */\n  const requested = searchParams.step\n  const currentStep = resolveCheckoutStep(\n    cart,\n    Array.isArray(requested) ? requested[0] : requested\n  )\n\n  if (currentStep !== requested) {\n    redirect(`/${countryCode}/checkout?step=${currentStep}`)\n  }\n\n  const customer = await retrieveCustomer()\n\n  return (\n    <>\n      <div className=\"content-container pt-8\">\n        <CheckoutSteps cart={cart} current={currentStep} />\n        <Rule className=\"mt-4\" weight=\"heavy\" />\n      </div>\n\n      <div className=\"content-container grid grid-cols-1 gap-x-16 pb-16 pt-8 small:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_360px]\">\n        <PaymentWrapper cart={cart}>\n          <CheckoutForm\n            cart={cart}\n            customer={customer}\n            currentStep={currentStep}\n          />\n        </PaymentWrapper>\n        <CheckoutSummary cart={cart} />\n      </div>\n    </>\n  )\n}\n"
}

- path: apps/storefront/src/modules/checkout/components/discount-code/index.tsx
  content: |
      "use client"
      
      import { Input } from "@modules/design-system"
      import React from "react"
      
      import { applyPromotions } from "@lib/data/cart"
      import { convertToLocale } from "@lib/util/money"
      import { HttpTypes } from "@medusajs/types"
      import Trash from "@modules/common/icons/trash"
      import ErrorMessage from "../error-message"
      import { SubmitButton } from "../submit-button"
      
      type DiscountCodeProps = {
        cart: HttpTypes.StoreCart
      }
      
      const DiscountCode: React.FC<DiscountCodeProps> = ({ cart }) => {
        const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = React.useState(false)
        const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = React.useState("")
      
        const { promotions = [] } = cart
        const removePromotionCode = async (code: string) => {
          const validPromotions = promotions.filter(
            (promotion) => promotion.code !== code
          )
      
          await applyPromotions(
            validPromotions.filter((p) => p.code !== undefined).map((p) => p.code!)
          )
        }
      
        const addPromotionCode = async (formData: FormData) => {
          setErrorMessage("")
      
          const code = formData.get("code")
          if (!code) {
            return
          }
          const input = document.getElementById("promotion-input") as HTMLInputElement
          const codes = promotions
            .filter((p) => p.code !== undefined)
            .map((p) => p.code!)
          codes.push(code.toString())
      
          try {
            await applyPromotions(codes)
          } catch (e) {
            setErrorMessage(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e))
          }
      
          if (input) {
            input.value = ""
          }
        }
      
        return (
          <div className="flex w-full flex-col">
            <form action={(a) => addPromotionCode(a)} className="mb-5 w-full">
              <div className="my-2 flex items-center gap-x-1">
                <button
                  onClick={() => setIsOpen(!isOpen)}
                  type="button"
                  className="text-small font-semibold text-riso-blue underline decoration-1 underline-offset-4 transition-colors duration-150 hover:text-ink"
                  data-testid="add-discount-button"
                >
                  Add Promotion Code(s)
                </button>
              </div>
      
              {isOpen && (
                <>
                  <div className="flex w-full items-end gap-x-2">
                    {/* The field grows; the button keeps its own width. */}
                    <div className="flex-1">
                      <Input
                        id="promotion-input"
                        label="Promotion code(s)"
                        name="code"
                        type="text"
                        autoFocus={false}
                        data-testid="discount-input"
                      />
                    </div>
                    <SubmitButton
                      variant="secondary"
                      data-testid="discount-apply-button"
                    >
                      Apply
                    </SubmitButton>
                  </div>
      
                  <ErrorMessage
                    error={errorMessage}
                    data-testid="discount-error-message"
                  />
                </>
              )}
            </form>
      
            {promotions.length > 0 && (
              <div className="flex w-full items-center">
                <div className="flex w-full flex-col">
                  <h3 className="mb-2 text-small font-semibold text-ink">
                    Promotion(s) applied:
                  </h3>
      
                  {promotions.map((promotion) => {
                    return (
                      <div
                        key={promotion.id}
                        className="mb-2 flex w-full max-w-full items-center justify-between"
                        data-testid="discount-row"
                      >
                        <span className="flex w-4/5 items-baseline gap-x-1 pr-1 text-small text-ink">
                          <span className="truncate" data-testid="discount-code">
                            <span
                              className={
                                "border px-2 py-0.5 font-mono text-micro " +
                                (promotion.is_automatic
                                  ? "border-riso-green text-riso-green"
                                  : "border-ink text-ink")
                              }
                            >
                              {promotion.code}
                            </span>{" "}
                            (
                            {promotion.application_method?.value !== undefined &&
                              promotion.application_method.currency_code !==
                                undefined && (
                                <>
                                  {promotion.application_method.type === "percentage"
                                    ? `${promotion.application_method.value}%`
                                    : convertToLocale({
                                        amount: +promotion.application_method.value,
                                        currency_code:
                                          promotion.application_method.currency_code,
                                      })}
                                </>
                              )}
                            )
                          </span>
                        </span>
                        {!promotion.is_automatic && (
                          <button
                            className="flex items-center"
                            onClick={() => {
                              if (!promotion.code) {
                                return
                              }
      
                              removePromotionCode(promotion.code)
                            }}
                            data-testid="remove-discount-button"
                          >
                            <Trash size={14} />
                            <span className="sr-only">
                              Remove discount code from order
                            </span>
                          </button>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    )
                  })}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
