- path: apps/storefront/src/modules/common/components/native-select/index.tsx
  content: |
      import { ChevronUpDown } from "@medusajs/icons"
      import clsx from "clsx"
      import {
        SelectHTMLAttributes,
        forwardRef,
        useEffect,
        useImperativeHandle,
        useRef,
        useState,
      } from "react"
      
      export type NativeSelectProps = {
        placeholder?: string
        errors?: Record<string, unknown>
        touched?: Record<string, unknown>
      } & SelectHTMLAttributes<HTMLSelectElement>
      
      const NativeSelect = forwardRef<HTMLSelectElement, NativeSelectProps>(
        (
          { placeholder = "Select...", defaultValue, className, children, ...props },
          ref
        ) => {
          const innerRef = useRef<HTMLSelectElement>(null)
          const [isPlaceholder, setIsPlaceholder] = useState(false)
      
          useImperativeHandle<HTMLSelectElement | null, HTMLSelectElement | null>(
            ref,
            () => innerRef.current
          )
      
          useEffect(() => {
            if (innerRef.current && innerRef.current.value === "") {
              setIsPlaceholder(true)
            } else {
              setIsPlaceholder(false)
            }
          }, [innerRef.current?.value])
      
          return (
            <div>
              <div
                onFocus={() => innerRef.current?.focus()}
                onBlur={() => innerRef.current?.blur()}
                className={clsx(
                  "relative flex items-center border border-ink bg-stock text-body",
                  className
                )}
              >
                <select
                  ref={innerRef}
                  defaultValue={defaultValue}
                  {...props}
                  className={clsx(
                    "flex-1 appearance-none border-none bg-transparent px-3 py-2.5 pr-9 text-body transition-colors duration-150 outline-none",
                    // The placeholder is a disabled option, so the empty value is
                    // what tells us to mute the closed select.
                    isPlaceholder ? "text-ink/60" : "text-ink"
                  )}
                >
                  <option disabled value="">
                    {placeholder}
                  </option>
                  {children}
                </select>
                <span className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-y-0 right-4 flex items-center text-ink">
                  <ChevronUpDown />
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          )
        }
      )
      
      NativeSelect.displayName = "NativeSelect"
      
      export default NativeSelect
      
  referencedBy: {}

      export const removePendingCustomer = async () => {
        const cookies = await nextCookies()
        cookies.set("_medusa_pending_customer", "", {
          maxAge: -1,
        })
      }
      
      export const getCartId = async () => {
        const cookies = await nextCookies()
        return cookies.get("_medusa_cart_id")?.value
      }
      
      // See the note on `setAuthToken`: `sameSite: "lax"` so the cart cookie survives

      export const setCartId = async (cartId: string) => {
        const cookies = await nextCookies()
        cookies.set("_medusa_cart_id", cartId, {
          maxAge: 60 * 60 * 24 * 7,
          httpOnly: true,
          sameSite: "lax",
          secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === "production",
        })
      }
      
      export const removeCartId = async () => {
        const cookies = await nextCookies()
        cookies.set("_medusa_cart_id", "", {
          maxAge: -1,
        })
      }

  content: |
      "use client"
      
      import Image from "next/image"
      import { useRouter } from "next/navigation"
      import { useEffect, useState } from "react"
      
      import { updateLineItem } from "@lib/data/cart"
      import { HttpTypes } from "@medusajs/types"
      import CartItemSelect from "@modules/cart/components/cart-item-select"
      import ErrorMessage from "@modules/checkout/components/error-message"
      import DeleteButton from "@modules/common/components/delete-button"
      import LineItemOptions from "@modules/common/components/line-item-options"
      import LineItemPrice from "@modules/common/components/line-item-price"
      import LineItemUnitPrice from "@modules/common/components/line-item-unit-price"
      import LocalizedClientLink from "@modules/common/components/localized-client-link"
      import Spinner from "@modules/common/icons/spinner"
      
      type ItemProps = {
        item: HttpTypes.StoreCartLineItem
        type?: "full" | "preview"
        currencyCode: string
        /**
         * Units of this line's variant still buyable, or `null` when stock is not a
         * limit. `undefined` means the caller did not ask (see `remainingUnits`).
         */
        availableUnits?: number | null
      }
      
      /*
       * The most units one line may hold. Stock can lower this but never raise it:
       * a well-stocked catalogue reports hundreds of units, and a picker with
       * hundreds of entries is not a quantity control. Ten also matches what the
       * starter offered, so nothing that worked before stops working.
       */
      const MAX_LINE_QUANTITY = 10
      
      const Item = ({
        item,
        type = "full",
        currencyCode,
        availableUnits,
      }: ItemProps) => {
        const router = useRouter()
        const [updating, setUpdating] = useState(false)
        const [pendingQuantity, setPendingQuantity] = useState<number | null>(null)
        const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)
      
        /*
         * The server's quantity is the truth. A confirmed change comes back as a new
         * `item.quantity`, which drops the optimistic value; a rejected one never
         * does, so the select snaps back to what the cart actually holds.
         */
        useEffect(() => {
          setPendingQuantity(null)
        }, [item.quantity])
      
        const quantity = pendingQuantity ?? item.quantity
      
        const stockKnown = typeof availableUnits === "number"
        const available = stockKnown ? (availableUnits as number) : null
        const maxQuantity =
          available === null ? MAX_LINE_QUANTITY : Math.max(Math.min(available, MAX_LINE_QUANTITY), 1)
        const outOfStock = available !== null && available < 1
        const exceedsStock = available !== null && item.quantity > available
      
        const changeQuantity = async (nextQuantity: number) => {
          /*
           * A select can hand back an empty value if it is asked for an option that
           * does not exist, and the API reads quantity 0 as "delete this line". Only
           * a real, positive quantity is worth sending.
           */
          if (!Number.isInteger(nextQuantity) || nextQuantity < 1) {
            return
          }
      
          if (nextQuantity === item.quantity) {
            return
          }
      
          setError(null)
          setPendingQuantity(nextQuantity)
          setUpdating(true)
      
          try {
            const result = await updateLineItem({
              lineId: item.id,
              quantity: nextQuantity,
            })
      
            if (!result.ok) {
              setError(result.message)
              setPendingQuantity(null)
            } else {
              /*
               * Ask for the route again. The action already revalidated the cart and
               * usually repaints it, but that repaint is not guaranteed to land
               * (measured: roughly one change in ten left the row showing the previous
               * quantity and money), so the totals and the stock warnings are
               * refreshed explicitly.
               */
              router.refresh()
            }
          } catch (cause) {
            setError(
              cause instanceof Error && cause.message
                ? cause.message
                : "Could not update the quantity. Try again."
            )
            setPendingQuantity(null)
          } finally {
            setUpdating(false)
          }
        }
      
        const selectId = `quantity-${item.id}`
        const quantityOptions = Array.from(
          { length: maxQuantity },
          (_unused, index) => index + 1
        )
      
        return (
          <li
            className="flex gap-4 border-b border-ink/20 py-6"
            aria-busy={updating || undefined}
            data-testid="product-row"
          >
            <LocalizedClientLink
              href={`/products/${item.product_handle}`}
              className="block w-20 shrink-0 small:w-24"
              tabIndex={-1}
              aria-hidden="true"
            >
              <span className="relative block aspect-square w-full overflow-hidden border border-ink bg-ink/5">
                {item.thumbnail ? (
                  <Image
                    src={item.thumbnail}
                    alt=""
                    fill
                    sizes="96px"
                    className="object-cover object-center"
                  />
                ) : null}
              </span>
            </LocalizedClientLink>
      
            <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col gap-4 small:flex-row small:justify-between small:gap-6">
              <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-1">
                <LocalizedClientLink
                  href={`/products/${item.product_handle}`}
                  className="font-display text-lead font-semibold leading-tight text-ink hover:text-riso-blue"
                  data-testid="product-title"
                >
                  {item.product_title}
                </LocalizedClientLink>
      
                <LineItemOptions variant={item.variant} data-testid="product-variant" />
      
                {type === "full" ? (
                  <LineItemUnitPrice
                    item={item}
                    style="tight"
                    currencyCode={currencyCode}
                  />
                ) : null}
      
                {outOfStock || exceedsStock ? (
                  <p
                    role="status"
                    className="text-small font-semibold text-ink"
                    data-testid="stock-warning"
                  >
                    {outOfStock
                      ? "Out of stock. Remove this line to continue."
                      : `Only ${available} left. Lower the quantity to continue.`}
                  </p>
                ) : null}
              </div>
      
              <div className="flex shrink-0 flex-col items-start gap-3 small:items-end">
                {type === "full" ? (
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <label htmlFor={selectId} className="text-small text-ink/70">
                      Quantity
                    </label>
                    <CartItemSelect
                      id={selectId}
                      value={quantity}
                      disabled={updating || outOfStock}
                      onChange={(event) => changeQuantity(Number(event.target.value))}
                      data-testid="product-select-button"
                    >
                      {exceedsStock ? (
                        <option value={item.quantity}>
                          {item.quantity} (only {available} left)
                        </option>
                      ) : null}
                      {quantityOptions.map((option) => (
                        <option value={option} key={option}>
                          {option}
                        </option>
                      ))}
                    </CartItemSelect>
                    {updating ? <Spinner /> : null}
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <p
                    className="font-mono text-small text-ink/70"
                    data-testid="cart-item-quantity"
                  >
                    {item.quantity} x
                  </p>
                )}
      
                <LineItemPrice item={item} style="tight" currencyCode={currencyCode} />
                {type === "full" ? (
                  <DeleteButton
                    id={item.id}
                    className="text-small"
                    data-testid="product-delete-button"
                  >
                    Remove
                  </DeleteButton>
                ) : null}
      
                <ErrorMessage error={error} data-testid="product-error-message" />
              </div>
            </div>
          </li>
        )
      }
      
      export default Item
      
  referencedBy: {}

  content: |
      import repeat from "@lib/util/repeat"
      import { HttpTypes } from "@medusajs/types"
      
      import Item from "@modules/cart/components/item"
      
      type ItemsTemplateProps = {
        cart?: HttpTypes.StoreCart
        /** Units left per variant id; `null` where stock is not a limit. */
        availability?: Record<string, number | null>
      }
      
      /** Placeholder row shown only if the cart has not resolved yet. */
      const SkeletonRow = () => (
        <li
          className="flex gap-4 border-b border-ink/20 py-6"
          data-testid="cart-item-loader"
        >
          <div className="h-20 w-20 shrink-0 animate-pulse bg-ink/10 small:h-24 small:w-24" />
          <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col gap-3">
            <div className="h-4 w-40 animate-pulse bg-ink/10" />
            <div className="h-4 w-24 animate-pulse bg-ink/10" />
            <div className="h-4 w-20 animate-pulse bg-ink/10" />
          </div>
        </li>
      )
      
      /**
       * The cart's lines. Quantities come from the cart, but how many units are left
       * has to come from the product side — the cart payload does not carry inventory
       * — so the page resolves it once and hands the map down.
       */
      const ItemsTemplate = ({ cart, availability = {} }: ItemsTemplateProps) => {
        const items = cart?.items
        const currencyCode = cart?.currency_code ?? ""
      
        return (
          <ul className="flex flex-col border-t border-ink/20" data-testid="cart-items">
            {items
              ? items
                  .slice()
                  .sort((a, b) => {
                    return (a.created_at ?? "") > (b.created_at ?? "") ? -1 : 1
                  })
                  .map((item) => (
                    <Item
                      key={item.id}
                      item={item}
                      currencyCode={currencyCode}
                      availableUnits={
                        item.variant_id && item.variant_id in availability
                          ? availability[item.variant_id]
                          : undefined
                      }
                    />
                  ))
              : repeat(5).map((index) => <SkeletonRow key={index} />)}
          </ul>
        )
      }
      
      export default ItemsTemplate
      
  referencedBy: {}

      import { retrieveOrder } from "@lib/data/orders"
      import OrderCompletedTemplate from "@modules/order/templates/order-completed-template"
      import { Metadata } from "next"
      import { notFound } from "next/navigation"
      
      type Props = {
        params: Promise<{ id: string }>
      }
      export const metadata: Metadata = {
        title: "Order Confirmed",
        description: "You purchase was successful",
      }
      
      export default async function OrderConfirmedPage(props: Props) {
        const params = await props.params
        const order = await retrieveOrder(params.id).catch(() => null)
      
        if (!order) {
          return notFound()
        }
      
        return <OrderCompletedTemplate order={order} />
      }
      
  referencedBy: {}
- path: apps/storefront/src/modules/order/templates/order-completed-template.tsx
  content: |
      import { Heading } from "@modules/common/components/ui"
      import { cookies as nextCookies } from "next/headers"
      
      import CartTotals from "@modules/common/components/cart-totals"
      import Help from "@modules/order/components/help"
      import Items from "@modules/order/components/items"
      import OnboardingCta from "@modules/order/components/onboarding-cta"
      import OrderDetails from "@modules/order/components/order-details"
      import ShippingDetails from "@modules/order/components/shipping-details"
      import PaymentDetails from "@modules/order/components/payment-details"
      import { HttpTypes } from "@medusajs/types"
      
      type OrderCompletedTemplateProps = {
        order: HttpTypes.StoreOrder
      }
      
      export default async function OrderCompletedTemplate({
        order,
      }: OrderCompletedTemplateProps) {
        const cookies = await nextCookies()
      
        const isOnboarding = cookies.get("_medusa_onboarding")?.value === "true"
      
        return (
          <div className="py-6 min-h-[calc(100vh-64px)]">
            <div className="content-container flex flex-col justify-center items-center gap-y-10 max-w-4xl h-full w-full">
              {isOnboarding && <OnboardingCta orderId={order.id} />}
              <div
                className="flex flex-col gap-4 max-w-4xl h-full bg-white w-full py-10"
                data-testid="order-complete-container"
              >
                <Heading
                  level="h1"
                  className="flex flex-col gap-y-3 text-ui-fg-base text-3xl mb-4"
                >
                  <span>Thank you!</span>
                  <span>Your order was placed successfully.</span>
                </Heading>
                <OrderDetails order={order} />
                <Heading level="h2" className="flex flex-row text-3xl-regular">
                  Summary
                </Heading>
                <Items order={order} />

      "use server"
      
      import { sdk } from "@lib/config"
      import { medusaError } from "@lib/util/medusa-error"
      import { getAuthHeaders, getCacheOptions } from "./cookies"
      import { HttpTypes } from "@medusajs/types"
      
      export const retrieveOrder = async (id: string) => {
        const headers = {
          ...(await getAuthHeaders()),
        }
      
        const next = {
          ...(await getCacheOptions("orders")),
        }
      
        return sdk.client
          .fetch<HttpTypes.StoreOrderResponse>(`/store/orders/${id}`, {
            method: "GET",
            query: {
              fields:
                "*payment_collections.payments,*items,*items.metadata,*items.variant,*items.product",
            },
            headers,
            next,
            cache: "force-cache",
          })
          .then(({ order }) => order)
          .catch((err) => medusaError(err))
      }
      
      export const listOrders = async (
        limit: number = 10,
        offset: number = 0,
        filters?: Record<string, unknown>
      ) => {
        const headers = {
          ...(await getAuthHeaders()),
        }
      
        const next = {
          ...(await getCacheOptions("orders")),
        }
      
        return sdk.client
          .fetch<HttpTypes.StoreOrderListResponse>(`/store/orders`, {
            method: "GET",
            query: {
              limit,
              offset,
              order: "-created_at",
              fields: "*items,+items.metadata,*items.variant,*items.product",
              ...filters,
            },
            headers,
            next,
            cache: "force-cache",
          })
          .then(({ orders }) => orders)
          .catch((err) => medusaError(err))
      }
      
      export const createTransferRequest = async (
        state: {
          success: boolean
          error: string | null
          order: HttpTypes.StoreOrder | null
        },
        formData: FormData
      ): Promise<{
        success: boolean
        error: string | null
        order: HttpTypes.StoreOrder | null
      }> => {
        const id = formData.get("order_id") as string
      
        if (!id) {
          return { success: false, error: "Order ID is required", order: null }
        }
      
        const headers = await getAuthHeaders()
      
        return await sdk.store.order
          .requestTransfer(
            id,
            {},
            {
              fields: "id, email",
            },
            headers
          )
          .then(({ order }) => ({ success: true, error: null, order }))
          .catch((err) => ({ success: false, error: err.message, order: null }))
      }
      
      export const acceptTransferRequest = async (id: string, token: string) => {
        const headers = await getAuthHeaders()
      
        return await sdk.store.order
          .acceptTransfer(id, { token }, {}, headers)
          .then(({ order }) => ({ success: true, error: null, order }))
          .catch((err) => ({ success: false, error: err.message, order: null }))
      }
      
      export const declineTransferRequest = async (id: string, token: string) => {
        const headers = await getAuthHeaders()
      
        return await sdk.store.order
          .declineTransfer(id, { token }, {}, headers)
          .then(({ order }) => ({ success: true, error: null, order }))
          .catch((err) => ({ success: false, error: err.message, order: null }))
      }

> Now I have the exact defect:

> After a rejected submit, `FormData` contains `same_as_billing=on` — the checkbox flipped back to checked even though the customer had unchecked it. > 
> Cause: React 19 resets a form after its action runs (`requestFormReset`). For an uncontrolled... no, our checkbox *is* controlled (`checked={sameAsBilling}` + onChange). Hmm, but the reset still set `checked=true`? The DOM box is `true` while React state is `false` (since the billing block is still shown → state false). So the DOM shows checked while React thinks unchecked → disagreeing. Because the reset reverted the DOM checkbox to its *default* (which for a checkbox inside a `<form>` with no defaultChecked is unchecked... but we got checked=true).
> 
> Hmm, `defaultChecked` for this input: React renders `checked={sameAsBilling}` initially true (shipping == billing at first paint) — React treats the *initial* value as the default for reset purposes? Yes: React's form reset restores controlled checkboxes to the value they had at mount when `defaultChecked` isn't specified. Actually React's reset implementation uses the DOM's `defaultChecked` attribute, which React sets from `defaultChecked`. Since we don't pass `defaultChecked`, the attribute may be absent → reset → unchecked. But we observed checked.
> 
> Whatever the mechanism, the observable fact is: **after a rejected submit, the checkbox reverts to its mount-time state while React's state stays false**, so the next submit silently sends "same as billing".
> 
> That's a real, user-facing data-loss bug on the billing path: the customer's separate billing address is silently replaced by the shipping one.
> 
> Fix options:
> (a) Make the checkbox uncontrolled-ish but authoritative: read its value at submit from the DOM? Server actions receive FormData; the DOM is the truth for the checkbox. The mismatch comes from React's reset.
> (b) Give the checkbox a `defaultChecked` matching state so a reset restores something sane — doesn't fix the disagreement.
> (c) Don't rely on React state for the checkbox: use `defaultChecked` + a `useState` mirror updated in onChange, and re-sync from the DOM after each action (`useEffect` on state). Fragile.
> (d) Make the checkbox part of the same controlled flow but force the DOM to follow state after a rejected submit: use `key={String(sameAsBilling)}` on the checkbox so React remounts it when the state changes (a remount writes `checked` from the prop, overwriting the reset DOM state). Hmm, the state doesn't change after the rejection (false → false), so no remount happens.
> (e) Add a `useEffect` that after a submit result arrives, re-applies the checkbox: e.g. derive the checkbox's checked from state and set `ref.current.checked = sameAsBilling` in an effect that runs on `state` changes. Explicit and reliable.
> (f) Simplest and most robust: **don't submit the checkbox at all**. Instead, submit a hidden input whose value is derived from React state: `<input type="hidden" name="same_as_billing" value={sameAsBilling ? "on" : "off"} />`, and keep the visible checkbox with `checked` + onChange but WITHOUT a name. Hidden inputs are not affected by form reset (React controls their value attribute... hmm, hidden inputs ARE uncontrolled in the reset sense: reset only affects value/checked for user-editable fields; hidden inputs keep their `value` attribute. React's reset calls form.reset() which resets input values to defaults — for hidden inputs React's reset logic skips them? Actually `form.reset()` resets `<input>` values including hidden to their default (the `value` attribute). React would then re-render from state → controlled sync? A hidden input rendered with `value={...}` and no onChange is a *read-only controlled* input; React will warn ("You provided a `value` prop to a form field without an `onChange` handler") — a warning I don't want.
> 
> Hmm. Let's think about (e): after the action returns a new state, run an effect that syncs the DOM checkbox to `sameAsBilling`. Since `state` changes identity on each action result, `useEffect(..., [state, sameAsBilling])` runs and sets `ref.current.checked = sameAsBilling`. That's explicit and safe, and it hides React's quirk.
> 
> But careful: the effect must not fight the user's own clicks: on toggle, `sameAsBilling` changes and the effect sets checked = sameAsBilling (same as the DOM). Fine.
>

The address fields are controlled, so they're fine (c19 proves it). The billing fields are controlled too (probe shows "billing city value now: '   '" preserved, and "99 Bill Rd" preserved → controlled inputs keep their values). Only the checkbox diverges, because a checkbox's "value" is `checked` and React's reset writes it to the default.
> 
> So fix (e): keep `checked={sameAsBilling}` controlled by state AND add a ref-based effect that re-asserts `checked` whenever the action's state changes.

Since we *need* the DOM value to be authoritative for FormData, and the DOM is reset, the other option is to read from the DOM at submit time: i.e. don't use React state to decide the server payload — the FormData already carries the DOM state, and the DOM got reset. React writes `defaultChecked` only on mount (it's the default, not the current). So defaultChecked={true} (mount value) → reset → checked=true → same bug.

      - [x] **C5** Sort & filter — newest/price, category, price range, reflected in URL. Verified both directions against the Store API as the independent source of truth: every sort, filter and combination was loaded from a URL (URL → state) and driven by clicking the controls (state → URL). Newest (`created_at:desc`), price ascending and price descending each return the same 12 products the API expects, with prices monotonic; `everyday-basics` and `sweatshirts-hoodies` sort identically on the category and collection pages through their own `sortBy` parameter. Price range filters exactly as expected (from €40 → 11 products, up to €20 → 3, €20–50 → 12) and the slider is keyboard-operable, refining on release. Category filter returns the 7 T-Shirts, and combinations (category + range + sort) compound correctly with a chip per active filter. Two caveats recorded below: a price tie can swap the last slot on a page, and the search-driven `/store` keeps InstantSearch's parameter names.
      - [x] **K1** Cart — add/remove/quantity, persists across reload, stock errors handled. Rebuilt on the design system (plates and rules, mono money, display headings) and verified on the production build against the Store API as the independent source: adding from the product page puts `Cart (1)` in the nav and opens the cart drawer with the line and its subtotal within 608 ms; the cart page's subtotal, taxes, total and every line total equal the API's figures after each add, quantity change, removal and reload (5/5 steps), and the same cart id cookie survives the reload. Quantities offered are stock-derived — `race-condition-hoodie` size M offers 1–5, what the API reports for that variant. Stock paths, with stock moved through the Admin API so the Store API really changes: a quantity the API rejects leaves the line at the quantity the cart holds, with "There isn't enough stock left for that quantity. Lower it and try again." in the row, and a line holding 2 of 1 left is flagged ("Only 1 left. Lower the quantity to continue."), blocks checkout, and clears both once lowered; a product page prerendered when stock was 5 still offers the add and reports the same rejection inline. Two runs of the stock pass agreed exactly; no console errors, and no horizontal overflow at 360 / 768 / 1280.
      - [x] **K2** Checkout steps — email → address → shipping → payment → review, validation, back without data loss. The checkout is now the five-step sequence the spec names, rebuilt on the design system, and its state is *derived* rather than stored: the URL names the step (`?step=`) and the cart decides whether that step is reachable, so `/checkout` with no parameter lands on Contact, `?step=payment` before an address is redirected back to Contact, and an already-answered step stays editable. A numbered stepper (DESIGN.md §4 permits numbers for checkout steps) links only to reachable steps and shows the rest as locked; every step is a shared `StepSection` that collapses to its own summary once answered. ## What was built

**Step model** — `apps/storefront/src/modules/checkout/lib/steps.ts` (new): the five steps, what makes each one complete, and which are reachable. The URL names the step (`?step=contact|address|delivery|payment|review`) and the **cart decides whether it's reachable**, so `/checkout` with no parameter lands on Contact, `?step=payment` before an address is redirected back, and an answered step stays editable. A numbered stepper links only to reachable steps; each step is a shared `StepSection` that collapses to its summary.

**New pieces**: `components/checkout-steps`, `components/step-section`, `components/contact` (email gets its own step, as the spec's sequence says), `components/address-fields` (shared by shipping/billing), `lib/util/checkout-validation.ts`. **Rewritten**: addresses, shipping-address, billing_address, delivery, payment, payment-container, payment-button, review, checkout-form, the checkout page + layout, address-select, submit-button, plus the checkout summary/discount-code/native-select.

**Failures are returned, not thrown** — `setCartEmail`, `setAddresses`, `setShippingMethod`, `initiatePaymentSession`, `placeOrder` now return `{ ok, message }` / per-field errors, so K4's declined card can show its own copy in production.

      import { Heading } from "@modules/common/components/ui"
      import { cookies as nextCookies } from "next/headers"
      
      import CartTotals from "@modules/common/components/cart-totals"
      import Help from "@modules/order/components/help"
      import Items from "@modules/order/components/items"
      import OnboardingCta from "@modules/order/components/onboarding-cta"
      import OrderDetails from "@modules/order/components/order-details"
      import ShippingDetails from "@modules/order/components/shipping-details"
      import PaymentDetails from "@modules/order/components/payment-details"
      import { HttpTypes } from "@medusajs/types"
      
      type OrderCompletedTemplateProps = {
        order: HttpTypes.StoreOrder
      }
      
      export default async function OrderCompletedTemplate({
        order,
      }: OrderCompletedTemplateProps) {
        const cookies = await nextCookies()
      
        const isOnboarding = cookies.get("_medusa_onboarding")?.value === "true"
      
        return (
          <div className="py-6 min-h-[calc(100vh-64px)]">
            <div className="content-container flex flex-col justify-center items-center gap-y-10 max-w-4xl h-full w-full">
              {isOnboarding && <OnboardingCta orderId={order.id} />}
              <div
                className="flex flex-col gap-4 max-w-4xl h-full bg-white w-full py-10"
                data-testid="order-complete-container"
              >
                <Heading
                  level="h1"
                  className="flex flex-col gap-y-3 text-ui-fg-base text-3xl mb-4"
                >
                  <span>Thank you!</span>
                  <span>Your order was placed successfully.</span>
                </Heading>
                <OrderDetails order={order} />
                <Heading level="h2" className="flex flex-row text-3xl-regular">
                  Summary
                </Heading>
                <Items order={order} />
                <CartTotals totals={order} />
                <ShippingDetails order={order} />
                <PaymentDetails order={order} />
                <Help />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )
      }

      import { HttpTypes } from "@medusajs/types"
      import { Text } from "@modules/common/components/ui"
      
      type OrderDetailsProps = {
        order: HttpTypes.StoreOrder
        showStatus?: boolean
      }
      
      const OrderDetails = ({ order, showStatus }: OrderDetailsProps) => {
        const formatStatus = (str: string) => {
          const formatted = str.split("_").join(" ")
      
          return formatted.slice(0, 1).toUpperCase() + formatted.slice(1)
        }
      
        return (
          <div>
            <Text>
              We have sent the order confirmation details to{" "}
              <span
                className="text-ui-fg-medium-plus font-semibold"
                data-testid="order-email"
              >
                {order.email}
              </span>
              .
            </Text>
            <Text className="mt-2">
              Order date:{" "}
              <span data-testid="order-date">
                {new Date(order.created_at).toDateString()}
              </span>
            </Text>
            <Text className="mt-2 text-ui-fg-interactive">
              Order number: <span data-testid="order-id">{order.display_id}</span>
            </Text>
      
            <div className="flex items-center text-compact-small gap-x-4 mt-4">
              {showStatus && (
                <>
                  <Text>
                    Order status:{" "}
                    <span className="text-ui-fg-subtle " data-testid="order-status">
                      {formatStatus(order.fulfillment_status)}
                    </span>
                  </Text>
                  <Text>
                    Payment status:{" "}
                    <span
                      className="text-ui-fg-subtle "
                      sata-testid="order-payment-status"
                    >
                      {formatStatus(order.payment_status)}
                    </span>
                  </Text>
                </>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        )
      }
      
      export default OrderDetails

      import repeat from "@lib/util/repeat"
      import { HttpTypes } from "@medusajs/types"
      import { Table } from "@modules/common/components/ui"
      
      import Divider from "@modules/common/components/divider"
      import Item from "@modules/order/components/item"
      import SkeletonLineItem from "@modules/skeletons/components/skeleton-line-item"
      
      type ItemsProps = {
        order: HttpTypes.StoreOrder
      }
      
      const Items = ({ order }: ItemsProps) => {
        const items = order.items
      
        return (
          <div className="flex flex-col">
            <Divider className="!mb-0" />
            <Table>
              <Table.Body data-testid="products-table">
                {items?.length
                  ? items
                      .sort((a, b) => {
                        return (a.created_at ?? "") > (b.created_at ?? "") ? -1 : 1
                      })
                      .map((item) => {
                        return (
                          <Item
                            key={item.id}
                            item={item}
                            currencyCode={order.currency_code}
                          />
                        )
                      })
                  : repeat(5).map((i) => {
                      return <SkeletonLineItem key={i} />
                    })}
              </Table.Body>
            </Table>
          </div>
        )
      }
      
      export default Items

            <Divider className="!mb-0" />
            <Table>
              <Table.Body data-testid="products-table">
                {items?.length
                  ? items
                      .sort((a, b) => {
                        return (a.created_at ?? "") > (b.created_at ?? "") ? -1 : 1
                      })
                      .map((item) => {
                        return (
                          <Item

                            item={item}
                            currencyCode={order.currency_code}
                          />
                        )
                      })

                      return <SkeletonLineItem key={i} />
                    })}
              </Table.Body>
            </Table>
          </div>
        )
      }

## Failures found and fixed (not suppressed)
`<li>` inside `<tbody>` (React #418 on every checkout page), an uncontrolled email wiped by React's form reset, a rejected address re-checking the billing toggle and discarding the billing address, and a preselect gap in the payment step. Each fix was re-verified in the run that followed it; no lint rule was disabled and no assertion weakened (two harness assertions were corrected because they were wrong, not because the behaviour failed — the confirmation address probe hardcoded a city the flow had since edited, and a stepper probe clicked an `<li>` instead of its link).
